task_name: Arrange Magnets of the Same Color in a Row on the Whiteboard

en: Attach the two yellow magnets and the two red magnets on the left side of the table to the white board in the center respectively.

Use your left hand to hold the yellow magnet on the table close to the whiteboard onto the whiteboard. Then, hold the two red magnets on the table vertically one by one to the right of the former. Finally, hold the remaining yellow magnet behind the yellow one.
Attach the two yellow magnets and the two red magnets respectively to the lower left corner of the whiteboard.

Use your left hand to attach the yellow magnet at the bottom to the lower left of the whiteboard. Then, horizontally attach the red magnet closest to the whiteboard to its right. Next, attach another red magnet vertically behind the previous one. Finally, attach the second yellow magnet behind the previous one, forming a quadrilateral.
With the left hand, use the four magnets on the table to form a square on the whiteboard. The yellow ones are placed vertically on the left and the red ones on the right.
zh: 把桌子左边的两个黄色磁铁和两个红色磁铁分别吸在中央的白板上。
用左手把桌子上面靠近白板的黄色磁铁吸在白板上，再将桌上两个红色磁铁逐一竖着吸在前者的右边，最后再将剩余的黄色磁铁吸在黄色磁铁的后面。
把两个黄色磁铁和两个红色磁铁分别吸在白板的左下方。
用左手把最下方的黄色磁铁吸在白板的左下方，再将离白板最近的红色磁铁水平吸在它的右边，再将另一枚红色的竖着吸在前一枚红色的后面，最后将第二枚黄色的吸在前一枚黄色磁铁的后面，位置形成一个四边形。
左手用桌上的四枚磁铁在白板上拼一个正方形出来，黄色竖着在左边，红色竖着在右边。

task_name: Arrange Magnets of the Same Color in a Row on the Whiteboard

en: Attach the two yellow magnets and the two red magnets on the left side of the table to the white board in the center respectively.

Use your left hand to attach the pink magnet on the left side of the whiteboard to the upper left corner of the whiteboard, then attach the yellow magnet to the lower right corner, then attach the remaining yellow magnet in front of the pink magnet, and finally attach the last pink magnet to the right side of the pink magnet on the whiteboard. The four of them form a rectangle.
Attach two red magnets and two yellow magnets to the left side of the white board.

With your left hand, attach the red magnet closest to the whiteboard at the lower left corner of the clip to the upper left corner of the whiteboard. Then, horizontally attach the two yellow magnets on the table one by one from right to left below it. Ensure that the second yellow magnet is directly in front of the red magnet. Finally, attach the last red magnet on the table to the right of the previous one and keep it in a straight line with the first yellow magnet The positions form a quadrilateral.
zh: 把桌子左边的两个黄色磁铁和两个红色磁铁分别吸在中央的白板上。
用左手将白板左边的粉色磁铁吸在白板的左上角，再将黄色磁铁吸在其右下方，再将剩余的黄色磁铁吸在粉色磁铁的前面，再将最后一枚粉色磁铁吸在白板上粉色磁铁的右边，四者围成一个长方形。
把两枚红色磁铁和两枚黄色磁铁吸在白板偏左侧的位置。
左手把夹子左下方的最靠近白板的那枚红色磁铁吸在白板的左上方，再将桌上的两枚黄色磁铁逐个从右往左水平吸在它的下方，第二枚黄色磁铁保证在红磁铁的正前方，最后将桌上最后一枚红磁铁吸在前一枚红磁铁的右边并跟第一枚黄磁铁竖着在一条直线上，位置形成一个四边形。

Finally, attach the remaining two magnets on the table horizontally to the left front of the red and yellow magnets in the order of red first and then yellow.

Finally, attach the yellow magnet on the right side of the whiteboard with your right hand.

右手先将白板右侧的紫色磁铁吸到白板上，左手先后将白板左侧的紫色磁铁和黄色磁铁吸到白板上，最后右手再将白板右侧的黄色磁铁吸到白板上。

With your left hand, draw a yellow magnet on the left side of the whiteboard to the left front of the clip on the whiteboard. With your right hand, place the yellow magnet on the right side of the whiteboard to the right of another yellow magnet and directly in front of the clip. Then, with your right hand, place the remaining two purple magnets directly in front of the two yellow magnets respectively. The four of them form a square.
zh: 把桌上的彩色磁铁吸到白板上。
左手将白板左侧的一枚黄色磁铁吸到白板上夹子的左前方，右手再将白板右侧的黄色磁铁放到另一枚黄色磁铁的右边且处于夹子的正前方，然后右手将剩余两枚紫色磁铁分别放于两枚黄色磁铁的正前方，四者围成一个正方形。

en: Arrange three cubes of different sizes in a row on the table in order.
Use your left hand to arrange the smallest blue cube, the medium-sized green cube and the largest pink cube in a horizontal row on the desktop from left to right and from smallest to largest.
zh: 将三个大小不同的立方体在桌上按顺序排成一排。
用左手将最小的蓝色立方体、中等大小的绿色立方体和最大的粉红色立方体，按从左到右，从小到大的顺序在桌面上排成一横排。

en: Sort the three colored cubes by size.
Use your left hand to place the small blue cubes, medium green cubes and large pink cubes on the yellow checkered tablecloth in the order from left to right and from small to large.
zh: 按大小对三个彩色立方体进行排序。
用左手在黄色格子桌布上，将小蓝色立方体、中等绿色立方体和大粉色立方体按从左到右、从小到大的顺序摆放。

en: Sort the orange cubes by size by placing them one by one beside the largest purple cubes.
Use your right hand to move the medium-sized orange cube and the smallest orange cube from the right to the center. Place them in descending order of size beside the stationary purple cubes.

用右手将中等大小的橙色立方体和最小的橙色立方体从右侧移到中心。将它们按尺寸从大到小的顺序摆放在静止的紫色立方体旁边。

Use your right hand to grasp the medium-sized orange cubes and the smallest orange cubes, and move them from large to small onto the grid-like surface, placing them right next to the purple cubes.

Use your left hand to organize the small blue squares, medium-sized green squares and large red squares on the yellow checkered tablecloth. Push these squares into a horizontal row with your left hand, arranging them in ascending order and from left to right.

en: On the checkerboard desktop, categorize by moving the orange squares towards the purple ones.
Grab a medium-sized orange cube with your right hand and place it beside the large purple cube. Then move the smallest orange cube to the right of the medium-sized orange cube.
zh: 在棋盘格桌面上，通过将橙色方块移向紫色方块来进行分类。
用右手抓取中等大小的橙色立方体，并将其放置在大的紫色立方体旁边。再移动最小的橙色立方体到中等大小的橙色立方体的右边。

en: Place two red rectangular blocks on top of the existing row of three red blocks to form a two-layer wall structure.

Grab the red square on the far left with your left hand, lift it up and place it above the base square on the far left. Then align the red square on the far right with your right hand and place it above the base square on the far right.
Place two red squares on top of three connected red squares.
zh: 将两个红色矩形积木放在现有三块红色积木的一行上，形成两层墙结构。
左手抓取最左边的红色方块，将其提起并放置在最左边的基座方块上方；然后右手将最右边的红色方块对齐放在最右边的基座方块上方。
将两个红色方块放在三个连一起的红色方块上。

en: Place two red rectangular blocks on the existing row of three blocks to form a double-layer wall structure.

Grab the red block on the far right with your right hand, lift it vertically, and place it above the middle block on the bottom layer; then grab the leftmost block on the bottom layer with your left hand, lift it, and place it above the leftmost block on the bottom layer, aligning the edges.

Reach with your right hand to the red square in the bottom right corner, lift it straight up, and place it directly above the middle square on the lower layer; release to stabilize the square in the top right corner; withdraw your right hand; reach with your left hand to the red square in the bottom left corner, lift it vertically, and place it directly above the leftmost square on the lower layer, ensuring horizontal alignment with the top right square; release to complete the arrangement of bricks in two layers.
Place the two red squares on top of the three connected red squares.
zh: 将两个红色长方块放在现有三块积木的一行上，形成双层墙结构。
右手抓取最右边的红色方块，垂直提起，放在底层中间方块的上方；左手然后抓取最左边的底层方块，提起，放在底层最左边方块的上方，对齐边缘。
用右手伸向右下角的红色方块，将其向上直提，并置于下层中间方块的正上方；松开以使右上角的方块稳定；收回右手；用左手伸向左下角的红色方块，将其垂直提起，并放在最左侧下层方块的正上方，确保与右上角方块横向对齐；松开以完成两层的砖块排列。
将两个红色方块放在三个连一起的红色方块上。

en: Place two red rectangular blocks vertically on top of a row of three aligned red blocks to form a two-layer wall structure.

Grab the red block on the far right with your right hand, lift it, and place it flat on the block at the bottom center; then grab the bottom row block on the far left with your left hand, lift it, and place it flat on the bottom block on the far left.

Reach out with your right hand to the red block in the lower right corner, touch its top surface, lift it vertically, move it leftward, then place it on the block in the middle of the bottom layer. Withdraw your right hand. Move your left hand to the red block in the lower left corner, touch its top surface, lift it vertically, move it rightward, then place it on the leftmost block of the bottom layer. Release both blocks to complete a two-layer wall with an offset arrangement on the upper layer.
Place the two red rectangular blocks vertically on the row of three aligned red blocks.
zh: 将两个红色矩形块垂直放在一行三个对齐的红色块上，形成一个两层的墙结构。
右手抓住最右边的红色方块，将其提起，并平放在中间底部的方块上；然后左手抓住最左边的底部行方块，将其提起，并平放在最左边的底部方块上。
用右手伸向右下角的红色方块，接触其顶面，垂直提起，向左平移，然后将其放在底层中间的方块上。收回右手。移动左手到左下角的红色方块，接触其顶面，垂直提起，向右平移，然后将其放在底层最左侧的方块上。释放两个方块，完成一个上层错位排列的两层墙。
将两个红色矩形块垂直放在一行三个对齐的红色块上。

en: Place two red rectangular blocks on the existing row of three blocks to form a double-layer wall structure.

Grab the red block on the far right with your right hand, lift it vertically, and place it centered on the middle block of the lower layer; then grab the front row block on the far left with your left hand, lift it, and place it centered on the leftmost block of the lower layer.

Use your right hand to approach the red block at the right front, completely envelop it, and lift it vertically upward. Place it precisely above the central block in the back row, then lower it until it makes stable contact. Withdraw your right hand. Move your left hand to the red block at the left front, grasp it, lift it vertically, align it above the leftmost block in the back row, and then place it into position. Once the second block is stable, withdraw both hands.
Place two red rectangular blocks in a row with the existing three blocks.
zh: 将两个红色矩形积木放在现有三块积木的一行上，形成双层墙结构。
右手抓住最右边的红色方块，垂直提起，将其居中放在下层中间的方块上；然后左手抓住最左边的前排方块，提起它，将其居中放在最左边的下层方块上。
用右手靠近右前部的红色方块，完全包裹住它，并垂直向上提起。准确地将其放置在后排中央方块的上方，然后下降直到稳定接触。收回右手。移动左手向左前部的红色方块，抓住它，垂直提起，使其对齐在后排最左侧的方块上方，然后将其放入到位。第二个方块稳定后，收回双手。
将两个红色矩形积木放在现有三块积木的一行上。

en: Place two red rectangular blocks on the existing row of three blocks to form a two-layer wall structure.

Grab the red block on the bottom layer at the far right with your right hand, lift it, and place it on the middle bottom block; then grab the red block on the bottom layer at the far left with your left hand, place it on the bottom block at the far left, and align the two top blocks to form a staggered brick pattern.

Reach with your right hand to the lowest red block on the right side, grasp its top surface, lift it vertically, and place it centered on the block at the lower middle; release it to form the upper part of the first layer. Withdraw your right hand, then extend your left hand to the lowest red block on the left side, grasp its top surface, lift it straight up, move it slightly to the right to offset and align the joints, then place it on the block at the far left below; adjust the horizontal position to ensure tight contact before releasing.
Place the two red rectangular blocks in a row with the existing three blocks.
zh: 将两个红色矩形积木放在现有三块积木的一行上，形成一个两层的墙体结构。
右手抓起下层最右边的红色方块，将其提起并放在中间下层方块上；然后左手抓住最左边的下层红色方块，将其放在最左边的下层方块上，对齐两个上层方块以形成错缝砌筑图案。
用右手向右侧最下方的红色积木伸去，抓住其顶面，垂直提起，并将其居中放置在中间下方的积木上；松开以形成第一层上部。收回右手，然后伸出左手向左侧最下方的红色积木伸去，抓住其顶面，直直向上提起，稍微向右移动以错开接缝对齐，然后将其放在最左侧的下方积木上；调整横向位置以确保紧密接触后松开。
将两个红色矩形积木放在现有三块积木的一行上。

en: Place two red rectangular blocks on the existing row of three blocks to form a two-layer wall structure.

Grab the red block on the far right with your right hand and place it centered on the middle block of the back row; then grab the red block on the front row bottom left with your left hand and place it centered on the leftmost block of the back row.

Grasp the rightmost red block in the front bottom row with your right hand—the one with white peeling on its right edge—and lift it vertically while keeping it horizontal. Move it upward and backward so that its bottom surface is above the central block in the back row, then lower it until it makes stable contact. Release your grip. Move to the left, grasp the leftmost red block in the front bottom row with your left hand and lift it. Move it upward and slightly backward so that its bottom surface is above the leftmost block in the back row, then lower it until it is level and stable. Release your grip.
Place two red rectangular blocks in a row with the existing three blocks.
zh: 将两个红色矩形积木放在现有三块积木的一行上，形成一个两层的墙体结构。
右手抓起最右边的红色方块，，并将其居中放在后排中间方块上；然后左手抓起最左边的前排下方红色方块，并将其居中放在后排最左边的方块上。
右手抓住前下排最右边的红色方块——其右端有白色剥落——并垂直提起，同时保持水平方向。将其向上并向后移动，使其底面位于后排中央方块上方，然后将其降低至稳定接触。松开抓握。向左移动，左手抓住前下排最左边的红色方块并将其提起。将其向上并稍微向后移动，使其底面位于后排最左边方块的上方，然后降低直到平整且稳定。松开抓握。
将两个红色矩形积木放在现有三块积木的一行上。

en: Place two red rectangular blocks in a row with the existing three blocks to form a double-layer wall structure.

Grab the red block at the bottom right corner with your right hand, lift it vertically, and place it on the block in the middle of the bottom layer; then grab the remaining red block at the bottom left corner with your left hand, lift it, and place it on the leftmost block of the bottom layer.

Extend your right hand toward the red block at the lower right corner of the workspace, grasp its top surface, lift it vertically upward, then move it to the left and place it directly above the middle block of the lower layer. Retract your right hand, then extend your left hand to grab the red block at the lower left corner, grasp its top surface, lift it vertically, move it to the right so that it is directly above the leftmost block of the lower layer. Before releasing contact, slightly adjust the two upper blocks to align them.
Place the two red rectangular blocks in a row with the existing three blocks.
zh: 将两个红色长方块放在现有三块积木的一行上，形成双层墙结构。
右手抓取底层最右边的红色方块，垂直提起，放在底层中间的方块上；然后左手抓取剩下的左下角红色方块，提起它，放在底层最左边的方块上。
用右手伸向工作区右下角的红色方块，抓住其顶面，垂直向上提起，然后向左移动，将其置于下层中间方块的正上方。收回右手，然后伸出左手去抓取左下角的红色方块，抓住其顶面，垂直提起，向右移动，使其直接位于下层最左边方块的正上方。在释放接触前，稍微调整两个上层方块使其对齐。
将两个红色长方块放在现有三块积木的一行上。

en: Place two red rectangular blocks on top of the three aligned red blocks below to form a two-layer wall structure.

Grasp the red block at the bottom right with your right hand and place it centered on the block in the middle at the bottom; then grasp the block at the bottom left with your left hand, lift it, and place it centered on the block at the bottom left.

Reach with your right hand to the red square at the bottom right corner, grasp its top surface, lift it vertically, and place it precisely above the center of the middle square on the bottom layer; release your hand to form the top block of the first layer. Withdraw your right hand, then extend your left hand to grab the red square at the bottom left corner, lift it straight up, align it above the bottom square at the far left, and then lower it to make stable contact—thus completing a two-layer wall on one side, with three blocks at the bottom and two staggered blocks stacked above.
Place the two red rectangular blocks on top of the three aligned red blocks below.
zh: 将两个红色矩形积木放在下方三块对齐的红色积木上，形成两层墙结构。
右手抓住最底层右边的红色方块，并将其居中放在中间底部的方块上；然后左手抓住最底层左边的方块，将其提起，并将其居中放在最底层左边的方块上。
用右手伸向右下角的红色方块，抓住它的顶部表面，垂直提起，并精确地放置在底层中间方块的中心上方；松开手，形成第一层上部的方块。收回右手，然后伸出左手抓住左下角的红色方块，直直向上提起，使其对齐在最左边的底部方块上方，然后将其降低至稳定接触——这样就完成了一面两层的墙，底部有三个方块，上面叠放两个并错开。
将两个红色矩形积木放在下方三块对齐的红色积木上。

en: Place two red rectangular blocks vertically on top of a row of three red blocks to form a two-layer wall structure.

Grab the red block on the far right with your right hand, lift it, and place it vertically on top of the middle bottom layer block; then grab the bottom layer block on the far left with your left hand, lift it, and place it vertically on top of the bottom layer block on the far left, aligning the two upper blocks side by side.

Grasp the rightmost red block on the bottom layer with your right hand, and place it upright directly above the middle bottom block. Release the block to form the upper part of the first layer. Withdraw your right hand. Grasp the leftmost red block on the bottom layer with your left hand, firmly contact its top and side, lift it vertically, move it diagonally upward to the left, then place it upright directly above the leftmost bottom block. Adjust the horizontal alignment so the two upper blocks are tight and parallel, completing a two-layer brick arrangement.
Place two red rectangular blocks vertically on a row of three red blocks.
zh: 将两个红色矩形块垂直放在一行三个红色块上，形成一个两层的墙结构。
右手抓住最右边的红色方块，，将其提起，并竖直放在中间底层方块的顶部；然后左手抓住最左边的底层方块，将其提起，并竖直放在最左边底层方块的顶部，使两个上方的方块并排对齐。
用右手抓住底层最右边的红色积木，并将其直立地放在中间底层积木的正上方。松开积木，形成第一层上部的部件。收回右手。用左手抓住底层最左边的红色积木，牢固地接触其顶部和侧面，将其垂直提起，向左上方移动，然后直立地放在最左边底层积木的正上方。调整横向对齐，使上部的两个积木紧密且平行，完成一个2层的砖块排列。
将两个红色矩形块垂直放在一行三个红色块上。

en: Place two red rectangular blocks in a row with the existing three blocks to form a double-layer wall structure.

Grab the red block on the bottom layer's far right with your right hand, lift it, and place it centered above the middle block of the bottom layer; then grab the block on the bottom layer's far left with your left hand and place it centered on top of the leftmost block of the bottom layer.

Reach with your right hand toward the red square at the lower right corner of the table, grasp the top edge, lift it vertically, and place it horizontally above the center square of the bottom layer; adjust it laterally to align its long axis parallel with the square below, then release. Move your left hand to the red square at the lower left corner, grasp its top surface, lift it, move it upward and to the right, and place it neatly on the leftmost bottom layer square; make slight lateral adjustments to ensure consistent spacing and alignment on the upper layer.
Place the two red rectangular blocks in a row with the existing three blocks.
zh: 将两个红色长方块放在现有三块积木的一行上，形成双层墙结构。
右手抓住下层最右边的红色方块，将其提起，并居中放在下层中间方块的上方；然后左手抓住下层最左边的方块，将其居中放在下层最左边的方块上。
用右手伸向桌子右下角的红色方块，抓住其顶部边缘，垂直提起，并水平放置在底层中心方块上方；横向调整以使其长轴与下方方块平行，然后释放。将左手移动到左下角的红色方块，抓住其顶面，提起它，向上和向右移动，将其整齐地放在最左侧的底层方块上；进行微小的横向修正，以确保上层的间距和对齐一致。
将两个红色长方块放在现有三块积木的一行上。

en: Assemble a two-row brick structure by placing the lower row of bricks side by side, then stagger the upper row of bricks so that they overlap the joints.

Grab the red block on the bottom layer at the far right with your right hand, lift it, and place it centered above the middle block of the bottom layer; then grab the block on the bottom layer at the far left with your left hand and place it centered on top of the block at the far left of the bottom layer.

Grab the rightmost lower red brick with your right hand, lift it vertically, and place it centered over the joint between the middle and right lower bricks. Release the brick to form the upper unit of the first layer. Move your left hand to the leftmost lower red brick, lift it vertically, and place it centered over the joint between the left and middle lower bricks. Lower and release it to complete the two-row staggered wall structure composed of five bricks.
Place the lower layer bricks side by side and stack the upper layer bricks staggered over the joints.
zh: 通过将下层砖块并排放置，然后将上层砖块错开堆叠在接缝上，组装一个两行的砖结构。
右手抓住下层最右边的红色方块，将其提起，并居中放在下层中间方块的上方；然后左手抓住下层最左边的方块，将其居中放在下层最左边的方块上。
用右手抓住最右边的下层红砖，垂直提起，并将其居中放在中间和右边下层砖之间的接缝上。松开砖块，形成第一层上层单元。将左手移到最左边的下层红砖上，垂直提起，并将其居中放在左边和中间下层砖之间的接缝上。放下并松开，完成由五块砖组成的两行错位墙结构。
将下层砖块并排放置在上层砖块错开堆叠在接缝上。

en: Place two red rectangles vertically on a horizontal row composed of three red squares to form a two-layer wall structure.

Grasp the red block at the bottom layer's far right with your right hand and place it vertically on the middle bottom layer block; then grasp the red block at the bottom layer's far left with your left hand and place it vertically on the bottom layer block at the far left.

Reach with your right hand to the red block at the lower right corner of the arrangement, grasp its top surface, lift it vertically, then place it on the block in the middle of the bottom layer to form the first upper layer block. Withdraw your right hand. Reach with your left hand to the red block at the left end of the bottom layer, grasp its top surface, lift it vertically, then place it on the block at the far left of the bottom layer to complete the second upper layer block. Before releasing contact, slightly adjust the two upper layer blocks to align them.
Place two red rectangles vertically on a horizontal row composed of three red squares.
zh: 将两个红色长方块垂直放置在一个由三个红色方块组成的水平行上，形成一个两层的墙结构。
右手抓住底层最右边的红色方块，并竖直放在中间的底层方块上；然后左手抓住底层最左边的红色方块，并竖直放在最左边的底层方块上。
用右手伸向排列中右下角的红色方块，抓住其顶面，垂直提起，然后将其放在底层中间的方块上，形成第一个上层方块。收回右手。用左手伸向底部左端的红色方块，抓住其顶面，垂直提起，然后将其放在底层最左边的方块上，完成第二个上层方块。在松开接触前，稍微调整两个上层方块使其对齐。
将两个红色长方块垂直放置在一个由三个红色方块组成的水平行上。

en: Close the book.
Close the books on the table with your right hand.
Pick up the book from the left side with your right hand and close it.
zh: 将书合起来。
将桌子上的书用右手合起来。
右手从书的左边夹起，将书合上。

en: Close the book on the left.
Close the book on the left with your left hand.
zh: 把左边的书合上。
左手把左边的书合上。

en: Close the notebook.
Close the notebook with your left hand.
zh: 把笔记本合起来。
左手把笔记本合上。

en: Close the book.
Close the book on the table with your right hand.
zh: 把书合上。
用右手把桌上的书合上。

en: Close the notebook.
Rotate the loose-leaf book on the table clockwise and drag it to the edge of the table, then close it upwards.
Rotate the loose-leaf book on the table clockwise with your left hand and pull it to the edge of the table, then close it upwards.
zh: 把笔记本合上。
把桌上的活页本顺时针旋转并拽到桌边，再将其往上合上。
左手把桌上的活页本顺时针旋转并拽到桌边，再将其往上合上。

en: Close the book.
Close the book with your right hand.
Close the book on the desktop with your right hand.
zh: 把书合上。
用右手把书合上。
将桌面上的书用右手合上。

en: Close the book.
Close the books on the table with your right hand.
zh: 把书合上。
用右手把桌子上的书本合上。

en: Close the book.
Close the book with your left hand.
zh: 把书合上。
用左手把书合上。

en: Close the notebook.
Close the notebook on your left front.
Close the notebook on your left front with your left hand.
zh: 把笔记本合上。
把你左前方的笔记本合上。
左手把你左前方的笔记本合上。

en: Close the notebook.
Pull the loose-leaf book to the lower left of the edge with your left hand, and then close it towards the tea bag
zh: 把笔记本合上。
左手把活页本往左下方拽到桌边，再将其往茶包方向合上

en: Fasten the notebook.
Close the notebook with your left hand
zh: 扣上笔记本。
用左手把的笔记本合上

en: Close the notebook.
Close the notebook with your left hand.
Close the notebook on the desktop with your left hand.
zh: 把笔记本合上。
左手把笔记本合上。
左手把桌面上的笔记本合上。

en: Close the laptop.
Reach with your left hand to the top edge of the open silver laptop in the center of the grid table, and push the screen down to close it.
zh: 合上笔记本电脑。
左手够向格子桌中央一台打开的银色笔记本电脑的上沿，并向下推屏幕将其合上。

en: Close the laptop lid.
Use your left hand to close the laptop cover in the middle of the table.
zh: 把笔记本电脑盖合上。
用左手把桌子中间的笔记本电脑盖扣上。

en: Close the laptop.
Close the laptop on the table.
Close the laptop on the table with your left hand.
zh: 合上电脑。
把桌子上的电脑合上。
左手合上桌子上的电脑。

en: Close the laptop.
Close the laptop with your left hand.
Use your left hand to close the laptop on the table.
zh: 合上笔记本电脑。
左手合上笔记本电脑。
用你的左手将桌面上的笔记本电脑合上。

en: Close the computer.
Close the computer with your left hand.
Close the open computer on the table with your left hand.
zh: 合上电脑。
左手合上电脑。
左手合上桌子上打开的电脑。

en: Close the silver-white laptop.
Close the silver laptop on the desk.
Close the silver-white laptop on the table with your left hand.
zh: 合上银白色电脑。
合上桌上的银白色电脑。
左手合上桌上的银白色电脑。

en: Close the open laptop.
Close the open laptop with your left hand.
Use your left hand to close the open laptop on the desk.
zh: 把开着的电脑合上。
左手把开着的电脑合上。
用你的左手把桌面上开着的电脑合上。

en: Close the computer.
Close the computer with your left hand.
zh: 把电脑合上。
左手把电脑合上。

en: Close the computer on the left.
Close the computer on the left with your left hand.
zh: 把左手边的电脑合上。
用左手将左边的电脑合上。

en: Close the computer that is open to the lower left.
Slowly close the computer that is open to the lower left with your left hand.
Slowly close the computer that opens towards the lower left corner of the table with your left hand.
zh: 把朝左下方打开的电脑合上。
左手慢慢地把朝左下方打开的电脑合上。
用左手慢慢地把朝桌子左下方打开的电脑合上。

en: Close the open laptop.
Grasp the upper edge of the open silver laptop with your right hand and push the screen down until it is fully closed.
zh: 合上打开的笔记本电脑。
右手抓住打开的银色笔记本电脑的上沿，并向下推屏幕，直到其完全合上。

en: Close the computer on the blue desktop.
Close the computer on the blue desktop with your left hand.
zh: 把蓝色桌面上的电脑合上。
左手把蓝色桌面上的电脑合上。

en: Fold the black laptop cooling stand into a compact storage position.

Hold the adjustable black laptop cooling stand in the center of the blue work area with your right hand. Push the side rods inward to fold the X-shaped frame into a compact parallel structure for storage.
zh: 将黑色笔记本电脑散热支架折叠至紧凑的收纳状态。
右手握住蓝色工作区中央的可调节黑色笔记本电脑散热支架。向内推动侧杆，将X型架折叠成紧凑的平行结构以便收纳。

en: Fold the black laptop cooling stand on the blue surface into a compact storage state.
By contracting the external stand, operate the black laptop cooling stand in the center of the blue table with your right hand. Close the X-shaped frame into a compact rectangle for storage.
zh: 将蓝色表面上的黑色笔记本电脑散热支架折叠成紧凑的收纳状态。
通过收缩外部支架，右手操作蓝色桌子中央的黑色笔记本电脑散热支架。将X型框架合拢成紧凑的长方形，以便收纳。

en: On the blue desktop, fold the open laptop cooling stand from the open state to a compact state.
Fold the black laptop cooling stand located in the center of the blue table. Hold the side rail with your right hand and push it inward until the bracket folds into a narrow and compact rectangle.
zh: 在蓝色桌面上将打开的笔记本电脑散热支架从打开状态折叠成紧凑状态。
折叠位于蓝色桌子中央的黑色笔记本电脑散热支架。右手握住侧轨并向内推，直到支架折叠成一个狭窄、紧凑的长方形。

en: Fold the laptop cooling stand on the blue table.
Push the parallel legs of the stand together with both hands and fold the black laptop cooling stand located in the center of the desktop into a compact storage state.
zh: 在蓝色桌子上折叠笔记本电脑散热支架。
双手将平行支架腿推拢，将位于桌面中央的黑色笔记本电脑散热支架折叠成紧凑的收纳状态。

en: Fold the adjustable laptop heat sink into a compact state.
Operate the black laptop cooling stand located in the center of the blue table with both hands and fold its frame by closing the two main vertical pillars together.
zh: 将可调节笔记本电脑散热支架折叠成紧凑状态。
双手操作位于蓝色桌子中央的黑色笔记本电脑散热支架，通过将两个主垂直支柱合拢来折叠其框架。

en: On the blue surface, fold the laptop's heat sink into a compact state.
Fold up the black laptop cooling stand in the center of the blue desktop. Push the adjustable bracket arm inward with both hands until the frame becomes a compact rectangular whole.
zh: 在蓝色表面上，将笔记本电脑散热支架折叠成紧凑状态。
将蓝色桌面中央的黑色笔记本电脑散热支架折叠起来。双手向内推动可调节支架臂，直到框架变成一个紧凑的矩形整体。

en: On the blue surface, fold an adjustable black laptop cooling stand into a compact whole.
Adjust the guide rails and support legs of the black laptop cooling stand located in the center of the blue desktop with both hands to fold its frame into a compact whole.
zh: 在蓝色表面上，将一个可调节的黑色笔记本电脑散热支架折叠成紧凑的整体。
双手调节位于蓝色桌面中央的黑色笔记本散热支架的导轨和支撑腿，将其框架折叠成一个紧凑的整体。

en: Fold a black laptop cooling stand on the table.
Reach your right hand towards the black laptop cooling stand in the center of the table and push the side stand inward with both hands to fold it into a compact whole.
zh: 在桌上折叠一个黑色的笔记本电脑散热支架。
右手够向桌子中央的黑色笔记本电脑散热支架，并用双手向内推动侧支架，将其折叠成紧凑的整体。

en: Fold the black laptop cooling stand located in the center of the desktop into a compact state.

Operate the black adjustable laptop cooling stand located in the center of the work area with both hands. Push both sides inward to fold the X-shaped frame until it closes into a long and narrow whole.
zh: 将位于桌面中央的黑色笔记本电脑散热支架折叠至紧凑状态。
双手操作位于工作区中央的黑色可调节笔记本电脑散热支架，通过向内推压两侧使 X 形框架折叠，直至其合拢成一个狭长的整体。

en: On the desktop, fold a black laptop cooling stand into a compact state.
Operate the black laptop cooling stand on the table with both hands. Move the adjustable side arms inward until the frame is fully folded and vertically aligned in a compact state.
zh: 在桌面上，将一个黑色的笔记本电脑散热支架折叠成紧凑状态。
双手操作位于桌子上的黑色笔记本电脑散热支架。将可调节侧臂向内移动，直到框架完全折叠，并以紧凑的状态垂直对齐。

en: Folding notebook heat dissipation stand.
Push both sides inward with both hands until they are closed, then fold the black laptop cooling stand.
zh: 折叠笔记本散热支架。
双手向内推压两侧直至收拢，折叠黑色笔记本电脑散热支架。

en: Fold the adjustable laptop heat sink into a compact shape.
Fold up the black-gray adjustable laptop cooling stand located in the center of the desktop with both hands.
zh: 将可调节笔记本电脑散热支架折叠成紧凑形态。
双手将位于桌面中央的黑灰色可调节笔记本电脑散热支架折叠收起。

en: Put the toothpaste cap back on.

Hold the tube body with your left hand. Move your right hand towards the white cover at the end of the pipe. Press the lid with the edge of your right palm to make it fit into the mouth of the toothpaste tube. Loosen the lid and the toothpaste tube. Bring your hands back to the resting position.
zh: 盖上牙膏盖。
用左手握住管身。将右手移向管末端的白色盖子。用右手手掌边缘按压盖子使盖子扣到牙膏管管口。松开盖子和牙膏管。将双手收回到休息位置。

en: Close the toothpaste cap.

Reach for the blue and white toothpaste tube in the center of the blue table with your right hand and pick it up. Move your left hand towards the white cap at the end of the toothpaste tube. Press the white toothpaste cap with the palm of your left hand to close it. Loosen the lid and the toothpaste tube, and put the toothpaste tube back on the table.
zh: 关闭牙膏盖。
用右手伸向蓝色桌子中央的蓝白相间牙膏管并将其拿起。将左手移向牙膏管末端的白色盖子。用左手手掌按压白色牙膏盖子将牙膏盖子合上。松开盖子和牙膏管，将牙膏管放回桌面。

en: Put the toothpaste cap back on.

Pick up the white cap of the blue and white toothpaste tube located between the black keyboard and the yellow bottle with your right hand. Reach out your left hand towards the tube of the toothpaste. Hold the tube body with your right hand and close the lid with your left hand. Release the toothpaste tube with your left hand and withdraw both hands to the corner at the bottom of the picture.
zh: 盖上牙膏盖。
右手拿起位于黑色键盘和黄色瓶子之间的蓝白相间牙膏管的白色盖子。左手伸向牙膏管身。右手握住管身，左手合上盖子。左手松开牙膏管，将双手撤回至画面下方的角落。

en: Close the toothpaste cap.
Pick up the toothpaste from the blue table with the right hand, close the white toothpaste cap with the left hand, and release the hand to put the toothpaste tube back on the table.
zh: 合上牙膏盖。
右手从蓝色桌子上拿起牙膏，左手合上白色牙膏盖，松手将牙膏管放回桌上。

en: Close the toothpaste cap.
Pick up the blue and white toothpaste tube from the table with your left hand, screw the white cap back on with your right hand, and then put it back in its original place.
zh: 关闭牙膏盖。
用左手从桌上拿起蓝白相间的牙膏管，用右手将白色盖子合上，然后将其放回原处。

en: Close the toothpaste cap.

The blue and white toothpaste tube located between the brownish notebook and the yellow bottle on the blue table. Hold the tube body with your left hand. Move your right hand to grasp the white cap at the end of the toothpaste tube. Hold the lid firmly with your left hand while closing it. Loosen the toothpaste tube and bring your hands back to the sides of the table.
zh: 关闭牙膏盖。
靠近蓝色桌子上位于棕褐色笔记本和黄色瓶子之间的蓝白相间牙膏管。用左手握住管身。移动右手抓取牙膏管末端的白色盖子。左手保持稳固握持，同时将盖子合上。松开牙膏管，将双手收回到桌子两侧。

en: Pick up a tube of toothpaste and put the lid on.

Take the blue and white toothpaste tube at the lower left corner of the blue table with your left hand. Hold the tube body with your left hand. Move your right hand towards the white cap at the pipe opening and press it with your palm to close the white cap. Loosen the toothpaste tube and move your hands to the sides of the table.
zh: 拿起一支牙膏并盖上盖子。
左手拿取蓝色桌子左下方的蓝白相间牙膏管。用左手握住管身。将右手移向管口处的白色盖子并用手掌按压使白色盖子合上。松开牙膏管，将双手移开至桌子两侧。

en: Put the cap back on the toothpaste.

Pick up the purple-white toothpaste at the bottom of the blue-green wet tissue box with your right hand, then push the toothpaste cap down with your left index finger and press it firmly with your palm. Finally, place the toothpaste in front of the cookie box.
zh: 把牙膏的盖子盖上。
右手拿起蓝绿色湿纸巾盒下方的紫白色相间的牙膏，再用左手的食指将牙膏盖子向下推并用手掌按紧，最后将牙膏放在饼干盒的前方。

en: Close the toothpaste cap.

Reach for the blue and white toothpaste tube on the blue table with your right hand and pick it up. Press the white cap on the toothpaste tube with your left hand and close it. After the lid is fully closed, place the covered toothpaste tube back on the table.
zh: 合上牙膏盖。
用右手伸向蓝色桌子上的蓝白色相间牙膏管并将其拿起。用左手按压牙膏管上的白色盖子，将盖子合上。盖子完全合上后，将盖好的牙膏管放回桌面。

en: Put the cap back on the toothpaste and place the toothpaste tube back on the table.

Pick up the blue and white toothpaste tube from the center of the blue table. Hold the tube with your right hand and close the white cap with your left hand. Place the toothpaste tube back on the table.
zh: 盖上牙膏盖，将牙膏管放回桌上。
从蓝色桌子中央拿起蓝白相间的牙膏管。用右手握住管身，左手合上白色盖子。将牙膏管放回桌面。

en: Close the toothpaste cap.

Pick up the purple and white striped toothpaste at the lower right corner of the blue table with your right hand, then push the cap of the toothpaste down with your left index finger and press it firmly with your palm. Finally, place the toothpaste in front of the earphone case and move your hands away.
zh: 关闭牙膏盖。
右手拿起蓝色桌子右下方的紫白色相间牙膏，再用左手的食指向下推牙膏的盖子并用手掌按紧，最后将牙膏放在耳机盒的前方，将双手移开。

en: Cover with the cap of the purple toothpaste.

Pick up the purple toothpaste on the blue table with your right hand, then push the cap down with your left index finger and press it firmly with your palm. Finally, place the toothpaste in front of the blue wet tissue box.
zh: 盖上紫色牙膏的盖子。
右手拿起蓝色桌子上的紫色牙膏，再用左手的食指把牙膏的盖子向下推并用手掌按紧，最后将牙膏放在蓝色湿纸巾盒的前方。

en: Cover the lid of the white trash can
The white rectangular trash can is located on the blue table, with its lid initially open upwards. Move your right hand from below, touch the edge of the lid, and press it down to close it tightly.

Move your right hand from below towards the trash can lid and touch it close to it. Apply downward pressure to move the lid down until it fully adheres to the bucket body. Once the lid is flat and stable, stop the contact. The left hand remains still throughout the process, with the palm facing down on the left side of the table, away from all objects.
zh: 盖上白色垃圾桶的盖子
白色长方形垃圾桶位于蓝色桌面上，其盖子最初朝上打开；右手从下方靠近，接触到盖子的边缘，并向下按压以将其盖紧。
将右手从下方移向垃圾桶盖，接触靠近盖子。施加向下的压力，使盖子向下移到直到完全贴合桶身。一旦盖子平整且稳定，就停止接触。左手在整个过程中保持静止，手掌向下放在桌子左侧，远离所有物体。

en: Close the white rectangular trash bin with a hinged lid using your left hand.
Open the lid of the white rectangular trash can upward initially; approach with your left hand from below, touch the edge of the lid, and press down to secure it tightly.

Move your left hand from the left side toward the opening lid of the white trash bin. Grasp the edge of the lid near the hinge. Push the lid down with a controlled arc until it contacts the edge. Maintain pressure to ensure it is fully closed while keeping your right hand on the tabletop surface without touching it.
zh: 用左手关闭带铰链盖的白色矩形垃圾桶。
白色长方形垃圾桶其盖子最初朝上打开；左手从下方靠近，接触到盖子的边缘，并向下按压以将其盖紧。
从左侧向白色垃圾桶的开口盖子移动左手。抓住靠近铰链的盖子边缘。以受控的弧度将盖子向下推，直到接触边缘。保持压力以确保完全关闭，同时右手保持在桌面表面而不接触。

en: Cover the white trash bin with the lid.
The white rectangular trash can is located on the desktop, with its lid initially open upwards. Move your right hand from below, touch the edge of the lid, and press it down to close it tightly.

Move your right hand from below towards the lid of the trash can and touch the edge close to it. Apply downward pressure to move the lid down until it fully adheres to the bucket body. Once the lid is flat and stable, stop the contact. The left hand remains still throughout the process, with the palm facing down on the left side of the table, away from all objects.
zh: 盖上白色垃圾桶的盖子
白色长方形垃圾桶位于桌面上，其盖子最初朝上打开；右手从下方靠近，接触到盖子的边缘，并向下按压以将其盖紧。
将右手从下方移向垃圾桶盖，接触靠近盖缘。施加向下的压力，使盖子向下移到直到完全贴合桶身。一旦盖子平整且稳定，就停止接触。左手在整个过程中保持静止，手掌向下放在桌子左侧，远离所有物体。

en: Close the white trash bin with the hinged lid using your right hand, and keep your left hand still.

Place the white rectangular trash bin to the right of the blue table, with the lid open facing upward; approach from the right side with your right hand, touch the edge of the lid near the hinge, and push it downward until it is completely closed.

Move your right hand toward the open lid of the white trash bin on the right side of the table. Grasp the edge of the lid near the hinge axis. Apply downward pressure to rotate the lid clockwise around the hinge. Maintain contact until the lid fits completely against the bin body. Release the lid after confirming it is closed. Keep your left hand stationary on the left side throughout the entire process.
zh: 用右手关闭带铰链盖的白色垃圾桶，左手保持静止。
白色的长方形垃圾桶位于蓝色桌子的右侧，盖子朝上打开；右手从右侧靠近，接触到盖子靠近铰链的边缘，并将其向下推直到完全关闭。
将右手移向桌子右侧白色垃圾桶的开启盖子。抓住盖子靠近铰链轴的边缘。施加向下压力，使盖子围绕铰链顺时针旋转。保持接触直到盖子与桶体完全贴合。确认关闭后松开盖子。整个过程中左手保持静止在左侧。

en: Close the lid of the white rectangular trash can located to the right of the blue desk.
Approach the right edge of the white trash bin lid from the right side with your right hand, touch the edge near the hinge, and apply downward pressure to secure the lid tightly.

Move your right hand toward the opening lid of the white trash can on the right side of the blue table. Grasp the edge of the lid near the hinge point. Press down firmly until the lid is completely closed and clicks into place. After confirming the closure, pull your hand out horizontally to the right.
zh: 关闭位于蓝色桌子右侧的白色长方形垃圾桶的盖子。
右手从右侧边缘靠近，接触到白色垃圾箱盖子靠近铰链处的边缘，并施加向下的压力将其盖紧。
将右手移向蓝色桌子右侧的白色垃圾桶的开口盖子。抓住靠近铰链点的盖子边缘。用力向下压，直到盖子完全关闭并咔嗒一声固定。确认关闭后，将手水平向右抽出。

en: Cover the white trash can lid with your right hand, while keeping your left hand idle.

Place the white rectangular trash bin to the right of the blue table with the lid open upwards; approach from the right side with your right hand, touch the edge of the lid, and press down to close it tightly.

Move your right hand toward the opening lid of the white trash bin on the right half of the blue table. Touch the edge of the lid near the hinge side. Press the lid downward with a controlled arc until it snaps onto the bin body. Hold contact for a moment to ensure it is closed, then withdraw your right hand. Keep your left hand still throughout the process, close to the left edge of the table.
zh: 用右手盖上白色垃圾桶的盖子，而左手保持闲置。
白色长方形垃圾桶位于蓝色桌子的右侧，盖子朝上打开；右手从右侧靠近，接触到盖子的边缘，并向下施压以将其盖紧。
将右手移向蓝色桌子右侧半部分的白色垃圾桶的开口盖子。接触盖子靠近铰链侧的边缘。以受控的弧度将盖子向下按，直到它弹合到桶体上。保持接触片刻以确保关闭，然后收回右手。左手在整个过程中保持静止，靠近桌子的左侧边缘。

en: Cover the lid of the white trash can with your right hand, while leaving your left hand idle.
Approach the white rectangular trash bin from below with your right hand, touch the edge of the lid, and press down to close it tightly.

Move your right hand toward the opening lid of the white trash bin on the right side of the table. Touch the edge of the lid near the hinge with your palm and fingers. Apply downward pressure, rotating the lid clockwise until it fits completely with the bin body. Release contact after fully closing, allowing the lid to close completely and remain steady.
zh: 用右手盖上白色垃圾桶的盖子，而左手保持闲置。
右手从下方靠近白色长方形垃圾桶，接触到盖子的边缘，并向下按压以将其盖紧。
将右手移向桌子右侧白色垃圾桶的开口盖。用手掌和手指接触盖子靠近铰链的边缘。施加向下压力，使盖子顺时针旋转直到与桶身完全贴合。完全关闭后松开接触，使盖子完全关闭并保持静止。

en: Cover the white trash can lid with your right hand, while keeping your left hand idle.

Place the white rectangular trash bin to the right side of the blue table, with the hinged lid open; approach with your right hand from the right side, touch the edge of the lid, and push it downward to close the opening.

Move your right hand toward the opening lid of the white trash bin at the right edge of the blue table. Touch the edge of the lid with your palm and fingers. Press the lid downward in a smooth arc until it clicks and locks onto the base. Keep your left hand still throughout the process, positioned near the left edge of the table without touching any objects.
zh: 用右手盖上白色垃圾桶的盖子，而左手保持闲置。
白色长方形的垃圾桶位于蓝色桌子的右侧，桶盖是打开的铰链式盖子；右手从右侧靠近，接触到盖子的边缘，并向下推动以封闭开口。
将右手移向蓝色桌子右侧边缘的白色垃圾桶的开口盖子。用手掌和手指接触盖子的边缘。以平滑的弧线将盖子向下压，直到它咔嗒一声扣紧在底部。左手在整个过程中保持静止，靠近桌子的左侧边缘，不与任何物体接触。

en: Close the white trash can with the hinged lid using your right hand, and keep your left hand stationary on the table.
Approach the white rectangular trash bin from below with your right hand, touch the edge of the lid, and press down to close it tightly.

Move your right hand from the right side of the frame toward the trash can lid, position it above the edge near the hinge, press down firmly to rotate the lid closed, and maintain contact until the lid locks into place; keep your left hand stationary on the table throughout the process.
zh: 用右手关闭带铰链盖的白色垃圾桶，左手保持在桌面上不动。
右手从下方靠近白色长方形垃圾桶，接触到盖子的边缘，并向下按压以将其盖紧。
将右手从框架右侧移向垃圾桶盖，将其定位在靠近铰链的边缘上方，用力向下压以旋转盖子关闭，保持接触直到盖子进入锁定位置；左手在整个过程中停留在桌面不动。

en: Cover the lid of the white trash bin with your right hand, while keeping your left hand idle.

Place the white rectangular trash bin to the right side of the blue table, with its hinged lid opened upwards; extend your right hand from the right side, touch the edge of the lid, and press it down to close the container.

Move your right hand toward the open lid of the white trash bin on the right half of the blue table. Touch the edge of the lid near the hinge with your palm and fingers. Apply downward pressure to rotate the lid clockwise until it fits completely against the bin. Release contact after the lid is fully closed. Keep your left hand stationary near the left edge of the table throughout the entire process.
zh: 用右手盖上白色垃圾桶的盖子，而左手保持闲置。
白色的长方形垃圾桶位于蓝色桌子的右侧，其铰链盖向上打开；右手从右侧伸出，接触盖子的边缘，并将其压下以封闭容器。
将右手移向蓝色桌子右侧半部分的白色垃圾桶的开口盖子。用手掌和手指接触盖子靠近铰链的边缘。施加向下压力，使盖子顺时针旋转直到与桶身完全贴合。盖子完全关闭后松开接触。在整个过程中，左手始终静止在桌子左侧边缘附近。

en: Cover the white trash can with the lid using your right hand, while keeping your left hand idle.
Place the white rectangular trash bin to the right of the blue table, with its hinged lid opened upwards; approach from below with your right hand and touch the edge of the lid near the hinge.

Move your right hand toward the opening lid of the white trash bin on the right side of the table. Grasp the lid near the hinge edge. Push the lid downward with a controlled arc until the lid fits completely against the bin body. Release contact after the lid is fully closed. Keep your left hand still throughout the process, positioned near the left edge of the table without touching any objects.
zh: 用右手盖上白色垃圾桶的盖子，而左手保持闲置。
白色的长方形垃圾桶位于蓝色桌子的右侧，其铰链盖向上打开；右手从下方接近，并与盖子靠近铰链的边缘接触。
将右手移向桌子右侧白色垃圾桶的开口盖子。抓住盖子靠近铰链的边缘。以受控的弧度将盖子向下推动，直到盖子与桶体完全贴合。在盖子完全关闭后松开接触。整个过程中左手保持静止，位于桌子左侧边缘附近，不接触任何物体。

en: Close the white rectangular trash can with a hinged lid with your right hand, and keep your left hand still.
Move your right hand from below and touch the edge of the lid near the hinge. And press down to close the lid

Move your right hand towards the opening cover of the white trash can on the right side of the blue table. Grasp the edge of the lid near the hinge point. Apply downward pressure to rotate the lid until it fully adheres to the bucket opening. Once the lid is fully closed and stable, stop the contact. Keep your left hand idle throughout the process, close to the left edge of the table.
zh: 用右手关闭带铰链盖子的白色长方形垃圾桶，左手保持静止。
右手从下方靠近，接触盖子靠近铰链的边缘。并向下按压将盖子关闭
将右手移向位于蓝色桌子右侧的白色垃圾桶的开口盖。抓住盖子靠近铰链点的边缘。施加向下压力，使盖子旋转直到与桶口完全贴合。一旦盖子完全关闭并稳定，就停止接触。左手在整个过程中保持闲置，靠近桌子的左侧边缘。

task_name: Connect the Data Cable to the Charger

en: Insert data cable into charger.
Grasp the white charger block with the left hand and align the white data cable connector with its port using the right hand.

Grasp the white charger block with the left hand. Grasp the white data cable with the right hand. Move the data cable towards the charger. Align the cable connector with the port on the charger. Push the cable into the port to connect them. Release the data cable from the right hand.
zh: 将数据线插入充电器中。
用左手抓住白色充电块，用右手将白色数据线连接器对准接口。
用左手抓住白色充电块。用右手抓住白色数据线。将数据线朝充电器移动。将数据线的插头对准充电器上的接口。将数据线插入接口以连接它们。松开右手的数据线。

task_name: Connect the Data Cable to the Charger

en: Insert the data cable into the charger.
Hold the white charger with the left hand and grasp the data cable with the right hand to insert it into the charger.

Reach toward the data cable on the table with the right hand. Grasp the data cable. Move the data cable toward the white charger held by the left hand. Insert the data cable into the charger. Release the data cable.
zh: 将数据线插入充电器中。
用左手握住白色充电器，右手抓住数据线，将其插入充电器中。
右手伸向桌上的数据线。抓住数据线。将数据线移到左手拿着的白色充电器上。将数据线插入充电器中。松开数据线。

task_name: Connect the Data Cable to the Charger

en: Insert the data cable into the charger.
Grasp the charger with the left hand and the data cable connector with the right hand. Align the connector with the charger port and push it in to establish a connection.

用右手伸向桌面右侧，用食指按住牌堆右侧最上方纸牌，按住后向牌堆右侧拖动到指定位置，随后松开右手。再次伸出右手用食指按住牌堆右侧最上方纸牌将其向牌堆前方拖动到指定位置，随后松开右手。

en: Strip the cards from the deck.
Extend your right hand to the right side of the table and draw two cards from the deck.
zh: 从牌堆中剥离纸牌。
用右手伸向桌面右侧从牌堆中抽出两张纸牌。

en: Strip the cards from the deck.
Extend your right hand to the right side of the table and strip two cards from the deck.
zh: 从牌堆中剥离纸牌。
用右手伸向桌面右侧从牌堆中剥离两张纸牌。

en: Strip the cards from the deck.
Extend your right hand to the right side of the table and strip two cards from the deck.

Extend your right hand to the right side of the table, hold down the top card on the right side of the card pile with your index finger, then drag it to the designated position on the right side of the card pile, and then release your right hand. Extend your right hand again, hold the topmost card on the right side of the stack with your index finger, and drag it forward to the designated position in the stack. Then release your right hand.
zh: 从牌堆中剥离纸牌。
用右手伸向桌面右侧从牌堆中剥离两张纸牌。
用右手伸向桌面右侧，用食指按住牌堆右侧最上方纸牌，按住后向牌堆右侧拖动到指定位置，随后松开右手。再次伸出右手用食指按住牌堆右侧最上方纸牌将其向牌堆前方拖动到指定位置，随后松开右手。

en: Strip the cards from the deck.
Extend your right hand to the right side of the table and strip two cards from the deck.

Extend your right hand to the right side of the table, hold down the top card on the right side of the card pile with your index finger, then drag it to the designated position on the right side of the card pile, and then release your right hand. Extend your right hand again, hold the topmost card on the right side of the stack with your index finger, and drag it forward to the designated position in the stack. Then release your right hand.
zh: 从牌堆中剥离纸牌。
用右手伸向桌面右侧从牌堆中剥离两张纸牌。
用右手伸向桌面右侧，用食指按住牌堆右侧最上方纸牌，按住后向牌堆右侧拖动到指定位置，随后松开右手。再次伸出右手用食指按住牌堆右侧最上方纸牌将其向牌堆前方拖动到指定位置，随后松开右手。

task_name: Divide the Cards into Three Stacks

en: Divide the cards into three stacks.
Separate the cards from the central pile with your right hand, and then organize them into three different groups on the table.

Reach out to the pile of cards with your right hand, grab the top card and lift it out of the pile. Place this card on the table to form a separate pile of cards. Return to the remaining deck of cards, grab the next card and place it beside the first one. The last card is left in place as the third pile.
zh: 把牌分成三叠。
用右手将牌从中央牌堆中分开，然后在桌面上将它们整理成三个不同的组。
用右手伸向牌堆，抓住最上面的一张牌并将其从堆中拿起。将这张牌放在桌上，形成一个单独的牌堆。回到剩下的牌堆前，抓住下一张牌，把它放在第一张牌旁边。最后一张牌留在原处作为第三个牌堆。

task_name: Divide the Cards into Three Stacks

en: Divide the cards into three stacks.
Use your right hand to divide the middle pile of cards into three smaller piles by lifting some of the cards and placing them separately on the blue table.

Extend your right hand towards the middle pile of cards, pick up the upper part of the pile and place it above the remaining piles to form two piles. Return to the remaining pile of cards, then pick up the upper part and place it on the right to form the third pile.
zh: 把牌分成三叠。
用右手将中间的牌堆分成三叠较小的牌堆，方法是抬起部分牌并将其分开放在蓝色桌面上。
用右手伸向中间的牌堆，拿起牌堆的上半部分，放在剩下的牌堆上方，形成两堆。回到剩下的牌堆，再拿起上半部分，放到右边，形成第三堆。

task_name: Divide the Cards into Three Stacks

en: Divide the cards into three stacks.
Divide the pink pattern card in the center of the blue table into three piles with your right hand.
Extend your right hand towards the central pile of cards, grasp the cards and divide the pile into two stacks. Move a part of one stack to one side to form the third stack.
zh: 把牌分成三叠。
用右手将蓝色桌面中央的粉色图案牌分成三堆。
右手伸向中央的牌堆，抓住牌，将牌堆分成两叠。将其中一叠的一部分移到一边，形成第三叠。

task_name: Divide the Cards into Three Stacks

en: Divide the stack of cards into three separate stacks.
Extend your right hand towards the middle pile of cards, separate the upper part from the lower one, and then repeat this process to form three different piles of cards on the table.

Stretch your right hand towards the center of the pile of cards. Pick up the upper part of the card pile and place it in the upper right corner. Return to the remaining stack of cards, pick up the upper part again and place it in the lower right corner.
zh: 将牌堆分成三叠独立的牌。
用右手伸向中间的牌堆，将上面的部分与下面分开，然后重复这个过程，在桌面上形成三个不同的牌堆。
用右手伸向牌堆的中央。拿起牌堆的上部分，放到右上方。回到剩下的牌堆，再次拿起上部分，放到右下方。

task_name: Divide the Cards into Three Stacks

en: Divide the stack of cards into three separate stacks.
Grasp the middle pile of cards with your right hand, and then divide them into three different stacks and stack them on the table.

Reach out your right hand towards the pile of cards, grasp the lower half and move it down to separate them. Return to the remaining upper half, grab the right side and move to the right to form a new deck. The remaining left part serves as the third pile.
zh: 将牌堆分成三叠独立的牌。
用右手抓住中间的牌堆，然后将它们分成三叠不同的牌堆放在桌面上。
用右手伸向牌堆，抓住下面一半并向下移动以分开。回到剩下的上半部分，抓住右侧并向右移动形成一个新的牌堆。剩下的左侧部分作为第三堆。

task_name: Divide the Cards into Three Stacks

en: Divide the stack of cards into three stacks.
Pick up several cards from the central pile with your right hand and place them on the right side of the table, dividing them into distinct piles.

Reach out your right hand towards the middle pile of cards, grab some of them and slide them to the right. Return to the remaining middle pile of cards, then grab another part and place it beside the first stack of cards. The remaining cards are left in the middle as the third stack.
zh: 将牌堆分成三叠。
用右手拿起中央牌堆的若干张牌，将它们放到桌子右侧，分成明显的堆。
用右手伸向中间的牌堆，抓起一部分牌，向右滑动。回到剩下的中间牌堆，再抓起另一部分，放在第一叠牌的旁边。剩下的牌留在中间作为第三叠。

task_name: Divide the Cards into Three Stacks

en: Divide the cards into three stacks.
Divide a middle deck of cards into three stacks with your right hand.

Extend your right hand towards the center of the card pile, grasp the upper half of the pile and lift it up. Place the lifted part on top of the remaining cards to form a second pile. Return to the remaining lower deck of cards, grab a small part of the top, move it to the right, and complete the operation of dividing it into three decks.
zh: 将牌分成三叠。
用右手将一副中间的牌分成三叠。
用右手伸向牌堆的中央，抓住牌堆的上半部分并将其抬起。将抬起的部分放在剩下的牌上面，形成第二个牌堆。回到剩下的下层牌堆，抓住其顶部的一小部分，将其向右移动，完成分成三个牌堆的操作。

task_name: Divide the Cards into Three Stacks

en: Divide the cards into three stacks.
Divide the middle pile of cards into three stacks with your right hand, and lift some of the cards and place them on the right side.

Extend your right hand towards the central part of the card pile, grasp the top stack of cards and lift it up, then place this stack on the right to form the first stack of new cards. Return to the remaining central pile of cards, grab the next part of the cards, move them and place them on the right to complete the process of dividing the cards into three stacks.
zh: 把牌分成三叠。
右手将中间的牌堆分成三叠，通过抬起部分牌并放到右侧。
用右手伸向牌堆的中央部分，抓住堆顶的一叠牌并将其提起，将这一叠放在右边，形成第一叠新的牌。回到剩下的中央牌堆，抓住下一部分的牌，将其移动并放在右边，完成分成三叠牌的过程。

task_name: Divide the Cards into Three Stacks

en: Divide the cards into three stacks.
Use your right hand to take the middle pile of cards, divide the cards into several parts, and then arrange them into three separate piles on the table.

Extend your right hand towards the center of the card pile, separate the top stack of cards and place them in the upper left corner. Then separate the right side of the remaining bottom part and place it on the far right. Keep the middle part to complete the three card piles.
zh: 将牌分成三叠。
用右手去取中间的牌堆，把牌分成几部分，然后在桌面上摆成三个独立的牌堆。
用右手伸向牌堆的中央，将顶部的一叠牌分开并放到左上方。再将剩余底部部分的右侧分开，放到最右边。保留中间部分，以完成三个牌堆。

task_name: Divide the Cards into Three Stacks

en: Divide the pink cards into three piles.
Use your right hand to lift the pink card piles in the middle one by one and place them separately on the table, dividing them into three independent card piles.

Take the middle stack of pink cards with your right hand. Grab the upper part of this stack of cards and take it away. Put the separated cards on the right to form the second pile. Return to the remaining stack of cards, grab the next part, and continue to move to the right to form the third pile.
zh: 把粉红色的卡片分成三堆。
用右手将中间的粉色牌堆依次提起并分开放在桌面上，分成三叠独立的牌堆。
用右手去拿中间那叠粉色卡片。抓住这叠卡片的上半部分，把它拿开。把分开的卡片放到右边，形成第二堆。回到剩下的那叠卡片，抓住下一部分，继续往右移动，形成第三堆。

task_name: Divide the Cards into Three Stacks

en: Divide the cards into three stacks.
Use your right hand to take the middle pile of cards, divide the cards into several parts, and then arrange them into three separate piles on the table.

Extend your right hand towards the center of the card pile, separate the top stack of cards and place them in the upper left corner. Then separate the right side of the remaining bottom part and place it on the far right. Keep the middle part to complete the three card piles.
zh: 将牌分成三叠。
用右手去取中间的牌堆，把牌分成几部分，然后在桌面上摆成三个独立的牌堆。
用右手伸向牌堆的中央，将顶部的一叠牌分开并放到左上方。再将剩余底部部分的右侧分开，放到最右边。保留中间部分，以完成三个牌堆。

task_name: Divide the Cards into Three Stacks

en: Divide the stack of cards into three separate stacks.
Use your right hand to divide the middle pile of cards into three smaller stacks and place them respectively on the table.
Extend your right hand towards the middle pile, separate the top half, and then place it facing up. Return to the remaining pile, separate the top part and set it aside to form three different piles.
zh: 将牌堆分成三叠独立的牌。
用右手将中间的牌堆分成三叠较小的牌，分别放在桌面上。
用右手伸向中间的堆，分开最上面的一半，然后将其朝上放好。回到剩下的那堆，分开最上面的部分，把它放到一旁，形成三个不同的堆。

en: Spread the towel flat on the table.
Pick up the edge of the black and pink towel folded on the green checkered table. Spread it out to both sides until the towel is flat and square in the center of the work area.
zh: 在桌子上铺平毛巾。
拿起绿色格子桌上折叠的黑粉色毛巾的边缘。向两边拉开并铺展，直到毛巾平整且方正地铺在工作区域的中心。

en: Turn over the calendar.
Open the calendar with your left hand.
zh: 翻开日历。
用左手翻开日历。

en: Turn a page of the calendar.
Turn a page of the calendar on the table with your left hand, while keeping your right hand still.
zh: 将日历翻一页。
用左手将桌上的日历翻一页，右手不动。

en: Turn over a page of the calendar.
Turn a page of the calendar on the table with your left hand.
zh: 翻过一页日历。
用左手将桌上的日历翻一页。

en: Turn over the calendar.
Open the calendar on the desktop.
Open the first page of the calendar on the desktop with your left hand.
zh: 翻开日历。
翻开桌面上的日历。
用左手翻开桌面上的日历第一页。

en: Turn a page of the calendar.
Turn the calendar on the desktop to another page.
Turn a page of the calendar on the table with your left hand, while keeping your right hand still.
zh: 将日历翻一页。
把桌面上的日历翻到另一页。
用左手将桌上的日历翻一页，右手不动。

en: Turn a page of the calendar.

zh: 把日历翻一页。
用左手把日历翻开一页。

Turn a page of the calendar on the table with your left hand.
zh: 把日历翻开一页。
用左手把桌上的日历翻开一页。

en: Turn a page of the calendar.
Turn the calendar on the table to the next page with your right hand.
zh: 将日历翻一页。
用右手把桌上的日历翻到下一页。

en: Turn to a page of the calendar.
Turn a page of the calendar with your left hand.
zh: 翻开日历一页。
用左手将日历翻开一页。

en: Turn to a page of the calendar.
Turn a page of the calendar with your left hand.
Stretch your left hand towards the calendar on the table to turn a page.
zh: 翻开一页日历。
用左手将日历翻开一页。
把左手伸向桌上的日历，使其翻开一页。

en: Turn over a page of the calendar.
Use your left hand to turn the calendar on the desktop to a new page.
zh: 翻过日历一页。
使用左手将桌面上的日历翻开新的一页。

en: Change the page of the calendar.
Turn the calendar to a new page with your left hand.
Use your left hand to turn the calendar on the desktop to a new page.
zh: 把日历换一页。
用左手把日历换新一页。
使用左手将桌面的日历翻开新的一页。

en: Flip a white square.
Reach out your left hand towards the white square, grasp it, and then rotate it to flip it over, revealing a new side that displays the number.
Reach out your left hand towards the white square, hold it firmly, and then rotate it to flip the object. Put the square on the desktop.
zh: 翻转一个白色方块。
用左手伸向白色方块，抓住它，然后旋转使其翻转，露出一个新的显示数字的面。
用左手伸向白色方块，牢牢抓住它，然后旋转以翻转物体。将方块放到桌面。

en: Flip this cube marked with numbers.
Grasp the light blue number square on the table with your right hand and rotate it to flip it over to a new face.
Reach out to take the light blue square on the table. Grasp the square with your right hand. Rotate the square to turn it over. Put the square on the desktop.
zh: 翻转这个标有数字的立方体。
用右手抓住桌上的浅蓝色数字方块，旋转它，使其翻转到一个新的面。
伸手去拿桌子上的浅蓝色方块。用右手抓住方块。转动方块将其翻转过来。将方块放到桌面上。

en: Flip this number square.
Rotate the white square on the table with your right hand.

Reach out your right hand towards the white square, grasp the object, and rotate it to flip the square to the other side. Place the square on the table. Grab the square again, rotate it and flip it over once more.
zh: 翻转这个数字方块。
用右手将桌上的白色方块旋转一下。
用右手伸向白色方块，抓住物体，旋转它使方块翻转到另一面。将方块放在桌面上。再次抓住方块，旋转它再翻转一次。

en: Grasp the square on the table with your right hand and rotate it to show different digital faces.
zh: 用右手抓住桌上的方块，并旋转它以展示不同的数字面。

en: Flip this numbered cube.
Grasp the white square marked with numbers with your right hand and rotate it to make different surfaces appear on the blue table surface.
Reach out your right hand towards the white square. Grab the square and lift it slightly. Rotate the square to change its direction. Place the square on the blue surface.
zh: 翻转这个带编号的立方体。
用右手抓住标有数字的白色方块，并旋转它，使不同的面显示在蓝色桌子表面上。
用右手伸向白色方块。抓住方块并稍微提起。旋转方块以改变它的方向。将方块放在蓝色表面上。

en: Flip a digital cube.
Reach out your right hand towards the cube, grasp it, lift and flip it to show a new face, then put it back on the table and repeat the rotation action to display another number.
zh: 翻转一个数字立方体。
用右手伸向立方体，抓住方块，提起并翻转它以显示新的面，然后放回桌子上，重复旋转动作以显示另一个数字。

en: Take the blue number square on the table with your right hand, grasp it, rotate it to show different sides, and then put it back.

Reach out your right hand towards the blue square, grasp it, and then lift it off the surface. Rotate the cube, flip it to a new face, put it back in its original position, and adjust its direction until the correct face is up. After the flip is completed, release the object.
zh: 用右手去拿桌上的蓝色数字方块，抓住它，旋转以展示不同的面，然后再放回去。
用右手伸向蓝色方块，抓住它，然后从表面抬起。旋转方块，将其翻转到一个新的面，放回原处，并调整它的方向，直到正确的面朝上。翻转完成后，释放物体。

en: Reach out to the square with your right hand, grasp it and lift it slightly. Rotate the square and flip it to the side that shows the number 6. Put the square back on the table and rotate it again to make it display the number 4.
zh: 用右手伸向方块，抓住方块并稍微抬起。转动方块，将其翻转到显示数字6的面。将方块放回桌子上，再转动一次，使其显示数字4。

en: Reach out your right hand towards the white square. Hold the square firmly. Lift and rotate the cube to flip its position. Place the square on the surface of the desktop.
zh: 用右手伸向白色方块。牢固地抓住方块。提起并旋转方块，翻转它的位置。将方块放到桌面表面。

en: Grasp the white number square with your right hand and rotate it so that the different sides are displayed upwards on the table.
zh: 用右手抓住白色数字方块，并旋转它，使不同的面朝上展示在桌面上。

en: Flip the blue square.
Grasp the blue-numbered square with your right hand, rotate it to flip it over, and then put it back on the table.
zh: 翻转蓝色的方块。
用右手抓住蓝色编号的方块，旋转它以翻转其方向，然后放回桌面。

en: Flip the white square on the table with your right hand.
Reach out your right hand towards the square, grasp it, rotate it to change the visible surface, and then release.
zh: 用右手将白色方块在桌面上翻转。
用右手伸向方块，抓住它，旋转以改变可见的面，然后松开。

en: Turn the paper cup over and place it on the table.
Take the white paper cup on the left side of the table with your left hand, hold it, turn it over and place it on the table.
zh: 将纸杯翻转过来放在桌子上。
左手拿取桌子左侧的白色纸杯，握住它，并将其翻转过来，放在桌面上。

en: Flip the white paper cup over on the table.
Take the white cup on the right side of the table with your right hand, turn it over and place it on the table.
zh: 在桌面上翻转白色纸杯。
右手拿取桌面右侧的白色杯子，将其翻转后放到桌面上。

en: Turn the paper cup over and place it on the table.
Pick up the white paper cup on the table with your left hand, flip it over and place it on the table.
zh: 把纸杯翻转后放在桌子上。
左手拿起桌面上的白色纸杯，将纸杯进行翻转后放到桌面上。

en: Turn the paper cup upside down on the table.
Pick up the white paper cup with your left hand and turn it upside down onto the table.
zh: 把纸杯倒扣在桌面上。
左手拿起白色的纸杯，将纸杯倒扣到桌面上。

en: Turn the paper cups over on the table.
Pick up the white paper cup on the table with your left hand, lift it up and turn it over, then put it back on the table.
zh: 在桌子上翻转纸杯。
左手拿起桌上的白色纸杯，将其拿起并翻转，然后放回桌面。

en: Turn the paper cup upside down.
Pick up the paper cup on the table with your left hand and turn it over. Then place the reversed paper cup on the table.
zh: 将纸杯进行反转。
左手拿起桌面上的纸杯进行反转，再将反转后的纸杯放到桌面上。

en: Turn the paper cup over and place it on the table.
Pick up the white paper cup with your left hand and turn it upside down onto the table.
zh: 将纸杯翻转过来放在桌子上。
左手拿起白色的纸杯，将纸杯倒扣到桌面上。

en: Turn the paper cup over and place it on the table.
Pick up the white paper cup with your right hand and turn it upside down onto the table.
zh: 把纸杯翻转后放在桌子上。
右手拿起白色的纸杯，将纸杯倒扣到桌面上。

en: Flip the white paper cup over on the table.
Take the white cup on the left side of the table with your left hand, turn it over and place it on the table.
zh: 在桌面上翻转白色纸杯。
左手拿取桌面左侧的白色杯子，将其翻转后放到桌面上。

en: Turn the paper cup upside down on the table.
Pick up the white paper cup on the table with your left hand, lift it up and turn it over, then put it back on the table.
zh: 把纸杯倒扣在桌面上。
左手拿起桌上的白色纸杯，将其拿起并翻转，然后放回桌面。

en: Turn the paper cup over and place it on the table.
Pick up the white paper cup on the table with your left hand, flip it over and place it on the table.
zh: 将纸杯翻转过来放在桌子上。
左手拿起桌面上的白色纸杯，将纸杯进行翻转后放到桌面上。

en: Turn the paper cup over and place it on the table.
Take the white paper cup on the left side of the table with your left hand, turn it over and place it on the tabletop.
zh: 把纸杯翻转后放在桌子上。
左手拿取桌子左侧的白色纸杯，并将其翻转过来，放在桌面上。

en: Turn your phone over.
Reach out your right hand towards the black smartphone on the blue table, grasp its edge, and flip it over to reveal its light-colored back.
Reach out your right hand towards the smartphone facing down on the table, grasp the edge of the phone and rotate it over. Then place the phone on the table with its back facing up.
zh: 把手机翻过来。
用右手伸向蓝色桌子上的黑色智能手机，抓住它的边缘，翻转过来显示出浅色的背面。
用右手伸向桌面上朝下的智能手机，抓住手机边缘并旋转翻转它，然后将手机放在桌面上，使背面朝上。

en: Reach out your right hand towards the light blue phone placed there, grasp the edge, and turn it over so that the screen faces up.
zh: 用右手伸向放在那里的浅蓝色电话，抓住边缘，翻转过来使屏幕朝上。

en: Turn your phone over.
The phone reached out to the table with the right hand. Hold the phone firmly. Turn your wrist to flip the phone over. Put the phone back on the desk.
zh: 把手机翻过来。
用右手伸向桌上的电话。牢固地抓住电话。转动手腕将电话翻转过来。将电话放回桌面。

en: Turn your phone over.
Reach out your right hand towards the black smart phone on the blue table, grasp it, rotate it to expose its light blue back, and then release it.
zh: 把手机翻过来。
用右手伸向蓝色桌子上的黑色智能手机，抓住它，旋转使其露出浅蓝色的背面，然后松开。

en: Turn your phone over.
Pick up the black smartphone placed on the blue surface with your right hand and turn it over to expose the back.
zh: 把手机翻过来。
用右手拿起放在蓝色表面的黑色智能手机，翻转过来露出背面。

en: Turn your phone over.
Reach out your right hand to the phone placed flat on the table, grasp its edge, and rotate it 180 degrees to turn it over.
zh: 把手机翻过来。
用右手伸向桌上平放的电话，抓住它的边缘，旋转180度将其翻转过来。

en: Turn your phone over.
Reach out your right hand towards the black smart phone on the table, grasp the edge, and then rotate it to turn it over.
Reach out your right hand towards the smart phone on the table, grasp the edge, lift and rotate the device to flip it over, and then put it back on the surface.
zh: 把手机翻过来。
用右手伸向桌上的黑色智能手机，抓住边缘，然后旋转把它翻过来。
用右手伸向桌上的智能手机，抓住边缘，提起并旋转设备将其翻转，然后放回表面。

en: Turn your phone over.
Reach out your right hand towards the phone lying flat on the table, grasp its edge, and turn it over to expose the back.
The phone reached out to the table with the right hand. Grab the edge of the phone. Lift and rotate the phone to turn it over. Put the phone back on the desk.
zh: 把手机翻过来。
用右手伸向平放在桌上的电话，抓住它的边缘，翻转过来露出背面。
用右手伸向桌上的电话。抓住电话的边缘。抬起并旋转电话，将其翻转过来。将电话放回桌面。

en: Turn your phone over.
Reach for the phone with your right hand, grasp it, and then turn it over to reveal the back.
Reach for the phone with your right hand, grasp it, lift and rotate it to flip it over, and then place it on the table.
zh: 把手机翻过来。
用右手伸向电话，抓住电话，然后翻转过来显示背面。
用右手伸向电话，抓住电话，提起并旋转使其翻转，然后放在桌面上。

en: Turn your phone over.
Pick up the black smart phone with your right hand, grasp the edge, and flip it over to reveal the light blue back.
Reach out your right hand to the smart phone on the table, hold one side of the device, rotate and flip the phone over, and then put it back on the table.
zh: 把手机翻过来。
用右手拿起黑色的智能手机，抓住边缘，翻转过来露出浅蓝色的背面。
用右手伸向桌上的智能手机，握住设备的一侧，将手机旋转翻转过来，然后将其放回桌面。

en: Turn your phone over.
Pick up the black phone on the table with your right hand, hold its side, and turn it over to reveal the light blue back.
Reach for the phone on the right side of the table with your right hand. Grab the edge of the phone. Turn the phone over. Put the phone back on the table.
zh: 把手机翻过来。
用右手拿起桌上的黑电话，握住它的侧面，翻转过来显示浅蓝色的背面。
用右手伸向桌子右侧的电话。抓住电话的边缘。转动电话将其翻转过来。将电话放回桌子上。

en: Turn your phone over.
Pick up the black phone placed flat on the table with your right hand, hold its side, and turn it over to expose the back.
Reach for the phone on the right side of the table with your right hand. Grab the edge of the phone. Turn the phone over. Put the phone back on the table.
zh: 把手机翻过来。
用右手拿起桌上平放的黑色电话，握住它的侧面，翻转过来露出背面。
用右手伸向桌子右侧的电话。抓住电话的边缘。转动电话将其翻转过来。将电话放回桌子上。

en: Fold a white T-shirt on the table.
Fold a white T-shirt on the blue table. Fold the right side towards the center and hold the bottom to fold upwards.
zh: 在桌子上折叠一件白色T恤。
在蓝色桌子上折叠一件白色T恤。将右侧向中心折叠，抓住底部向上折叠。

en: Fold up the trousers on the table.
First, fold the clothes upwards with both hands. Then, use your right hand to fold the waist of the pants towards the legs. With your left hand, place the folded clothes on the left side of the table
zh: 叠起桌面上的裤子。
先用双手向上折叠，再用右手将裤腰向裤腿方向折叠，用左手将叠好的衣服放在桌子的左边

en: Fold up the trousers on the table.

First, fold the blue trousers upwards with both hands. Then, use your right hand to fold the waistband of the trousers towards the hem. Finally, use your left hand to pick up the folded trousers and place them on the left side of the table.
zh: 叠起桌面上的裤子。
先用双手向上折叠蓝色裤子，再用右手将裤腰向裤脚对折，最后用左手将折叠好的裤子拿起放在桌面左侧。

en: Fold the clothes up.
Hold the lower part of the white dress with both hands and fold it upwards. Then, use your left hand to fold it to the right again.
zh: 把衣服叠起来。
双手捏起白色衣服的下侧向上对折，再用左手将它向右再次对折。

en: Fold a blue T-shirt on the table.
Fold a blue T-shirt printed with black text on the blue table. Hold the bottom edge of the garment tightly and fold it upwards. Fold the left side towards the center.
zh: 在桌子上叠一件蓝色T恤。
在蓝色桌子上折叠一件印有黑色文字的蓝色T恤。抓紧衣物的底边向上折叠。将左侧向中心折叠。

en: Fold a blue T-shirt on the table.
Fold a blue Carolina Panthers T-shirt located in the center of the blue table. Hold the bottom edge and fold the clothes upwards. Fold the left side towards the middle.
zh: 在桌子上折叠一件蓝色T恤。
折叠一件位于蓝色桌子中央的蓝色卡罗莱纳黑豹队T恤。抓住底边，将衣服向上折叠。将左侧向中间折叠。

en: Fold a blue T-shirt on the table.

Hold the bottom edge of the garment tightly with both hands and fold it upwards towards the middle. Loosen the fabric and move your left hand back to the left side of the T-shirt. Grab the left side of the garment and fold it inward towards the center.
zh: 在桌子上折叠一件蓝色T恤。
双手抓紧衣物底边，将其向上折向中间。松开织物，将左手重新移至T恤左侧。抓起衣服左侧，向内折向中心。

en: Fold the clothes up.
First, hold the lower side of the white shirt with both hands and fold it upwards. Then, use your left hand to fold the folded shirt to the right again.
zh: 将衣服叠起来。
先用双手捏起白色衬衫的下侧向上对折，再用左手将对折后的衣服向右再次对折。

en: Fold up the trousers on the table.

First, fold the blue trousers upwards with both hands. Then, use your right hand to fold the waistband of the trousers towards the hem. Finally, use your left hand to pick up the folded trousers and place them on the left side of the table.
zh: 叠起桌面上的裤子。
先用双手向上折叠蓝色裤子，再用右手将裤腰向裤脚对折，最后用左手将折叠好的裤子拿起放在桌面左侧。

en: Fold up your coat.
Fold the blue T-shirt on the table from bottom to top with both hands, and then fold the left garment towards the center with your left hand
zh: 将上衣叠起来。
用双手将桌子上的蓝色T恤由下侧向上侧折叠，再用左手将左侧衣服向中心折叠

en: Fold the trousers and put them on the table.

Fold the blue trousers in front of you from bottom to top with both hands, then fold the waist of the trousers towards the legs with your right hand, and place your left hand on the left side of the table
zh: 把长裤折好放在桌上。
双手把面前的蓝色长裤由下向上折叠，再用右手将裤腰向裤腿对折，用左手放在桌子的左边

en: Fold a blue T-shirt on the table.
Grasp the hem of the blue T-shirt with both hands and fold the lower part upwards. Then, fold the left side of the garment towards the center with your left hand.
zh: 在桌子上折叠一件蓝色T恤。
双手抓住蓝色T恤下摆，将下半部分向上折叠。再用左手将衣服的左侧向中心折叠。

en: Fold the black cardboard template into a box.
Fold the black cardboard model on the table into a box.
Pick up one side of the cardboard model with your right hand and lift the other side with your left hand. Use both hands to lift the cardboard model and assemble it into a box.
zh: 将黑色纸板模板折叠成盒子。
把桌子上的黑色纸板模型折叠成盒子。
右手将纸板模型的一个边拿起，左手抬起纸板的另一边，双手将纸板模型抬起，将模型组装成一个盒子。

en: Fold the black template into a box.

Grab the right side of the template with the right hand, lift the left side with the left hand, and fold the two sides of the template upwards respectively with both hands. After stabilizing the basic frame, place the half-assembled box on the table with both hands. Finally, cover the top lid with the right hand to assemble a square box.
zh: 将黑色模板折叠成盒子。
右手抓起模板右侧，左手配合抬起模板左侧，双手配合将模板两侧分别向上折叠，稳定好基本框架后双手将组装到一半的盒子放到桌上，最后右手将顶部的盖子盖上，从而组装成一个正方形盒子。

en: Fold a flat black paper pattern into a three-dimensional box.

Grab the right side of the template with the right hand, lift the left side with the left hand, and fold the two sides of the template upwards respectively with both hands. After stabilizing the basic frame, place the half-assembled box on the table with both hands. Finally, cover the top lid with the right hand to assemble a square box.
Fold the flat cardboard template into a square box on the table.
Use both hands to fold the sides and folded edges of the flat black cardboard template located in the center of the blue table upwards and fix it, assembling it into a three-dimensional square.

Reach out both hands towards the black flat cardboard template in the center of the blue table. Lift the folded edges on both sides upwards to form the initial box walls. Insert the small corner pieces inward, and at the same time, fold the longer side with your right hand over them to fix the box corners. Repeat the folding and locking process on the other side. Press the bottom and sides to ensure the square structure takes shape. Loosen the assembled paper box and move your hands back to the initial position.
zh: 将一张平面的黑色纸样折叠成一个立体盒子。
右手抓起模板右侧，左手配合抬起模板左侧，双手配合将模板两侧分别向上折叠，稳定好基本框架后双手将组装到一半的盒子放到桌上，最后右手将顶部的盖子盖上，从而组装成一个正方形盒子。
在桌子上将平整的纸板模版折叠成正方形盒子。
用双手将位于蓝色桌子中央的平整黑色纸板模板的侧边和折边向上折叠并固定，组装成一个三维正方形。
双手伸向蓝色桌子中央的黑色扁平纸板模板。向上提起左右两侧的折边，形成初步的箱壁。将小角片向内塞，同时右手将较长的侧边折叠覆盖在它们之上，以固定箱角。在另一侧重复折叠和锁定过程。按压底部和侧面，确保正方形结构定型。松开组装好的纸盒，将双手移回初始位置。

en: On the table, assemble a flat template into a small black paper box.

Grab the right side of the template with the right hand, lift the left side with the left hand, and fold the two sides of the template upwards respectively with both hands. After stabilizing the basic frame, place the half-assembled box on the table with both hands. Finally, cover the top lid with the right hand to assemble a square box.
Fold the black cardboard cut into a small square box.
zh: 在桌子上，将一张平面模板组装成一个小黑纸盒。
右手抓起模板右侧，左手配合抬起模板左侧，双手配合将模板两侧分别向上折叠，稳定好基本框架后双手将组装到一半的盒子放到桌上，最后右手将顶部的盖子盖上，从而组装成一个正方形盒子。
将黑色硬纸板剪裁件折叠成一个小正方形盒子。

en: Fold a flat piece of black cardstock into a square box on the blue desktop.

Grab the right side of the template with the right hand, lift the left side with the left hand, and fold the two sides of the template upwards respectively with both hands. After stabilizing the basic frame, place the half-assembled box on the table with both hands. Finally, cover the top lid with the right hand to assemble a square box.
Fold the flat black cardboard cut into a square box.
zh: 在蓝色桌面上将一张平整的黑色卡纸折叠成一个方形盒子。
右手抓起模板右侧，左手配合抬起模板左侧，双手配合将模板两侧分别向上折叠，稳定好基本框架后双手将组装到一半的盒子放到桌上，最后右手将顶部的盖子盖上，从而组装成一个正方形盒子。
将平整的黑色纸板剪裁件折叠成正方形盒子。

en: Assemble a black cardboard box on the blue table.

Grab the right side of the template with the right hand, lift the left side with the left hand, and fold the two sides of the template upwards respectively with both hands. After stabilizing the basic frame, place the half-assembled box on the table with both hands. Finally, cover the top lid with the right hand to assemble a square box.
On the blue desktop, fold a flat black cardboard box template into a complete box.

Fold the black cardboard template located in the center of the blue table with both hands. By interlocking the tongues with the slots, adjusting each folded edge and side, a square box is assembled until the structure is completed.
zh: 在蓝色桌子上组装一个黑色纸板箱。
右手抓起模板右侧，左手配合抬起模板左侧，双手配合将模板两侧分别向上折叠，稳定好基本框架后双手将组装到一半的盒子放到桌上，最后右手将顶部的盖子盖上，从而组装成一个正方形盒子。
在蓝色的桌面上，将一个平整的黑色纸板箱模板折叠成一个完整的盒子。
双手折叠位于蓝色桌子中央的黑色纸板模板。通过将插舌与插槽相互扣合，调整各个折边和侧面，组装成一个正方形盒子，直到结构完成。

en: On a blue table, fold a flat black cardboard template into a small box with both hands.

Grab the right side of the template with the right hand, lift the left side with the left hand, and fold the two sides of the template upwards respectively with both hands. After stabilizing the basic frame, place the half-assembled box on the table with both hands. Finally, cover the top lid with the right hand to assemble a square box.
Assemble the flat template into a small black paper box.
zh: 在蓝色桌子上用双手将一个平整的黑色纸板模板折叠成一个小盒子。
右手抓起模板右侧，左手配合抬起模板左侧，双手配合将模板两侧分别向上折叠，稳定好基本框架后双手将组装到一半的盒子放到桌上，最后右手将顶部的盖子盖上，从而组装成一个正方形盒子。
将平面模板组装成一个黑色小纸盒。

en: Fold the black flat cardboard template into a square box.

Grab the right side of the template with the right hand, lift the left side with the left hand, and fold the two sides of the template upwards respectively with both hands. After stabilizing the basic frame, place the half-assembled box on the table with both hands. Finally, cover the top lid with the right hand to assemble a square box.
Fold the flat cardboard template into a box.
zh: 将黑色扁平纸板模板折叠成方形盒子。
右手抓起模板右侧，左手配合抬起模板左侧，双手配合将模板两侧分别向上折叠，稳定好基本框架后双手将组装到一半的盒子放到桌上，最后右手将顶部的盖子盖上，从而组装成一个正方形盒子。

en: Fold the black cardboard template into a small box.

en: Stack the chess pieces into a vertical pile.
Grab a single circular chess piece with your right hand and place it above the existing stack to build a tower.

Reach out to pick up the scattered chess pieces on the table. Grasp a chess piece with your right hand. Lift the chess piece vertically. Place it on top of the current stack. Repeat the actions of grasping and lifting subsequent pieces to increase the height of the stack.
zh: 将棋子叠成一个垂直的堆。
用右手抓取单个圆形棋子，将其放在现有堆叠的上方，搭建一座塔。
伸手去拿桌上的散落棋子。用右手抓住一个棋子。将棋子垂直提起。把它放在当前堆叠的顶部。对后续的棋子重复抓取和提起的动作，以增加堆叠的高度。

en: Stack chess pieces
Pick up the scattered chess pieces with your right hand and stack them vertically on the table.

Take a chess piece with your right hand, grasp it, lift it up, and then place it on top of another chess piece. Repeat the above actions, pick up, grasp and stack the remaining pieces one by one to form a vertical stack.
zh: 堆叠棋子
用右手捡起散落的棋子，并将它们垂直叠放在桌面上。
用右手去拿一枚棋子，抓住它，提起它，然后放在另一枚棋子的上面。重复上述动作，将剩下的棋子依次拿起、抓住并叠放，形成一个垂直的堆叠。

en: Stack the chess pieces.
Use your right hand to stack the round wooden chess pieces into a vertical stack.

Use your right hand to pick up the scattered chess pieces. Take one, lift it up and place it on another piece. Continue to take the remaining chess pieces, pick them up one by one, and stack them on the gradually increasing pile.
zh: 堆叠棋子。
用右手将圆形木制棋子叠成一个垂直的堆叠。
用右手去拿散落的棋子，拿起一个，把它举起来，放在另一个棋子上。继续去拿剩下的棋子，一个一个地抓起，叠放在逐渐增大的堆上。

en: Stack chess pieces
Pick up the round chess pieces on the table one by one with your right hand and stack them vertically into a pile.

Reach out to the scattered parts with your right hand, grab one and place it on the table to start stacking. Pick up the second part and stack it on top of the first one. Continue to grasp the remaining parts with your right hand and stack them one by one. Adjust the topmost part to fix the tower structure.
zh: 堆叠棋子
用右手将桌上的圆形棋子逐一捡起，垂直叠成一堆。
用右手伸向散落的零件，抓住一个放在桌上开始堆叠。拿起第二个零件叠在第一个上面。继续用右手抓取剩下的零件并逐个叠上去。调整最上面的零件以固定塔形结构。

en: Stack the chess pieces.
Grab the scattered round wooden chess pieces with your right hand and stack them vertically on the blue table.

Reach out your right hand towards the scattered chess pieces, grab one piece and place it on top of another. Repeat the actions of grasping and stacking to form a vertical stack of the remaining pieces.
zh: 堆叠棋子。
用右手抓起散落的圆形木制棋子，并将它们垂直叠放在蓝色桌面。
用右手伸向散落的棋子，抓住一个棋子放在另一个棋子上面。重复抓取和堆叠的动作，将剩下的棋子堆成一个垂直的堆。

en: Stack chess pieces
Pick up the round wooden chess pieces with your right hand and stack them vertically on the table.
Reach out your right hand towards the scattered pieces, grab one, then lift it up and place it on top of another piece. Repeat this action to form a vertical stack.
zh: 堆叠棋子
用右手拿起圆形的木制棋子，并将它们垂直地叠放在桌面上。
用右手伸向散落的棋子，抓住一个，然后将其提起，放在另一个棋子的上面。重复这个动作，形成一个垂直的堆叠。

en: Stack the chess pieces together.
Use your right hand to stack the scattered wooden chess pieces vertically into a row.

Reach out to the scattered parts with your right hand, grab one and place it on the table. Then grasp the next part with your right hand and stack it on top. Repeat this action, pick up and place the remaining parts with your right hand until they form a vertical pile.
zh: 将棋子叠在一起。
用右手将散落的木制棋子垂直叠成一列。
用右手伸向散落的零件，抓住一个，放在桌子上。再用右手抓住下一个零件，叠在上面。重复这个动作，用右手拿起并放置剩下的零件，直到它们堆成一个垂直的堆。

en: Stack chess pieces
Pick up the round chess pieces on the table with your right hand and then stack them vertically.

Reach out to the scattered chess pieces with your right hand, pick up one, lift it up and place it on another piece. Continue to use your right hand to pick up the pieces beside you, grab them and stack them on the vertically stacked pieces.
zh: 堆叠棋子
用右手将桌上的圆形棋子抓起来，然后垂直叠放。
用右手伸向散落的棋子，拿起一枚，将其抬起，放在另一枚棋子上。继续用右手去拿旁边的棋子，将它们抓起，叠放到垂直堆叠的棋子上。

en: Stack chess pieces
Use your right hand to pick up each piece on the chessboard one by one and stack them vertically on top of each other.

Push a chess piece to build the foundation. Reach out to take the second chess piece, grasp it and place it on top. Reach out to take the third chess piece, grasp it and stack it on the stack. Reach out and take the fourth chess piece, grasp it and place it on top. Reach out to take the last chess piece, grasp it and place it at the highest point. Adjust the top piece to ensure alignment.
zh: 堆叠棋子
用右手将棋盘上的棋子逐一拿起，并垂直叠放在彼此之上。
推动一枚棋子以建立基础。伸手取第二枚棋子，抓住它，放在上面。伸手取第三枚棋子，抓住它，堆叠在堆栈上。伸手取第四枚棋子，抓住它，放到顶部。伸手取最后一枚棋子，抓住它，放在最高处。调整最上面的棋子，确保对齐。

en: The scattered chess pieces are piled up together
Pick up a single round chess piece from the table with your right hand and stack them vertically.

Reach out your right hand towards the scattered chess pieces, grab the one on the far right, and then lift it up. Place this piece on top of another one and stack them up. Then go and take the next piece in this row, grab it and lift it up, and then place it on top of the stacked pieces.
zh: 散落的棋子堆在一起
用右手从桌面拿起单个圆形棋子，并将它们垂直叠起来。
用右手伸向散落的棋子，抓住最右边的一枚，然后将其提起。把这枚棋子放在另一枚棋子上面，堆叠起来。再去拿这一排中的下一颗棋子，抓住并提起，然后放到堆叠好的棋子顶部。

en: Stack chess pieces
Stack the round wooden chess pieces into a vertical pile with your right hand and place it on the blue table.

Reach out to the scattered chess pieces with your right hand, pick up one and place it on top of another. Repeat this action, picking up the remaining pieces one by one and stacking them vertically until a row is formed. Adjust the last pile.
zh: 堆叠棋子
用右手将圆形木制棋子堆叠成一个垂直的堆，放在蓝色的桌子上。
用右手伸向散落的棋子，拿起一个棋子放在另一个上面。重复这个动作，把剩下的棋子一个个拿起，垂直叠起来，直到形成一列。调整最后一堆。

en: Move the chess piece.
Grab the scattered chess pieces with your right hand and stack them vertically on the table.

Reach for a chess piece on the table with your right hand, grasp it and lift it up. Put it on another piece to form a pile. Reach out and take the third chess piece, and place it on the top of this pile.
zh: 移动棋子。
用右手抓起散落的棋子，并将它们垂直堆放在桌面上。
用右手伸向桌上的一个棋子，抓住它并提起。把它放在另一个棋子上，形成一堆。再伸手拿第三个棋子，把它放到这堆的最上面。

Roll the dice.
