Roll the dice with the index finger of your right hand.
zh: 掷骰子。
用右手食指拨动骰子。

en: Roll the dice on the table.
Roll the dice with the index finger of your left hand.
zh: 拨动桌上的骰子。
用左手食指拨动骰子。

en: Roll the dice.
Roll the dice with the index finger of your left hand.
zh: 掷骰子。
用左手食指拨动骰子。

en: Roll the dice on the table.
Roll the dice with the index finger of your left hand.
zh: 拨动桌上的骰子。
用左手食指拨动骰子。

en: Roll the dice.
Roll the dice with the index finger of your left hand.
zh: 掷骰子。
用左手食指拨动骰子。

task_name: Open or Close the Water Gun

en: Push the piston inward into the syringe.
Push the piston handle with your right hand into the syringe held by your left hand, and it will enter the piston cylinder.

Find the large syringe placed horizontally in the center of the pink table. Fix the transparent syringe with your left hand while holding the blue piston handle with your right hand. Push the piston to the left with your right hand to insert it into the transparent syringe.
zh: 向内推动活塞进入针筒。
用右手推活塞手柄进入左手抓住的针筒，其进入活塞筒。
找到位于粉色桌子中央水平放置的大号针筒。用左手固定透明针管，同时用右手握住蓝色活塞手柄。右手向左手边推动活塞使其进入透明针管。

task_name: Open or Close the Water Gun

en: Pull the piston of the large syringe with both hands.
Hold the blue T-shaped handle and the green tube body of a large needle tube in the center of the pink table with both hands. Pull the piston outward to extend the syringe, and then release it.

Hold the blue handle of the large syringe with your right hand and grasp it firmly. Move your left hand and firmly grasp the green cylinder body. Pull the blue piston out of the cylinder body with your right hand. After the piston is completely pulled out, release both hands.
zh: 用双手拉动大号针筒的活塞。
双手握住粉色桌子中央一个大针管的蓝色T形手柄和绿色筒身。向外拉动活塞使针管延伸，然后将其松开。
用右手握住大注射器的蓝色手柄，牢牢抓住它。移动左手，牢牢抓住绿色缸体。用右手将蓝色活塞从气缸中拔出。待活塞完全拔出后，松开双手。

task_name: Open or Close the Water Gun

en: Push the piston of a large syringe.

Reach out your right hand to get the large syringe in the center of the pink table. Hold the blue handle with your right hand and the blue cylinder with your left hand. Push the yellow piston into the cylinder. Release the object.
zh: 推一个大针管的活塞。
伸右手去拿粉色桌子中央的大针筒。右手握住蓝色手柄，左手握住蓝色筒体。将黄色活塞向筒体中推入。松开该物体。

task_name: Open or Close the Water Gun

en: Pull the piston of the large syringe horizontally on the grid surface.
Hold the blue syringe of a large syringe on the red checkered tablecloth with your left hand, and pull the blue handle outward with your right hand to pull out the yellow piston.

Extend your right hand towards the T-shaped handle of the large syringe in the center of the table. At the same time, move your left hand to hold the tube of the syringe. Firmly fix the blue and white cylinder body with your left hand, and at the same time pull the blue handle to the right side of the table with your right hand. Pull the yellow piston out of the cylinder completely. Release these two components and bring your hands back to the starting position.
zh: 在方格表面上水平拉动大号注射器的活塞。
左手握住红格子桌布上一个大号针筒的蓝色针管，同时右手向外拉动蓝色手柄以拉出黄色活塞。
右手伸向桌面中央大型注射器的t型手柄。同时移动左手握住注射器的管身。左手稳稳固定住蓝白色筒身，同时右手将蓝色手柄向桌面右侧拉动。将黄色活塞从筒内完全拉出。松开这两个部件，将双手收回至起始位置。

task_name: Open or Close the Water Gun

en: Pull out the piston from the large plastic syringe placed on the grid table.

Hold a large green and blue striped syringe in the center of the red and white checkered tablecloth with your left hand. Hold the blue handle with your right hand and pull the piston out of the cylinder body.

Reach out your right hand towards the blue handle of the syringe. Move your left hand towards the transparent and blue syringe. Hold the blue handle tightly with your right hand. Fix the syringe with your left hand. Pull your right hand outward to slide the piston out of the syringe. Pull the piston out completely until it almost disengages. Loosen the grip on the component. Put your hands back on both sides of the table.
zh: 从放在格子桌上的大号塑料针筒中拔出活塞。
左手拿住红白格子桌布中央的一个大型绿蓝相间的针筒。右手握住蓝色手柄，将活塞从筒身中拉出。
用右手伸向针管的蓝色手柄。将左手移向透明和蓝色的针筒。用右手抓紧蓝色手柄。用左手固定住针筒。向外拉动右手，将活塞从针筒中滑出。完全拉出活塞，直到它几乎脱离。松开对组件的抓握。将双手放回桌子两侧。

task_name: Open or Close the Water Gun

en: Pull the piston of a large blue and yellow syringe with both hands.
Hold the blue body of the large syringe with your left hand and pull the blue piston handle to the right with your right hand at the same time.
zh: 双手拉动一个大型蓝黄相间注射器的活塞。
左手拿住大型注射器的蓝色筒身，同时右手向右拉动蓝色的活塞柄。

task_name: Open or Close the Water Gun

en: Pull out the piston of the large syringe.

Take the huge blue and green striped syringe in the center of the pink table with your left hand. Hold the blue piston handle with your right hand and the green cylinder body with your left hand, then pull the piston outward to the end.

Move your right hand towards the blue piston handle of the large syringe placed horizontally on the table. Move your left hand towards the green barrel of the same syringe. Hold the blue handle tightly with your right hand and the green syringe tightly with your left hand. Pull your right hand to the right, and while your left hand is fixing the syringe, pull the piston out of the syringe. Loosen the syringe that has been opened and return your hands to the starting position.
zh: 拔大号针筒的活塞。
左手拿取粉色桌子中央那支巨大的蓝绿相间针筒。右手握住蓝色活塞手柄，左手握住绿色筒身，随后将活塞向外拉至尽头。
将右手移向水平放置在桌上的大注射器的蓝色活塞手柄。将左手移向同一注射器的绿色针筒。用右手握紧蓝色手柄，左手握紧绿色针筒。右手向右拉动，在左手固定针筒的同时将活塞从针筒中拉出。松开已拉开的注射器，将双手放回起始位置。

task_name: Open or Close the Water Gun

en: Push the piston of the large plastic syringe.

Reach both hands towards the large plastic syringe located in the center of the pink table. Hold the blue handle with your left hand and the tip of the blue syringe with your right hand, then push the piston into the syringe.

Reach out your left hand towards the blue handle of the large plastic syringe and hold it firmly. Extend your right hand towards the blue tip on the right side of the syringe and hold it tightly. Push the yellow plunger into the blue transparent syringe. At the same time, release the grip on both ends of the syringe. Put your hands back to the initial rest positions on both sides of the table.
zh: 推大型塑料注射器的活塞。
双手够向位于粉色桌子中央的大号塑料注射器。左手握住蓝色手柄，右手握住蓝色针筒尖端，随后推入活塞进入注射器。
用左手伸向大型塑料注射器的蓝色手柄并牢牢握住。将右手伸向注射器右侧的蓝色尖端并握紧。将黄色柱塞向蓝色透明针筒中推入。同时松开对注射器两端的抓握。将双手放回桌面两侧的初始休息位置。

task_name: Open or Close the Water Gun

en: Push the piston of a large syringe into the table.
Hold the transparent tube of the large syringe on the right with your right hand and the piston of the blue handle on the left with your left hand. Push the piston inward.

Reach out your left hand to get the large syringe placed horizontally on the pink table. Hold the blue piston handle with your left hand and the transparent tube of the syringe with your right hand. Push the piston into the syringe, release the syringe, and withdraw both hands to the sides of the screen.
zh: 推入桌上一个大注射器的活塞。
右手握住右侧大注射器的透明管身，左手握住左侧的蓝色手柄的活塞。向内推入活塞。
伸左手去拿横放在粉色桌子上的大注射器。左手握住蓝色活塞柄，右手握住注射器的透明管身。将活塞向注射器内推入，松开注射器，双手撤回至画面两侧。

task_name: Open or Close the Water Gun

en: Pull the large plastic syringe by pulling the piston.
Hold the syringe barrel of the light blue and yellow striped syringe on the checkered tablecloth with your left hand, and pull the handle with your right hand to completely pull out the piston.
zh: 通过拉动活塞来抽拉大型塑料注射器。
左手握住格子桌布上那支浅蓝和黄色相间注射器的针筒，同时右手拉动把手，将活塞完全拉出。

task_name: Open or Close the Water Gun

en: Pull the piston of a large syringe on the grid table with both hands.

Hold the body of the huge transparent and blue striped syringe in the center of the table with your left hand, and pull the blue T-shaped handle outward with your right hand to extend the yellow plunger rod.

Extend your right hand towards the blue T-shaped handle of the large syringe. Hold the blue handle firmly. Move your left hand to the body of the syringe. Hold the cylinder body tightly to secure the object. Pull your right hand back to the right side of the desktop. While keeping the syringe still with your left hand, pull out the yellow plunger rod from the cylinder body. Keep pulling until the plunger extends across the table.
zh: 双手在格子桌面上拉动一个大号注射器的活塞。
左手握住桌子中央那个巨大的透明和蓝色相间针筒的筒身，同时右手向外拉动蓝色T型手柄，以延伸出黄色的柱塞杆。
用右手伸向大型针筒的蓝色T型手柄。牢牢握住蓝色手柄。将左手移至针筒的筒身。紧紧握住筒身以固定物体。将右手向桌面右侧拉回。在左手保持针筒不动的同时，从筒身中抽出黄色柱塞杆。继续拉动，直到柱塞横跨桌面延伸开来。

task_name: Open or Close the Water Gun

en: Pull the piston of the large syringe.

Hold the blue handle of the large syringe placed horizontally in the center of the pink table with your left hand, and the blue tip with your right hand. Pull the component to both sides to pull out the piston, and then release the object.
zh: 拉动大注射器的活塞。
左手握住粉色桌子中央水平放置的大注射器的蓝色手柄，右手握住蓝色尖端，将组件向两边拉开以拉出活塞，然后松开该物体。

en: Open a red cardboard box on the blue table.
Open the lid on the right side with your right hand and unfold the remaining lid with your left hand to reveal the items inside.
zh: 在蓝色桌子上打开一个红色纸箱。
用右手翻开右侧的箱盖，用左手展开剩余的箱盖，露出里面的物品。

en: Open a cardboard box on the blue table.
First, open the right box lid with your right hand, then open the LIDS of the other boxes with your left hand to expose the items inside
zh: 在蓝色桌子上打开一个纸箱。
先用右手打开右侧箱盖，再用左手打开其他箱盖，露出里面物品

en: Lift the lid of the carton and open it.
Open the left box lid with your left hand, open the right and top box LIDS with your right hand, and open the bottom box lid with your left hand to expose the items inside.
zh: 掀开纸箱盖板打开纸箱。
左手打开左边箱盖，右手打开右边和上边箱盖，左手打开下边箱盖，露出里面物品。

en: Open a red cardboard box
Open the right box lid with your right hand and the other box LIDS with your left hand to expose the items inside
zh: 打开一个红色纸板箱
右手打开右边箱盖，左手打开其他箱盖，露出里面物品

en: Open the cardboard box in the center of the table.

Open the right cover plate with your right hand and the left cover plate with your left hand. Open the upper cover plate with your right hand and the lower cover plate with your left hand to expose the items inside.
zh: 打开桌子中央的纸箱。
右手打开右侧盖板，左手打开左侧盖板。右手打开上方盖板，左手打开下方盖板，露出里面物品。

en: Open the carton.

Open the right cover plate with your right hand, the left cover plate with your left hand, the upper cover plate with your right hand, and the lower cover plate with your left hand to expose the items inside the box.
zh: 打开纸箱。
右手打开右侧盖板，左手打开左侧盖板，右手打开上方盖板，左手打开下方盖板，露出箱内物品。

en: Open the reddish-brown lid of the carton.
With the right hand, I opened the red right top cover of the cardboard box in the center of the table, and then with the left hand, I opened the other covers, revealing the items inside.
zh: 打开纸箱红褐色的盖子。
右手打开桌子中央纸箱红色的右侧顶盖，接着左手打开其他盖板，露出了里面的物品。

en: Open the cardboard box to reveal the items inside.
Open the right cover plate with your left hand, open the left cover plate with your right hand, and open the upper and lower cover plates with your left hand to expose the items inside the box.
zh: 打开纸箱，露出里面的物品。
左手打开右侧盖板，右手打开左侧盖板，左手打开上方盖板和下方盖板，露出箱内物品。

en: Open the lid of the carton.
Open the right box cover with your left hand, open the left box cover with your right hand, and open the upper and lower box covers with your left hand to expose the items inside the box.
zh: 打开纸箱盖。
左手打开右侧箱盖，右手打开左侧箱盖，左手打开上方箱盖和下方箱盖，露出箱内物品。

en: Open the cardboard box on the table and show the items inside.
Open the right box cover with your right hand, open the left box cover with your left hand, and open the upper and lower box covers with your left hand to expose the items inside.
zh: 打开桌上的纸箱，展示其中的物品。
右手打开右侧箱盖，左手打开左侧箱盖，左手打开上方箱盖和下方箱盖，露出里面物品。

en: Open a red cardboard box.
Open the right box lid with your right hand and the other three box LIDS with your left hand to expose the items inside.
zh: 打开一个红色的纸板箱。
右手打开右侧箱盖，左手打开其他三个箱盖，露出里面物品。

en: Open a red cardboard box and check the items inside.
Open the right box lid with your right hand and the other box LIDS with your left hand to expose the items inside.
zh: 打开一个红色纸板箱并检查其中的物品。
右手打开右侧箱盖，左手打开其他箱盖，露出箱内物品。

en: Open the bottom drawer of the white desktop storage box.

Move your right hand towards the white three-layer storage box in the center. Reach out and reach the handle of the bottom drawer. Hold the drawer handle tightly. Pull the drawer outward smoothly until it is fully open. Let go of your hand. Pull your hand back to the lower right corner of the table.
The white three-layer storage rack extending towards the center of the blue table. Hold the handle of the bottom drawer, pull it forward to reveal the items inside, and then release it.

Move your right hand towards the white three-layer storage cabinet located in the center of the desktop. Place your hand in front of the bottom drawer. Hold the semi-transparent handle of the bottom drawer tightly. Pull out the drawer towards the edge of the desktop until it is fully pulled out. Release the handle. Pull your hand back to the right side of the desktop to keep the bottom drawer open.
zh: 打开白色桌面收纳盒最底层的抽屉。
右手向中心的白色三层收纳盒移动。伸手够到最底层抽屉的把手。抓紧抽屉把手。平稳地向外拉动抽屉，直到其完全打开。松开手。将手收回到桌子的右下方。
伸向蓝色桌子中央的白色三层收纳架。握住最底层抽屉的把手，将其向前拉开以显露其中的物品，随后松开。
将右手移向位于桌面中央的白色三层收纳柜。将手置于底层抽屉的前方。握紧底层抽屉的半透明把手。向桌面边缘方向拉出抽屉，直到其完全拉出。松开把手。将手收回至桌面右侧，使底层抽屉保持开启状态。

en: Pull open the bottom drawer.
Pull open the bottom drawer with your right hand.
Pull open the bottom drawer of the white cabinet with your right hand.
zh: 将最下面的抽屉拉开。
用右手把最下层的抽屉拉开。
用右手把白色柜子最下面的抽屉拉开。

en: Pull open the bottom drawer.
Pull open the bottom drawer with your right hand.
Pull open the bottom drawer of the white cabinet with your right hand.
zh: 把最下面的抽屉拉开。
用右手把最下面的抽屉拉开。
用右手把白色柜子最下面的抽屉拉开。

en: Pull the drawer open with your right hand.
Pull open the bottom drawer with your right hand.
Use your right hand to pull open the bottom drawer of the white cabinet.
zh: 用右手把抽屉拉开。
用右手把最下面的抽屉拉开。
用右手把白色柜子最底层的抽屉拉开。

en: Open the bottom drawer of the white cabinet.

Reach the silver handle of the bottom drawer of the white three-layer cabinet above the blue bottle on the wooden table with your right hand. Hold the handle and pull the drawer outward to reveal the items inside.

Move your right hand towards the silver handle of the bottom drawer of the white three-layer cabinet in the center of the table. Hold the horizontal handle of the bottom drawer firmly. Pull the drawer straight out towards the edge of the table until it is fully unfolded. Release the handle and bring your hand back to a stationary position while keeping the drawer open.
zh: 打开白色柜子最底层的抽屉。
右手去够木桌上蓝色瓶子上方白色三层柜最底层抽屉的银色把手。握住把手并向外拉开抽屉，显露出里面的物品。
将右手移向桌子中央白色三层柜最底层抽屉的银色把手。牢牢握住最底层抽屉的水平把手。将抽屉向桌边方向笔直拉出，直到完全展开。松开把手并将手收回至静止位置，同时抽屉保持打开状态。

en: Open the drawer on the second layer of the white storage cabinet.
The second drawer of the white three-layer storage cabinet extending to the left side of the table. Hold the front handle and pull the drawer out.

Move your left hand towards the three-tiered white storage cabinet on the left side of the table. Reach out your hand to reach the handle of the second drawer. Hold the handle firmly. Pull out the drawer and open it.
zh: 打开白色储物柜第二层的抽屉。
伸向桌子左侧白色三层收纳柜的第二层抽屉。握住前把手，向外拉开抽屉。
将左手移向位于桌子左侧的三层白色储物柜。伸出手去够第二层抽屉的把手。握稳把手。向外拉出抽屉将其打开。

en: Pull open the second drawer.
Open the second drawer with your right hand.
Open the second drawer of the white cabinet with your right hand.
zh: 把第二层抽屉拉开。
用右手把第二层抽屉打开。
用右手把白色柜子的第二层抽屉打开。

en: Open the drawer in the middle of the white cabinet.
Pull open the middle drawer of the three-layer white cabinet on the wooden table. Hold the silver handle with your right hand and pull out the drawer.

Reach out your right hand towards the white three-tiered drawer cabinet on the wooden table. Place your hand above the silver handle of the middle drawer. Hold the handle and pull the middle drawer outward. Release the handle. Bring your right hand back to the starting position.
zh: 打开白色柜子中间的抽屉。
拉开木桌上三层白色柜子的中层抽屉。用右手握住银色把手，将抽屉拉出。
用右手伸向木桌上的白色三层抽屉柜。将手置于中间抽屉的银色把手上方。握住把手并向外拉开中间抽屉。松开把手。将右手收回至起始位置。

en: Open the drawer in the middle of the white cabinet.

Stretch out your right hand towards the white three-drawer cabinet located in the center of the wooden table. Hold the handle of the middle drawer and pull it open. Pull your hand back to the right side of the table.

Reach out your right hand towards the horizontal handle of the middle drawer of the white three-layer drawer cabinet. Firmly hold the center position of the handle. Pull the drawer outward until it is completely pulled out of the cabinet rack. Release the handle. Bring your right hand back to the starting position on the right side of the desktop.
zh: 打开白色柜子中间的抽屉。
伸出右手，伸向位于木桌中央的白色三屉柜。握住中间抽屉的把手并将其拉开。将手收回到桌子右侧。
用右手伸向白色三层抽屉柜中间抽屉的水平把手。牢牢握住把手的中心位置。向外拉动抽屉，直到它从柜架中完全拉出。松开把手。将右手收回到桌面右侧的起始位置。

en: Open the drawer in the middle of the white three-layer cabinet.
Hold the silver horizontal handle of the middle drawer of the white three-drawer drawer on the wooden table with your right hand and pull it out until the drawer is fully open.

Move your right hand towards the white three-layer drawer cabinet located in the center of the work area. Reach out for the silver horizontal handle on the middle drawer. Hold the handle and pull the drawer out straight. Keep pulling until the drawer is fully pulled out of the cabinet rack. Loosen the handle and while the drawer remains open, bring your right hand back to the starting position.
zh: 打开白色三层柜中间的抽屉。
右手握住木桌上的白色三屉抽柜中间抽屉的银色横向把手，将其向外拉出，直到抽屉完全打开。
将右手移向位于工作区中央的白色三层抽屉柜。伸手去够中间抽屉上的银色水平拉手。握住拉手并将抽屉笔直拉出。继续拉动，直到抽屉从柜架中完全拉开。松开拉手，在抽屉保持打开状态的同时，将右手收回至起始位置。

en: Open the top drawer of the white three-layer storage cabinet.
Reach your right hand towards the top drawer of the white three-layer plastic storage box in the center of the blue table. Hold the drawer handle and pull it outward to open the drawer.

Extend your right hand towards the white plastic storage cabinet located in the center of the table. The recessed handle near the top drawer. Put your hand into the opening of the handle to hold it firmly. Pull out the drawer outward to separate it from the cabinet and expose the inside. Keep your hands in contact with the handle until the drawer is fully pulled out.
zh: 打开白色三层收纳柜最顶层的抽屉。
右手够向蓝色桌子中央白色三层塑料收纳盒最顶层的抽屉。握住抽屉把手并向外拉，以打开抽屉。
用右手伸向位于桌子中央的白色塑料收纳柜。靠近顶层抽屉的凹陷式把手。将手伸入把手开口以握稳。向外拉出抽屉，使其脱离柜体以露出内部。保持手与把手的接触，直到抽屉完全拉出。

en: Open the first drawer of the white storage cabinet.
The white plastic storage cabinet extending to the left of the blue table. Hold the handle of the first drawer with your left hand. Pull it outwards to expose the inside.

Stretch your left hand towards the white plastic storage cabinet on the left side of the blue table. Place your hand in front of the handle of the third drawer from bottom to top. Hold the handle firmly. Pull the drawer straight towards your body. Keep pulling outwards until the drawer is fully open. Hold the handle to keep the drawer open.
zh: 打开白色储物柜的第一个抽屉。
伸向蓝色桌子左侧的白色塑料储物柜。用左手握住第一层抽屉的把手。将其向外拉开，露出内部。
将左手伸向蓝色桌子左侧的白色塑料储物柜。将手置于从下往上数第三个抽屉的把手前。牢牢握住把手。将抽屉笔直地向身体方向拉。继续向外拉，直到抽屉完全拉开。握住把手以保持抽屉开启。

en: Open the folding fan and put it back on the table
Hold the edge of the fan with your right hand and the opposite edge with your left hand. Separate the bone strips and start to spread them out, then place the fully spread fan flat on the table

Hold the outer bone bar near the fan's rotating shaft with your right hand and the opposite edge with your left hand. Horizontally spread your hands apart to separate the bone strips and start to unfold them until the fan is fully spread out. Then, place the fully spread fan flat on the table
zh: 打开折叠扇，在放回桌上
右手握住扇子边缘，左手握住相对的边缘。使骨条分离并开始展开，然后将完全展开的扇子平放在桌面上
右手握住扇子转轴附近的外侧骨条，左手握住相对的边缘。水平地将双手拉开，使骨条分离并开始展开，直到扇子完全展开，将完全展开的扇子平放在桌面上

en: Open the folding fan, separate its bone strips and put it back on the table
Grasp both sides of the fan with both hands and pull it out to the sides to fully unfold the paper leaf into a semi-circle. Place the unfolded fan horizontally and stably on the table.
zh: 打开折叠扇，将其骨条分开后放回桌上
双手抓住扇子的两侧，向两侧拉开将纸叶完全展开成半圆形。水平稳定地将展开的扇子置于桌面之上。

en: Open the folded fan, separate its frame and unfold the paper blades.
Grasp both sides of the fan with both hands and pull it out to the sides to fully unfold the paper leaf into a semi-circle. Place the unfolded fan horizontally and stably on the table.
zh: 打开折叠的扇子，分开它的骨架并展开纸叶。
双手抓住扇子的两侧，向两侧拉开将纸叶完全展开成半圆形。水平稳定地将展开的扇子置于桌面之上。

en: Separate the ribs of the folding fan and put it back on the table
Grasp both sides of the fan with both hands and pull it out to the sides to fully unfold the paper leaf into a semi-circle. Place the unfolded fan horizontally and stably on the table.

Extend your right hand towards the outside of the fan. Bring your left hand close to the opposite side and pull both hands outward symmetrically until the fan is fully opened. Then gently place it back on the table in a stable and unfolded state.
zh: 将折叠扇扇骨分开然后放回桌上
双手抓住扇子的两侧，向两侧拉开将纸叶完全展开成半圆形。水平稳定地将展开的扇子置于桌面之上。
右手伸向扇子外侧；左手从相对的一侧靠近，双手同时向外对称拉动，直到扇子完全打开，然后将其轻轻放回桌面，呈稳定展开的状态。

en: Open the folding fan, separate its bone strips and put it back on the table

Grasp the outer bone of the folding fan close to the axis with your right hand. At the same time, fix the other opposite exoskeleton with the left hand. Pull the fan out symmetrically with both hands gradually until it is fully open, then release the grip and place the fan flat on the table.
zh: 打开折叠扇，将其骨条分开后放回桌上
右手抓住折叠扇靠近轴心的外骨；左手同时固定相对的另一个外骨。双手对称向外拉逐渐展开扇子直到完全打开，然后松开握持，将扇子平放在桌面上。

en: Unfold a folded traditional fan, separate its frame, and spread the paper surface on the table.

Pick up the right side with your right hand and the left side with your left hand, extending the folded fan from both sides of the table. Hold the outermost fan bone and then pull it in the opposite direction to start unfolding. When the fan is fully open and placed horizontally on the table, release the grip.
zh: 展开一把折叠的传统扇子，将其骨架分开，并把纸面铺在桌面上。
右手拿起右侧左手拿起左侧从桌子两侧伸向折叠的扇子。握住最外侧的扇骨，然后向相反方向拉以开始展开。当扇子完全打开并水平放在桌面上时，松开握持。

en: Open the folding fan, separate its frame and put it back on the table

Extend your right hand towards the outside of the fan. Move your left hand in the opposite direction simultaneously. Spread your hands to the sides to start spreading. Unfold the paper leaf completely into a semi-circle. Keep both hands on the outermost ribs and place the unfolded fan horizontally and steadily on the table.
zh: 打开折叠扇，将其骨架分开然后放回桌上
右手伸向扇子的外侧；左手同时朝相反方向移动。双手向两侧拉开以开始展开。将纸叶完全展开成半圆形。双手保持在最外侧肋条上，水平稳定地将展开的扇子置于桌面之上。

en: Open the folding fan and put it back on the table

Pick up the right side with your right hand and the left side with your left hand, reach towards the closed folding fan, and firmly hold the bone strips at both ends. Spread your hands horizontally to unfold the structure of the fan. At the same time, increase the arc until the fan is fully open. Place the fan flat on the table while keeping it open
zh: 打开折叠扇，在放回桌上
用右手拿起右边，左手拿起左边，伸向闭合的折扇，在两端牢固地握住骨条。双手水平拉开以展开扇子的结构。同时扩大弧度直到扇子完全打开。在保持扇子打开时平放在桌面

en: Open the folding fan, separate its bone strips and put it back on the table

Hold the outer edge of the red fan bone with your right hand and grasp the opposite end of the fan bone with your left hand. Pull both hands in coordination along the longitudinal axis of the fan symmetrically outward until it is fully unfolded into a semi-circular arc. When the fan is stable in the open state, then put it back on the table.
zh: 打开折叠扇，将其骨条分开后放回桌上
用右手握住红色扇骨外侧边缘，左手抓住相对的扇骨末端。双手协调地沿着扇子的纵向轴线对称向外拉，直到完全展开成半圆形弧度。当扇子在打开状态下稳定时，然后放回桌上。

en: Open the folding hand fan, separate its frame and then put it back on the table

Extend your right hand towards the folding fan, grasp the outermost rib close to the axis, and hold the other side of the fan handle with your left hand. Pull your hands to the sides to separate the fan ribs and start the opening action. Until the paper is unfolded into a semi-circle. Place the fully open fan flat on the table
zh: 打开折叠手扇，将其骨架分开然后放回桌上
右手伸向折叠扇，抓住靠近轴心的最外侧扇骨，左手抓住扇柄的另一侧。双手向两侧拉开以分离扇骨，开始打开的动作。直到纸片展开成半圆形。将完全打开的扇子平放在桌面上

en: Open a folded traditional fan and put it back on the table.

Grasp the outer bone of the folding fan close to the axis with your right hand. At the same time, fix the other opposite exoskeleton with the left hand. Pull the fan out symmetrically with both hands gradually until it is fully open, then release the grip and place the fan flat on the table.
zh: 打开一把折叠的传统扇子，然后放回桌上。
右手抓住折叠扇靠近轴心的外骨；左手同时固定相对的另一个外骨。双手对称向外拉逐渐展开扇子直到完全打开，然后松开握持，将扇子平放在桌面上。

en: Open the folding fan, separate its frame and place it on the table.
Hold the edge of the fan with your right hand and the opposite edge with your left hand. Separate the bone strips and start to spread them out, then place the fully spread fan flat on the table

Extend your right hand towards the outside of the fan. Move your left hand in the opposite direction simultaneously. Spread your hands to the sides to start spreading. Unfold the paper leaf completely into a semi-circle. Keep both hands on the outermost ribs and place the unfolded fan horizontally and steadily on the table.
zh: 打开折叠扇，将其骨架分开并放在桌上。
右手握住扇子边缘，左手握住相对的边缘。使骨条分离并开始展开，然后将完全展开的扇子平放在桌面上
右手伸向扇子的外侧；左手同时朝相反方向移动。双手向两侧拉开以开始展开。将纸叶完全展开成半圆形。双手保持在最外侧肋条上，水平稳定地将展开的扇子置于桌面之上。

en: Fix the lid with your left hand and grasp the edge of the blue lunch box lid with your right hand. Lift it vertically to separate it from the transparent rectangular base.
zh: 用左手固定盖子右手抓住蓝色饭盒盖子的边缘，垂直提起以将其从透明的矩形底座上分离。

en: Grasp the transparent rectangular bento box in the center of the table with your left hand, remove the blue lid with your right hand, and place it on the table to the right of the bento box.
zh: 左手抓住位于桌子中央的透明长方形便当盒，右手取下蓝色盖子，放在便当盒右边的桌面上。

en: Open the lunch box.
Grasp the blue lid of the lunch box with your left hand, lift it with your right hand and place it on the right.
zh: 打开午餐盒。
左手抓住饭盒的蓝色盖子，右手掀起盖子，把盖子放到右边。

en: Reaching out for the blue lunch box. Fix the lid with your left hand and grasp it with your right hand, pulling it upwards to separate it from the transparent container. Put the lid aside.
zh: 伸手去拿蓝色饭盒。左手固定盖子右手抓住盖子并向上拉，将其与透明容器分开。把盖子放在一边。

en: Remove the lid from the transparent rectangular lunch box placed in the center of the blue tablecloth.

Approach the lunch box from both sides with both hands. Grasp the left edge of the lid with your left hand and lift it up with your right hand to make it completely separate. Move the lid horizontally to the right and then place it flat on the table beside the opened container.
zh: 从放在蓝色桌布中央的透明长方形饭盒上取下盖子。
用双手从两侧靠近饭盒，左手抓住盖子的左侧边缘，右手将盖子向上抬起，使其完全分离。将盖子向右横向移动，然后平放在打开的容器旁边的桌面上。

en: Bring your hands close to the lunch box from both sides. Place your left hand on the left edge of the lid and your right hand on the right edge. Press slightly downward to maintain stability, and then use the coordinated force of both hands to lift the box lid vertically upwards.
zh: 双手从两侧靠近饭盒，将左手放在盒盖左侧边缘，右手靠近盒盖右侧边缘。稍微向下按压以保持稳定，然后用双手协调的力量将盒盖垂直向上掀起。

en: Reach out both hands towards the lunch box. Grasp the left side of the lid with your left hand and bring your right hand close to the right side. Apply a coordinated upward pressure to separate the lid from the box body.
zh: 双手伸向便当盒。用左手抓住盖子的左边，右手靠近盖子的右边。施加协调的向上压力，将盖子从盒身分离。

en: Open the lunch box and remove the lid from the container.
Reach for the closed lunch box with your left hand and grasp the edge of the lid with your right hand. Pull the lid vertically upwards to separate it from the bottom and place it on the table.
zh: 打开午餐盒，将盖子从容器上取下。
左手去拿关闭的饭盒，右手抓住盖子的边缘。将盖子垂直向上拉开，使其与底部分离，并放在桌面上。

en: Open the closed bento box and separate the lid from the bottom.
Reach into the lunch box, fix the lid with your left hand and grasp the edge of the blue lid with your right hand. Lift the lid vertically to separate it from the base, and then set it aside.
zh: 打开闭合的便当盒，将盖子从底部分离。
伸手向午餐盒，用左手固定盖子右手抓住蓝色盖子的边缘，垂直提起盖子使其与底座分离，然后将其放在一旁。

en: Remove the lid from the transparent rectangular bento box in the center of the blue table.

Bring your hands close to the lunch box from both sides. Fix the left side with your left hand and bring your right hand close to the right side of the lid. Lift the lid vertically upwards with your right hand, slide it horizontally to the right, and place it flat on the table beside the opened container.
zh: 从蓝色桌面中央的透明长方形便当盒上取下盖子。
用手从两侧靠近饭盒；左手固定左侧，右手靠近盖子的右侧。用右手将盖子垂直向上抬起，将盖子水平向右滑动，并将其平放在打开的容器旁边的桌面上。

en: Open the lunch box and remove the blue lid.
Reach into the container, fix the lid with your left hand and lift it vertically with your right hand to separate it from the base, then move the lid to the right.
zh: 打开午餐盒，拆下蓝色盖子。
伸手向容器，用左手固定盖子右手垂直提起盖子以将其与底座分离，并将盖子向右移动。

en: Fix the lid with your left hand and open the lid of a transparent rectangular bento box placed on the table with your right hand.
zh: 用左手固定盖子右手打开一个放在桌子上的透明长方形便当盒的盖子。

en: Open the notebook.
Open the yellow notebook with your left hand.
Open the yellow notebook on the table with your left hand.
zh: 把本子打开。
用左手把黄色本子翻开。
用左手把桌面上黄色本子翻开。

en: Open the white notebook.
Reach out your left hand towards the white notebook on the left side of the table and open the cover upwards.

Reach out your left hand towards the white notebook on the left side of the blue table. Hold the lower edge of the notebook cover. Lift the cover of the notebook to reveal the horizontal line paper inside. Make sure the cover is fully opened and placed flat on the table.
zh: 打开白色笔记本。
左手伸向桌子左侧的白色笔记本，向上翻开封面。
用左手伸向蓝色桌子左侧的白色笔记本。握住笔记本封面的下边缘。掀起笔记本封面，露出里面的横线纸。确保封面完全翻开并平放在桌面上。

en: Open the notebook.
Open the yellow notebook with your right hand.
Open the yellow notebook on the table with your right hand.
zh: 把本子翻开。
用右手把黄色本子翻开。
用右手把桌面上的黄色本子翻开。

en: Open the notebook.
The left hand opens the yellow notebook.
Lift the cover of the notebook with your left hand.
zh: 翻开本子。
左手翻开黄色的本。
用左手掀开笔记本的封面。

en: Open the notebook.
Reach out your left hand towards the notebook on the left side of the table, open the cover, and reveal the paper inside.
Stretch your left hand towards the notebook on the left side of the table. Hold the lower edge of the binder cover. Lift the cover and flip it upwards to reveal the white paper inside.
zh: 打开笔记本。
左手伸向桌子左侧的笔记本，翻开封面，露出里面的纸张。
左手伸向桌子左侧的笔记本。握住活页夹封面的下边缘。抬起封面并向上翻开，露出里面的白纸。

en: Open the loose-leaf notebook.
The left hand lifts the loose-leaf book.
The left hand lifted the loose-leaf book on the table
zh: 掀开活页本。
左手掀开活页本。
左手掀开桌上的活页本

en: Open the notebook.
Open the yellow notebook with your right hand.
Open the yellow notebook on the table with your right hand.
zh: 把本子翻开。
用右手把黄色本子翻开。
用右手把桌面上的黄色本子翻开。

en: Open the loose-leaf book.
Open the loose-leaf book with your left hand.
Open the notebook on the table with your left hand
zh: 把活页本打开。
左手把活页本打开。
左手把桌上的页本打开

en: Open the notebook.
Open the notebook with your left hand.
Open the notebook on the left side of the table with your left hand.
zh: 打开笔记本。
左手打开笔记本。
用左手打开桌子左侧的笔记本。

en: Open the notebook.
Open the yellow notebook by hand.
Open the yellow notebook on the table with your right hand.
zh: 把本子翻开。
用手把黄色本子翻开。
用右手把桌面上的黄色本子翻开。

en: Open the notebook.
Open the notebook with your left hand.
Open the cover of the notebook on the left side of the table with your left hand.
zh: 打开笔记本。
用左手翻开笔记本。
左手翻开桌子左侧的笔记本封面。

en: Open the loose-leaf notebook.
The left hand opened the loose-leaf book on the table.
Open the loose-leaf book on the left side of the desktop with your left hand.
zh: 翻开活页本。
左手翻开桌上的活页本。
用左手翻开桌面左侧的活页本。

en: Open the stationery bag.
Hold the stationery bag in your left hand, unzip the red zipper with your right hand, and then open the bag opening.
zh: 打开文具袋。
左手拿文具袋，右手解红色拉链，然后展开袋口。

en: Hold the stationery bag in your left hand, unzip the red zipper with your right hand, and then open the bag opening.
zh: 左手拿文具袋，右手解红色拉链，然后展开袋口。

en: Open the transparent grid stationery bag by sliding the red zipper track.
Hold the stationery bag in your right hand, unzip the red zipper with your left hand, and then open the bag opening.
zh: 通过滑动红色拉链轨道打开透明的网格文具袋。
右手拿文具袋，左手解红色拉链，然后展开袋口。

en: Open a transparent stationery bag with a red zipper.
Hold a transparent stationery bag on the left side of the pink table with your right hand and pull the red zipper from right to left with your left hand.
zh: 打开一个带有红色拉链的透明文具袋。
右手稳住粉色桌子中左侧的一个透明文具袋，并用左手将红色的拉链头从右向左拉。

en: Unzip the red zipper and open a grid stationery bag.
Fix the transparent grid stationery bag with your right hand and hold and pull the red pull at the top with your left hand.
zh: 拉开红色拉链，打开一个网格文具袋。
右手固定透明网格文具袋，左手捏住并拉动顶部的红色拉头。

en: Open the white transparent bag and operate on its red seal.
Grasp the red closing button with your right hand and pull it apart to separate the two sides of the mesh, revealing the interior of the stationery bag.
zh: 打开白色透明袋，操作其红色封口。
右手抓住红色的闭合扣，将其拉开以分开网状两侧，显示出文具袋的内部。

en: Open a red-zipped grid stationery bag on the pink table.
Grasp the red zipper of the white grid stationery bag with your left hand and unzip it, while securing the bag with your right hand.
zh: 在粉色桌子上打开一个红色拉链的网格文具袋。
左手抓握白色网格文具袋的红色拉链并将其拉开，同时用右手固定住袋子。

en: Pull the zipper to open the stationery bag
Hold the grid stationery bag steadily with your right hand and pull the zipper with your left hand.
zh: 拉动拉链打开文具袋。
右手稳住网格文具袋，左手拉动拉链。

en: Pull the red zipper from left to right to open the stationery bag.
Hold the zipper pull with your left hand, press the right side of the stationery bag with your right hand to secure it, and at the same time, unzip it.
zh: 从左向右拉动红色拉链头，打开文具袋。
左手捏住拉链头，右手按住文具袋右侧以固定，同时将拉链拉开。

en: Unzip the red zipper and open a transparent stationery bag.
Hold the red zipper pull of the transparent bag on the pink table with your left hand and slide the zipper from left to right to open it.
zh: 拉开红色拉链，打开一个透明文具袋。
左手握住粉色桌面上透明袋子的红色拉链头，将拉链从左向右滑动以将其打开。

en: Open the closed stationery bag by sliding the zipper.
Fix the stationery bag with your right hand and hold the zipper pull with your left hand to open the closed stationery bag.
zh: 通过滑动拉链打开封闭的文具袋。
右手固定文具袋，左手抓住拉链拉头打开封闭的文具袋。

en: Slide the red zipper pull from right to left to open a white grid stationery bag.
Slide the red zipper pull from right to left with your left hand to open a white grid stationery bag.
zh: 将红色拉链头从右向左滑动，打开一个白色网格文具袋。
左手将红色拉链头从右向左滑动，打开一个白色网格文具袋。

en: Open the toothpaste cap.

Pick up the toothpaste in front of the nylon rope with your right hand and move it to your chest. Open the toothpaste cap with your left hand, and then put the toothpaste back on the table with your right hand.
zh: 打开牙膏盖。
右手拿起尼龙绳前方的牙膏并移动到胸前，左手把牙膏盖打开，然后右手把牙膏放回桌子上。

en: Open the toothpaste.
Pick up the toothpaste with your right hand and move it to your chest. Open the toothpaste cap with your left hand and then put the toothpaste back on the table with your right hand.
zh: 打开牙膏。
右手拿起牙膏并移动到胸前，左手把牙膏盖打开，然后右手把牙膏放回桌子上。

task_name: Play the Drum with a Drumstick

en: Hit the central drum twice with a drumstick.

Take the drumstick on the right side of the table with your right hand. Move it towards the red and white round drum at the center. Strike the drum surface twice and then put the drumsticks back in their original positions.
zh: 用鼓棒击打中央鼓两次。
右手拿取桌面右侧的鼓棒。将其移向中心的红白相间圆鼓。敲击鼓面两次，然后将鼓棒放回原位。

task_name: Play the Drum with a Drumstick

en: Pick up the drumsticks, strike them repeatedly, and then put the drumsticks back on the table.

Hold the wooden drumsticks from the checkered tablecloth with both hands respectively, rhythmically strike the white surface of the central red drum, then put it back in its original position, and finally release both hands.

Hold the drumstick on the left with your left hand and the one on the right with your right hand. Lift the two drumsticks towards the red drum located in the center. Strike the white circular drum surface rhythmically and repeatedly. Pull the drumsticks back from the drum skin. Put the drumsticks back to their original positions on the table. Release the two drumsticks and draw your hands back to your sides.
zh: 拿起鼓棒，反复击鼓，然后将鼓棒放回桌上。
双手分别从格子桌布上握起木质鼓棒，有节奏地敲击中央红鼓的白色鼓面，再将其放回原位，最后松开双手。
用左手握住左边的鼓棒，右手握住右边的鼓棒。将两根鼓棒朝向位于中心的红鼓抬起。有节奏地多次敲击鼓的白色圆形鼓面。将鼓棒从鼓皮上收回。将鼓棒放回桌上的原位。松开两根鼓棒，将双手缩回身体两侧。

task_name: Play the Drum with a Drumstick

en: Pick up the drumsticks and hit the drum a few times.

Take the wooden drumstick on the right side of the table with your right hand. Hold the drumsticks and strike the center of the white drum surface twice. Put the drumsticks back to their original positions.

Reach the wooden drumstick on the right side of the table with your right hand. Hold the drumstick tightly and pick it up. Move towards the red drum located in the center. Strike the drum surface twice with a drumstick. Lower your hands and put the drumsticks back on the right side of the table. After the drumsticks are firmly placed on the table, release your hand.
zh: 拿起鼓棒，敲了几下鼓。
用右手拿取桌子右侧的木质鼓棒。握住鼓棒，敲击白色鼓面中心二次。将鼓棒放回原位。
用右手够向桌面右侧的木制鼓棒。紧紧握住鼓棒并将其拿起。移向位于中央的红鼓。用鼓棒敲击鼓面二次。垂下手，将鼓棒放回桌面右侧。待鼓棒放稳在桌面后，松开手。

task_name: Play the Drum with a Drumstick

en: Pick up the drumsticks and hit the drum five times.

Hold the wooden drumstick on the right side of the green grid table with your right hand. Move it towards the red and white drum located in the center. Strike the white surface of the drum many times.

Hold the drumstick tightly with your right hand. Raise the drumsticks. Move it towards the center. Place the drumsticks above the red and white drum. The white surface of the drum is repeatedly struck. Move the drumsticks back to the right side of the table.
zh: 拿起鼓棒，敲五下鼓。
用右手握住绿色网格桌右侧的木质鼓棒。将其移向位于中央的红白相间的鼓。敲击鼓的白色表面多次。
用右手拿取握紧鼓棒。举起鼓棒。将其移向中心。将鼓棒置于红白相间的鼓上方。反复敲击鼓的白色表面。将鼓棒移回桌子右侧。

task_name: Play the Drum with a Drumstick

en: Pick up the drumsticks, tap the drum a few times, and then put the drumsticks back in their place.
Take the wooden drumstick on the right side of the green checkered table with your right hand, hold it, and use it to strike the red and white drum located at the center.

Take the wooden drumstick located on the right side of the green checkered table with your right hand. Hold the drumsticks and lift them upwards. Move the drumsticks above the red and white drum located in the center. Tap the white drum surface several times with the top of the drumstick. Put the drumsticks back on the table on the right.
zh: 拿起鼓棒，敲击几下鼓，然后将鼓棒放回原处。
用右手拿取绿色格子桌右侧的木质鼓棒，将其握住，并用它敲击位于中心位置的红白相间的鼓。
用右手拿取位于绿色格子桌右侧的木制鼓棒。握住鼓棒并将其向上举起。将鼓棒移至位于中央的红白相间的鼓上方。用鼓棒顶端敲击白色鼓面数次。将鼓棒放回右侧的桌面。

task_name: Play the Drum with a Drumstick

en: Pick up two wooden sticks and rhythmically strike the drum in the center of the table.
Hold the two wooden drumsticks on both sides of the red and white drum with both hands, repeatedly strike the drum surface, and then place it back on the green checkered tablecloth.

Reach the wooden drumsticks on the left and right sides of the red drum with both hands. Hold the drumsticks tightly. Raise the two drumsticks above the center of the white drum surface. Repeatedly strike the drum surface with alternating movements. Put the drumsticks back to their original positions on the surface of the green grid. Let go of your hands and remove them from the object.
zh: 拿起两根木棍，有节奏地敲击着桌子中央的鼓。
用双手握住红白相间的鼓左右两侧的两根木质鼓棒，反复敲击鼓面，随后将其放回绿色的格子桌布上。
用双手够向位于红色鼓左右两侧的木质鼓棒。紧紧握住鼓棒。将两根鼓棒举到白色鼓面中心上方。以交替的动作反复敲击鼓面。将鼓棒放回绿色格子表面的原位。松开手，将双手从物体上移开。

task_name: Play the Drum with a Drumstick

en: Pick up two drumsticks, strike the snare drum at the center of the table, and then put them back.

Pick up the left and right drumsticks from the green square table with both hands. Alternately strike the white drumhead of the small red-edged drum located in the center. Put the drumsticks back to their original positions and release them.

Reach for the drumstick on the left side of the table with your left hand and take the drumstick on the right side with your right hand. Hold the two drumsticks tightly. Raise the drumsticks and strike the white center of the red-edged drum in an alternating rhythm. Repeat the drumming action many times. Lower your hands to the table. Put the drumsticks back to their initial positions on the surface of the green grid. Release your hands and move them away from the center.
zh: 拿起两根鼓棒，敲击桌子中央的小鼓，然后将其放回。
用双手从绿色方格桌面上拿起左右鼓棒。交替敲击位于中央的红边小鼓的白色鼓面。将鼓棒放回原位并松开。
用左手伸手拿取桌子左侧的鼓棒，用右手拿取右侧的鼓棒。紧紧握住两根鼓棒。举起鼓棒，以交替的节奏敲击红边鼓的白色中心。重复多次击鼓动作。将双手放低至桌面。将鼓棒放回绿色格子表面上的初始位置。松开手，将双手移离中心。

task_name: Play the Drum with a Drumstick

en: Pick up the drumsticks and hit the red drum, then place the drumsticks on the silver plate.

Take the wooden drumstick on the right side of the table with your right hand. Hold the drumsticks and strike them several times in the center of the red drum surface. Put the drumsticks into the silver metal tray and release your hand.

Take the wooden drumstick on the right side of the green checkered table with your right hand. Hold the drumstick firmly and lift it up. Move the drumsticks above the white drumhead of the central red drum. Strike the drum surface many times. Move the drumsticks to the rectangular silver tray on the right. Place the drumsticks on the tray and release your hand. Bring your hand back to the starting position on the right side.
zh: 拿起鼓棒敲击红鼓，然后将鼓棒放在银盘上。
用右手拿取桌子右侧的木质鼓棒。握住鼓棒，在红色鼓面中心多次敲击。将鼓棒放入银色金属托盘并松开手。
用右手拿取绿色格子桌子右侧的木质鼓棒。牢牢握住鼓棒并将其举起。将鼓棒移至中心红色鼓的白色鼓面上方。多次敲击鼓面。将鼓棒移向右侧的长方形银色托盘。将鼓棒放在托盘上并松开手。将手收回到右侧的起始位置。

task_name: Play the Drum with a Drumstick

en: Pick up the drumsticks and strike the drum a few times.
Pick up the wooden drumstick on the left side of the grid table with your left hand, hold it, and use it to strike the center of the red and white drum twice.

Reach with your left hand for the wooden drumstick located on the left side of the table. Grasp the drumstick firmly and pick it up. Move the drumstick toward the red and white drum placed in the center of the table. Strike the drum surface once downward. Lift the drumstick slightly and strike the drum a second time. Keep your grip and return the drumstick to the left side of the table.
zh: 拿起鼓槌，敲击了几下鼓。
用左手拿起格子桌左侧的木质鼓棒，握住它，并用它敲击红白相间鼓的中心两次。
用左手够向位于桌子左侧的木制鼓棒。握紧鼓棒并将其拿起。将鼓棒移向位于桌子中央的红白相间的鼓。向下击打一次鼓面。稍微抬起鼓棒，第二次击打鼓。保持握姿，将鼓棒移回桌子左侧。

task_name: Play the Drum with a Drumstick

en: Strike a red and white drum with two wooden drumsticks.
Pick up two wooden drumsticks from the green grid table with your left hand, strike the white surface of the red drum in the center, and then put the drumsticks back to their original positions.

Reach your left hand toward the wooden drumstick on the left side. Reach your right hand toward the wooden drumstick on the right side. Grasp both drumsticks and raise them toward the red small drum located at the center of the green checkered table. Use the drumsticks to alternately strike the white drumhead repeatedly. Place both drumsticks back on the table. Release the wooden drumsticks and retract both hands to your sides.
zh: 用两根木质鼓槌敲击一面红白相间的鼓。
用左手从绿格子桌面上拿起两根木质鼓棒，敲击中央红鼓的白色鼓面，再将鼓棒放回原处。
左手伸向左侧的木质鼓棒。右手伸向右侧的木质鼓棒。握住两根鼓棒，将其举向位于绿格子桌面中央的红色小鼓。用鼓棒以交替的方式重复敲击鼓的白色鼓面。将两根鼓棒放回桌面。松开木质鼓棒，双手收回至两侧。

task_name: Play the Drum with a Drumstick

en: Hit the drum with two wooden drumsticks.

Pick up two wooden drumsticks from the green checkered tablecloth with both hands and strike the white surface of the middle red drum alternately and synchronously multiple times. Finally, put the drumsticks back in their original positions.

Pick up the wooden drumsticks located in the left and right front of the green checkered tablecloth with both hands. Hold the drumstick and lift it towards the center. Place the tip of the stick above the white surface of the red drum. Alternate hitting the center position with the right and left sticks several times. Put the drumsticks back to their original positions on the table and release them.
zh: 用两根木制鼓槌击鼓。
用双手从绿色格子桌布上拿起两根木制鼓棒，以交替和同步的动作多次敲击中间红色鼓的白色鼓面，最后将鼓棒放回原位。
用左右手拿起位于绿色格子桌布左前方和右前方的木质鼓棒。握住鼓棒并将其向中心抬起。将棒尖置于红色鼓的白色鼓面上方。用右棒和左棒交替击打中心位置数次。将鼓棒放回桌面上的原始位置并松开。

task_name: Play the Drum with a Drumstick

en: Pick up the drumsticks, repeatedly strike the drumhead, and then place them on the metal tray.

Reach out with your right hand to take the drumstick located on the right side of the red and white drum, hold it, and strike the center of the drum surface several times. Put the drumsticks back on the metal tray.

Reach out your right hand towards the drumstick located beneath the metal tray. Hold the drumstick firmly and lift it up. Move the drumsticks to the center of the table above the white drumhead. Tap the drum surface rhythmically and repeatedly. Move your right hand back to the metal tray on the right side. Place the drumsticks on the tray. Let go of your hand and take it back.
zh: 拿起鼓棒，反复敲击鼓面，然后将其放到金属托盘上。
用右手伸手拿取位于红白相间的鼓右侧的鼓棒，握住它，并敲击鼓面中心数次。将鼓棒放回金属托盘上。
用右手伸向位于金属托盘下方的鼓棒。牢牢握住鼓棒并将其举起。将鼓棒移向白色鼓面上方桌子的中心位置。有节奏地反复敲击鼓面。将右手移回右侧的金属托盘方向。将鼓棒放在托盘上。松开手并收回。

en: Pour water into the cup.
Pick up the mineral water bottle with your right hand and pour water into the paper cup.
zh: 往杯子里倒水。
用右手拿起矿泉水瓶往纸杯里倒水。

en: Pour water from the plastic bottle into the white cup.
Hold the transparent plastic bottle on the right side of the table with your right hand. Pour the liquid into the white cup in the center.
zh: 将水从塑料瓶倒入白色的杯子。
右手握住桌子右侧的透明塑料瓶。向位于中央的白色杯子中倒入液体。

en: Pour water from the bottle into the cup.
Pick up the bottle filled with water on the left side of the table with your left hand and pour water into the small white cup on the left.

Reach for the bottle filled with water on the far left with your left hand. Pick it up from the desktop. Move the bottle above the small white cup on the table and tilt the bottle to pour water inward.
zh: 将水从瓶中倒入杯中。
左手拿起桌子左侧装满水的瓶子，向位于左侧的白色小杯中倒水。
用左手伸向最左侧装满水的瓶子。将其从桌面上拿起。将瓶子移至桌面上的小白杯上方，倾斜瓶身向内倒水。

en: Pour the cola into the paper cup.
Pour the cola into the paper cup with your right hand.
Pick up the cola bottle with your right hand and pour the cola into the paper cup.
zh: 把可乐倒入纸杯中。

task_name: Push the Ball into the Box

en: Push the yellow tennis ball into the black box.

Stretch out your left hand towards the yellow tennis ball. Touch the ball and steadily push it towards the black box on the left side of the table. Guide the ball until it rolls over the opening and remains in the box. After completing the task, bring your hand back to the original position on the left side of the screen.
zh: 将黄色的网球推入黑色的盒子。
向黄色网球伸出左手。接触球并将其平稳地推向桌面中左侧的黑色盒子。引导球直到它滚过开口并留在盒子内。任务完成后，将手收回到画面左侧的原始位置。

task_name: Push the Ball into the Box

en: Push the yellow tennis ball over the table and into the black box.

Stretch out your right hand towards the yellow tennis ball on the table. Place your right hand behind the ball to establish contact. Push the yellow tennis ball through the grid-like surface and move it towards the open black box. Make sure the ball rolls completely into the box.
zh: 将黄色的网球推过桌面并推入黑色的盒子。
伸右手向位于桌面上的黄色网球。将右手置于球后以建立接触。推动黄色网球穿过格子状表面，向开口的黑色盒子移动。确保球完全滚入盒中。

task_name: Push the Ball into the Box

en: Push the yellow ball on the table into the black box.
Reach out to a yellow ball on the green square table with your left hand and push it into the black box.
zh: 将桌上的黄球推入黑盒子里。
用左手伸向绿色方格桌上的一个黄球，并将其推入黑色方盒中。

task_name: Push the Ball into the Box

en: Push the yellow ball into the black box.
Push a yellow ball on the left side of the checkerboard table towards the black cubic box in the center.
Stretch out your left hand towards the yellow tennis ball. Touch the ball and steadily push it towards the black box in the center of the table. Guide the ball until it rolls into the box.
zh: 将黄球推入黑盒。
将位于棋盘格桌子左侧的一个黄球推向位于中央的黑色立方体盒子。
向黄色网球伸出左手。接触球并将其平稳地推向桌面中央的黑色盒子。引导球直到它滚到盒子内。

task_name: Push the Ball into the Box

Move the yellow tennis ball in the center of the table to the open black box on the right.

Stretch your right hand towards the yellow tennis ball in the center of the table. Touch the ball and push it along the table towards the open black box on the right side. Guide the ball into the interior of the box. Pull your hand back from the box and move it to the right side of the desktop.
zh: 将黄色网球推入黑盒子里。
将桌子中央的黄色网球移动到右侧敞开的黑色盒子中。
用右手伸向桌面中央的黄色网球。触碰球并将其沿桌面推向右侧敞开的黑色盒子。将球引导进盒子内部。将手从盒子处收回，移向桌面右侧。

task_name: Push the Ball into the Box

en: On the checkered table, push the yellow tennis ball into the black box.
Push a yellow ball on the left side of the checkerboard table towards the cubic box in the center.

Stretch your left hand towards the small yellow tennis ball on the left side of the table. Touch the ball and start rolling it forward. Guide the ball through the green square surface and move it towards the black box located in the middle area. Apply continuous and steady force until the ball rolls into the box.
zh: 在格纹桌面上，将黄色网球推入黑盒子中。
将位于棋盘格桌子左侧的一个黄球推向位于中央的立方体盒子。

task_name: Push the Ball into the Box

Stretch out your left hand towards the yellow tennis ball on the left side of the green checkered tablecloth. Touch the side of the ball. Slide the ball along the table towards the opening on the front of the black box. Push the ball completely into the box. Bring your left hand back to the starting position on the left side of the picture.
zh: 将黄色网球推入桌上的黑色盒子里。
伸左手够向绿色方格桌子左侧的黄色网球，并将其推入位于中央的小黑盒开口内。

task_name: Push the Ball into the Box

用左手伸向黄色球。接触球。将其推过格子桌布，移向黑盒。引导球直到它进入黑盒的开口侧。一旦球成功放入，将手从盒中收回。

task_name: Push the Ball into the Box

task_name: Push the Ball into the Box

en: Push the yellow ball into the open box.
Push the yellow tennis ball near the center of the desktop towards the black box on the right. Push the ball into the box on the right and withdraw your hand from the working area.

Extend your right hand towards the yellow ball in the center of the table. Place your hand behind the ball and steadily push it towards an open black box on the right side. Guide the ball until it rolls into the container. Bring your right hand back to its original position while keeping your left hand still on the left side of the table.

右手伸向桌面中央的黄球。将手置于球后，平稳地将其推向右侧的一个开口黑盒。引导球直到它滚入容器。将右手收回原位，同时左手保持静止在桌面左侧。

task_name: Push the Ball into the Box

Stretch your right hand towards the yellow tennis ball in the center of the table. Push the ball along the table towards the black box. Guide the ball through the opening into the interior of the container. After the ball is securely placed, withdraw your right hand from the box.

task_name: Push the Ball into the Box

en: Push the yellow tennis ball into the black box.
Use your left hand to push a yellow tennis ball on the left side of the square table into the black box near the center.

Stretch your left hand towards the yellow tennis ball on the left side of the table. Touch the side of the ball and steadily push it towards the black box in the center of the table. Guide the ball until it is completely inside the opening of the black box. Bring your left hand back to the starting position on the far left. Keep your right hand still throughout the process.
zh: 将黄色网球推入黑盒。
用左手将位于方格桌左侧的一个黄色网球推入位于中心附近的黑盒子里。

task_name: Push the Block with a Marker

en: Push a white cube on the desktop with a red and white marker pen.
Hold the red and white marker on the right side of the blue table. Use a marker to push the white cube to the left and then release it.

Reach out your right hand towards the red and white marker pen on the right side of the table. Hold the marker pen and slide it to the left to touch the right side of the white cube. Push the cube to move left along the desktop surface. Retrieve the marker pen and place it back on the right side of the desktop. Release the grip and remove your hand from the marker pen.
zh: 用一支红白相间的记号笔在桌面上推一个白色的立方体。
握住蓝色桌子右侧的红白相间记号笔。使用记号笔将白色立方体向左推，然后将其松开。
用右手伸向桌面右侧的红白相间的记号笔。握住记号笔并将其向左滑动，使其接触到白色立方体的右侧。推动立方体沿桌面表面向左移动。收回记号笔并将其放回桌面右侧。松开抓握并将手从记号笔上移开。

task_name: Push the Block with a Marker

en: Push a light blue cube on the table with a red marker.

Pick up a red marker from the right side of the blue table. Use this marker pen to push a light blue cube from the center of the table to the left. After the cube has moved, put the marker back on the table.

Reach the red marker on the right side of the blue table with your right hand. Hold the marker firmly and lift it up. Move the marker pen to the light blue square located in the center of the desktop. Press the body of the marker pen against the right side of the blue square. Push the marker to the left to make the square slide on the desktop. Put the marker pen back on the table and let go.
zh: 用一支红色马克笔在桌面上推动一个浅蓝色的立方体。
从蓝色桌子的右侧拿起一支红色马克笔。使用这支马克笔将一个浅蓝色立方体从桌子中心推向左侧。在立方体移动后，将马克笔放回桌上。
用右手够向蓝色桌子右侧的红色马克笔。牢牢握住马克笔并将其举起。将马克笔移向位于桌面中央的浅蓝色方块。将马克笔笔身抵在蓝色方块的右侧面。向左推动马克笔，使方块在桌面上滑动。将马克笔放回桌上并松开手。

task_name: Push the Block with a Marker

en: A light blue cube is pushed on the table with a red marker held in the right hand.
Use a red and white marker pen to push a small light blue cube from the center of the blue table to the left.

Hold the red and white marker pen with your right hand. Move your hand towards the light blue cube located in the center of the desktop. Press the tip of the marker pen against the right side of the cube. Apply force forward and to the left to make the cube slide on the table. Keep in contact with the cube until it reaches the position close to the yellow wrap on the left. Bring your hand and marker back to the right side of the desktop.
zh: 用右手握着的红色马克笔在桌面上推动一个浅蓝色立方体。
使用一支红白相间的记号笔，将一个浅蓝色的小立方体从蓝色桌子的中心推向左侧。
用右手握住红白相间的记号笔。将手移向位于桌面中央的浅蓝色立方体。将记号笔的笔尖抵住立方体的右侧。向前和向左施力，使立方体在桌面滑动。保持与立方体的接触，直到它到达靠近左侧黄色包裹的位置。将手和记号笔收回到桌面的右侧。

task_name: Push the Block with a Marker

en: Holding a red marker pen in his right hand, he pushed a light blue cube on the table.

Reach out your right hand to pick up a red marker pen on the right side of the blue table. Use this marker pen to push the light blue cube in the center to the left, then put the marker pen back in place and retracted.

Stretch your right hand towards the red marker on the right side of the blue table. Grab the marker pen and raise it to a horizontal position. Move the marker pen to the center of the desktop so that it touches the right side of the light blue square. Use the tip of the marker pen to push the square along the desktop to the left. Withdraw the marker pen from the square and place it back on the right side of the table. Release the grip and withdraw your hand.
zh: 右手握着一支红色记号笔，在桌面上推一个浅蓝色的立方体。
伸右手拿取蓝色桌子右侧的一支红色记号笔。用这支记号笔将中心的一个浅蓝色立方体向左推，然后将记号笔放回原处并缩回。
用右手伸向蓝色桌子右侧的红色记号笔。抓取记号笔并将其举至水平位置。将记号笔移向桌面中央，使其接触浅蓝色方块的右侧。用记号笔尖端将方块沿桌面推向左侧。将记号笔从方块处撤回，并放回桌子右侧。松开抓取并收回手。

task_name: Push the Block with a Marker

Grab the red and white marker pen on the far right of the blue table and use it to slide the light blue cube towards the center.

Reach the red and white marker on the far right of the blue table with your right hand. Hold the marker pen firmly. Move the marker to the left so that it touches the right side of the light blue cube. Steadily push the cube towards the center of the desktop. Stop the lateral movement and release the marker.

task_name: Push the Block with a Marker

Reach the red marker on the right side of the table with your right hand. Hold the marker pen and press its tip against the right side of the light blue cube. Steadily push the cube along the desktop to the left. Withdraw the marker pen from the cube and move it to the right. Let go of your hand and put the marker back on the table.
zh: 用红色记号笔在桌面上推动一个浅蓝色立方体。
握住蓝色桌子右侧的一支红色马克笔，并将其作为工具将一个浅蓝色立方体向左推，然后将其松开。
用右手够向桌面右侧的红色记号笔。握住记号笔，将其笔尖抵住浅蓝色立方体的右侧。稳稳地将立方体沿桌面推向左侧。将记号笔从立方体处撤回并移向右侧。松开手，将记号笔放回桌面上。

task_name: Push the Block with a Marker

en: Push a light blue cube on the desktop with a red marker.
Reach out your right hand to pick up the red marker pen beside the light blue cube on the blue table. Hold the marker pen and use it to push the cube horizontally to the left side of the work area.

Extend your right hand to the red marker pen on the right side of the light blue cube. Hold the marker pen and operate it until the tip touches the right side of the cube. Apply a steady lateral pressure to push the light blue cube to the left side of the desktop. Keep the marker pen in contact with the cube throughout the sliding process. Once the cube is moved into position, retract your hand to the right side of the picture and lower the marker pen.
zh: 用红色记号笔在桌面上推动一个浅蓝色立方体。
伸右手拿取蓝色桌面上浅蓝色立方体旁的红色记号笔。握住记号笔，并用它将立方体水平推向工作区的左侧。
向位于浅蓝色立方体右侧的红色记号笔伸出右手。握住记号笔并进行操控，直到笔尖接触到立方体的右侧。施加稳定的侧向压力，将浅蓝色立方体推向桌面的左侧。在整个滑动过程中，保持记号笔与立方体接触。一旦立方体移动到位，就将手向画面右侧收回并放下记号笔。

task_name: Push the Block with a Marker

en: Push a light blue cube on the desktop with a red marker.
Push the light blue square in the center of the blue table with the red marker held in the right hand. Move the square to the left side of the table and then withdraw your hand.

Reach out your right hand towards the red marker on the right side of the blue table. Hold the marker pen and press its tip against the right side of the light blue cube. Push the marker to the left to make the cube slide along the table. Keep pushing the cube gently until it moves to the left side of the table. Pull the marker pen back from the cube. While holding the marker pen, withdraw your right hand to the right edge of the table and place the pen on the table.
zh: 用红色记号笔在桌面上推动一个浅蓝色立方体。
用右手握着的红色记号笔推动位于蓝色桌子中央的浅蓝色方块。将方块移至桌子左侧，然后收回手。
用右手伸向位于蓝色桌面右侧的红色记号笔。握住记号笔，将其笔尖抵住浅蓝色立方体的右侧。向左推动记号笔，使立方体沿桌面滑动。继续轻推立方体，直到它移动到了桌子左侧。将记号笔从立方体处收回，在保持握住记号笔的同时，将右手向桌子右边缘撤回并且把笔放在桌子上。

task_name: Push the Block with a Marker

en: Use a red and white marker pen to push a light blue cube on the desktop.

Use the red and white marker pen on the right side of the blue table to push a light blue cube to the left. Pick up the marker pen and touch the cube, then push the cube towards the center of the table.

Stretch your right hand towards the red and white marker on the right side of the table. Press your hand on the end of the marker and slide it towards the light blue cube at the center. Touch the side of the cube with the top of the marker. Push the marker and the cube together to the left side of the desktop. After moving the cube, bring your right hand back to the initial position on the far right and put down the pen.
zh: 使用一支红白相间的记号笔在桌面上推动一个浅蓝色的立方体。
利用蓝色桌子右侧的红白相间标记笔，将一个浅蓝色立方体向左推。拿起标记笔与立方体接触，随后将立方体推向桌子中央。
将右手伸向桌面右侧的红白相间标记物。将手按在标记物的末端，并将其滑向中心的浅蓝色立方体。用标记物的顶端接触立方体的侧面。将标记物和立方体一起推向桌面的左侧。移动立方体后，将右手收回到最右侧的初始位置并且放下笔。

task_name: Push the Block with a Marker

en: Push a light blue cube with a red marker.

Pick up the red marker pen from the right side of the blue table. Use a marker to push the light blue square in the middle right foreground towards the center. After withdrawing your hand, put the marker back on the table.

Stretch out your right hand towards the red marker on the right side of the blue table. Hold the marker tightly. Press the pen tip against the right side of the light blue cube. Push the light blue cube towards the center. Pull your hand back to the right. Put the marker pen on the table. Release your hand and bring it back to its original position.
zh: 用红色记号笔推动一个浅蓝色立方体。
从蓝色桌子的右侧拿起红色记号笔。用记号笔将位于中右侧前景的浅蓝色方块推向中间。收回手后将记号笔放回桌面。
伸右手向蓝色桌子右侧的红色马克笔。抓紧马克笔。将笔尖抵住浅蓝色立方体的右侧。将浅蓝色立方体推向中心。将手向右收回。将马克笔放在桌上。松开手并把手收回到原始位置。

task_name: Push the Block with a Marker

en: Push a light blue cube on the desktop with a white marker pen.
Use a white marker with a red cap to move a light blue cube from the right side of the blue table to the center.

Extend your right hand and move it towards the white marker pen with a red cap on the right half of the table. Touch the marker pen. Press the marker against the side of the light blue cube located in the middle right area. Push the light blue cube to the middle left until it reaches its final position. Release the marker. Withdraw your hand to the right side of the screen.
zh: 用一支白色记号笔在桌面上推动一个浅蓝色立方体。
使用一支带红盖的白色记号笔，将一个浅蓝色立方体从蓝色桌子的右侧移向中心。
伸右手移向桌子右半部分带红盖的白色记号笔。触碰记号笔。将记号笔贴靠在位于中右侧区域的浅蓝色立方体侧面。向左中方向推动浅蓝色立方体，直到其到达最终位置。松开记号笔。将手撤回至画面右侧。

task_name: Push the Block with a Marker

en: Push a white cube on the blue table with a red marker.

Grab the red marker pen located in the center of the blue table, right next to a small white square. Use this marker to push the square to the left side of the table, and then put the marker back in its original place.

Reach out your right hand towards the red marker pen on the right side of the white square on the blue table. Hold the marker pen firmly. Align the tip of the marker pen with the right side of the white square. Push the square steadily to the left side of the table. After the square reaches its new position, move the marker pen away. Put the marker back on the right side of the desktop. Pull your hand back to the edge of the table.
zh: 用红色记号笔在蓝色桌面上推一个白色立方体。
抓取位于蓝色桌子中央、紧邻一个小白色方块的红色记号笔。使用该记号笔将方块推向桌子左侧，然后将记号笔放回原处。
用右手伸向位于蓝色桌面上白色方块右侧的红色记号笔。牢牢握住记号笔。将记号笔尖对准白色方块的右侧面。稳稳地将方块推向桌子的左侧。待方块到达新位置后，将记号笔移开。将记号笔放回右侧桌面。将手收回到桌边。

en: Push the pink and white wet tissue box on the blue surface.
Slide your right hand upwards towards the pink and white wet tissue box in the lower half of the blue table, then withdraw your hand.
zh: 在蓝色表面上推动粉白相间的湿纸巾盒。
右手向蓝色桌子下半区域的粉白相间的湿纸巾盒，将其向上滑动，随后缩回手。

en: Push the yellow tape measure on the desktop.

Push the yellow tape measure on the left side of the blue table towards the center. Touch the object with your left hand and let it slide horizontally along the surface, then bring your left hand back to the stationary position.
zh: 在桌面上推黄色卷尺。
将位于蓝色桌子左侧的黄色卷尺推向中心。用左手接触并使物体沿表面水平滑动，然后将左手收回到静止位置。

en: Push the snack sticks wrapped in gold paper on the table one by one with both hands.
Use your left hand to push the rectangular snack bar wrapped in gold paper from the left side of the blue table to the center. Then push it to the right side of the table with your right hand.
zh: 双手依次在桌面上推动金纸包装的零食棒。
用左手将金纸包装的长方形零食棒从蓝色桌子的左侧推向中心。再用右手将其推向桌子右侧。

en: Push the golden-wrapped snack sticks across the blue table with both hands.
Push the golden-wrapped snack stick on the left side of the blue table towards the center with your left hand, and further move it to the right with your right hand.
zh: 双手推着金色包装的零食棒穿过蓝色桌面。
用左手将蓝色桌子左侧的金色包装的零食棒推向中心，并用右手将其进一步向右移动。

en: Push the snack cookies with both hands.

Use your left hand to reach the snack biscuit on the left and push it towards the center. Next, use your right hand to further push the snack cookies under the white container located at the top of the table.
zh: 用双手推零食饼干。
用左手够向左侧的零食饼干并将其推向中心。接着，用右手将零食饼干进一步推向位于桌面顶部的白色容器的下方。

en: Push the yellow snack stick over the table.
Take the yellow snack stick on the left side of the table with your left hand and push it towards the center. Then, continue to push it to the right near the plush toy with your right hand.
zh: 将黄色的零食棒推过桌面。
左手拿取桌子左侧的黄色零食棒，将其推向中心，右手随后继续向右推向毛绒玩具附近。

en: Push the blue and white plastic bag over the table.
Push the blue and white plastic bag on the right side of the blue table with your right hand. Push the bag towards the center and withdraw your hand.
zh: 将蓝白相间的塑料袋推过桌面。
右手去推位于蓝色桌子右侧的蓝白相间塑料袋。将袋子推向中心并收回手。

en: Push the small rectangular box across the table with both hands.
Push the pink and white rectangular box on the left side of the blue table towards the center with your left hand. Push the box further to the right with your right hand.
zh: 用双手推着小长方形盒子穿过桌面。
用左手将蓝色桌子左侧的粉白相间的长方形盒子推向中心。用右手将盒子进一步向右推。

en: Push the sponge on the table with both hands.
Push the green and yellow sponge located in the middle of the blue table. Slide it towards the middle with your left hand and push it further to the right with your right hand.
zh: 用双手在桌面上推海绵。
推位于蓝色桌子中间的绿黄相间的海绵。用左手将其滑向中间，并用右手将其进一步向右推。

en: Push the box.
Use your left hand to push the pink and white box on the left towards the center. Move your right hand and continue pushing the box to the right with your right hand.
zh: 推盒子。
用左手将左侧的粉白相间的盒子推向中心。移动右手，用右手继续将盒子向右推。

en: Both hands were pushing the white box on the table.

Use your left hand to push the white box with blue and red characters printed on the left side of the table towards the center. Push the box further to the right with your right hand, closer to the plush toy.
zh: 双手在桌面上推着白色盒子。
用左手将桌子左侧印有蓝红文字的白盒推向中心。用右手将该盒进一步向右推，靠近毛绒玩具。

en: Push the white rectangular box through the blue table one after another with both hands.
Move the white rectangular box from the left side of the blue table to the center with your left hand, and then push it further to the right towards the orange box with your right hand.
zh: 用双手先后推动白色长方形盒子穿过蓝色桌面。
用左手将白色长方形盒子从蓝色桌子的左侧移向中心，然后用右手将其进一步向右推向橙色盒子。

task_name: Push the Object onto the Specified Color Region

en: Push the blue box from the yellow pad to the green pad.
Move the small blue box from the yellow pad in the center to the green pad on the far left. Slide the object along the table with your left hand until it is within the green area.
zh: 将蓝色盒子从黄色垫子推到绿色垫子。
将蓝色小方盒从中央的黄色垫子移至最左侧的绿色垫子。用左手将物体沿桌面滑动，直到其位于绿色区域内。

task_name: Push the Object onto the Specified Color Region

en: Mobile cookie box.
Use your left hand to push the cookie box in the yellow area onto the pink area.
zh: 移动饼干盒。
用左手将黄色区域上的饼干盒推到粉红色区域上。

task_name: Push the Object onto the Specified Color Region

en: Push the rectangular cookie box on the pink area to the green area on the table with your right hand.
zh: 右手将粉红色区域上的长方形饼干盒推到桌子上的绿色区域上。

task_name: Push the Object onto the Specified Color Region

en: Take the small item on the yellow cloth in the middle with your left hand and slide it horizontally to the left until it is placed on the green area.
zh: 左手拿取中间黄色布上的小件物品，并将其水平向左滑动，直到放置在绿色区域上。

task_name: Push the Object onto the Specified Color Region

en: Push the small blue box from the yellow pad to the green pad with your left hand.
zh: 左手将小蓝盒子从黄色垫子推到绿色垫子。

task_name: Push the Object onto the Specified Color Region

en: Push the cookie box.
Push the cookie box on the green area with your right hand.
Use your right hand to push the blue cookie box in the green area onto the pink area.
zh: 推动饼干盒。
用右手推动绿色区域上的饼干盒。
用右手将绿色区域上的蓝色饼干盒推到粉红色区域上。

task_name: Push the Object onto the Specified Color Region

en: Push the biscuit box onto the yellow area.
Push the cookie box in the pink area onto the yellow area with your left hand.
zh: 把饼干盒推到黄色区域上。
用左手把粉红色区域上的饼干盒推到黄色区域上。

task_name: Push the Object onto the Specified Color Region

en: Mobile cookie box.
First, use your left hand to push the cookie box in the yellow area onto the pink area, and then use your right hand to push the cookie box onto the green area above the square box.
zh: 移动饼干盒。
先用左手将黄色区域上的饼干盒推到粉红色区域上，再用右手把饼干盒推到正方形盒子上方的绿色区域上。

task_name: Push the Object onto the Specified Color Region

en: First, push the hemp rope from the green area to the yellow area with your left hand, and then push it onto the red area with your right hand.
zh: 左手先将绿色区域上的麻绳推到黄色区域上，右手再将其推到红色区域上。

task_name: Push the Object onto the Specified Color Region

en: First, use your left hand to push the cookie box in the yellow area to the pink area, and then use your right hand to push the cookie box to the green area.
zh: 先用左手将黄色区域上的饼干盒推到粉红色区域上，再用右手将饼干盒推到绿色区域上。

task_name: Push the Object onto the Specified Color Region

en: Push the cookie box.
First, use your right hand to push the cookie box in the green area onto the pink area, and then use your left hand to push it onto the yellow area.
zh: 推动饼干盒。
先用右手将绿色区域上的饼干盒推到粉红色区域上，再用左手将饼干盒推到黄色区域上。

task_name: Push the Object onto the Specified Color Region

en: First, use your left hand to push the cookie box on the yellow area in front of the beverage bottle to the pink area in the middle of the table, and then use your right hand to push the cookie box to the green area.
zh: 先用左手将饮料瓶前方黄色区域上的饼干盒推到桌子中间的粉红色区域上，再用右手将饼干盒推到绿色区域上。

task_name: Put Items into the Paper Box

en: Put the bagged bread, toothbrush, data cable and a bunch of grapes on the table into the cardboard box one by one.
Put the bagged bread, toothbrush, data cable and a bunch of grapes on the table into the cardboard box in sequence and then into the box containing other items.

Use your right hand to place the bagged bread, toothbrush, data cable and a bunch of grapes on the table one by one into the cardboard box containing other items above the tape measure on the green table. After completion, the mechanical arm should return to its original position.
zh: 将桌子上的袋装面包、牙刷、数据线和一串葡萄依次放入纸箱中。
将桌子上的袋装面包、牙刷、数据线和一串葡萄依次放入纸箱中放入装有其他物品的箱子中。
用右手将桌子上的袋装面包、牙刷、数据线和一串葡萄依次放入青色桌子上卷尺上方装有其他物品的纸箱中，完成后机械臂归位。

task_name: Put Items into the Paper Box

en: Put a name tag with an orange lanyard into the cardboard box.
Reach out and take the name tag with an orange lanyard on the left side of the table, and put it into the cardboard box located in the center of the work area.

Stretch your left hand towards the name tag with an orange lanyard on the left side of the table. Grab the lanyard and lift it off the blue surface. Move the lanyard above the small cardboard box in the center. Put the lanyard and its label into the box. Adjust the position of the lanyard by hand to ensure it is placed securely. Release the grip. Bring your left hand back to the starting position on the left side of the desktop.
zh: 将一条带有橙色挂绳的工牌放入纸箱。
伸手拿取桌子左侧带有橙色挂绳的工牌，并将其放入位于工作区中心的纸箱中。
将左手伸向桌面左侧带有橙色挂绳的工牌。抓取挂绳并将其从蓝色表面提起。将挂绳移至中心的小纸箱上方。将挂绳及其标签放入箱内。用手调整挂绳的位置，以确保其放置稳妥。松开抓取。将左手收回至桌面左侧的起始位置。

task_name: Put Items into the Paper Box

en: Throw the mineral water into the box.
Throw the mineral water into the cardboard box with the left hand.
He grabbed the Wahaha mineral water on the table with his left hand and threw it into the open cardboard box.
zh: 把矿泉水扔进箱子里。
左手把矿泉水扔进纸箱子里。
左手抓起桌上的娃哈哈矿泉水将其扔进开口的纸箱内。

task_name: Put Items into the Paper Box

en: Throw the undrunk mineral water into the box.
The left hand threw the unfinished mineral water into the box.
The left hand threw the undrunk mineral water on the table into the open box.
zh: 把没喝完的矿泉水扔进箱子里。
左手把没喝完的矿泉水扔进箱子里。
左手将桌上没喝完的矿泉水扔进打开的箱子里。

task_name: Put Items into the Paper Box

en: Put the items on the table into the box.
Put the three items on the table into the yellow paper box.

First, use your right hand to move the paper box on the table to the middle of the table. Then, use your left hand to put the yellow scouring pad, building blocks and soap under the paper box one by one into the paper box.
zh: 把桌子上的物品放入盒子里。
将桌子上的三个物品放入黄色的纸盒里。
先用右手将桌子上的纸盒拿到桌子中间，再用左手依次将桌子上纸盒下方的黄色百洁布，积木和香皂放入纸盒里。

task_name: Put Items into the Paper Box

en: Put the mineral water into the paper box.
Put the mineral water into the paper box with your left hand.
Pick up the mineral water on the far left of the table with your left hand and put it into the yellow paper box on the left side of the white box.
zh: 把矿泉水放入纸盒里。
用左手把矿泉水放入纸盒里。
用左手拿起桌子最左边的矿泉水放入白色盒子左边的黄色纸盒里。

task_name: Put Items into the Paper Box

en: Put the snacks and the white and orange bags beside them into the cardboard box.
Put the snacks on the right side of the green ball on the right side of the box and the white and orange bag beside it into the cardboard box.

Use your right hand to put the snacks on the right side of the green ball on the right side of the box and the white and orange bag beside it into the cardboard box that already has a tape measure inside.
zh: 将零食和旁边的白橙袋子放入纸箱中。
将箱子右侧绿球右边的零食和其旁边的白橙袋子放入纸箱中。
用右手将箱子右侧绿球右边的零食和其旁边的白橙袋子放入本就有一个卷尺在其中的纸箱中。

task_name: Put Items into the Paper Box

en: Put the mineral water into the cardboard box.
Throw the mineral water into the paper box with your left hand.
Throw the mineral water into the paper box beside the correction tape on the blue table with your left hand.
zh: 把矿泉水放进纸箱。
用左手把矿泉水扔进纸盒子里。
用左手将矿泉水扔进蓝色桌子上涂改带旁边的纸盒子里。

task_name: Put Items into the Paper Box

en: Put the mineral water into the yellow paper box.
Put the mineral water into the rectangular paper box on the table with your left hand.
Pick up the mineral water on the table with your left hand and put it into the yellow paper box above the white paper cup.
zh: 将矿泉水放入黄色的纸盒里。
用左手把矿泉水放入桌子上的长方形纸盒里。
左手拿起桌子上的矿泉水放入白色纸杯上方的黄色纸盒里。

task_name: Put Items into the Paper Box

en: Put the three items into the paper box with the left hand.
Hold the paper box to the center of the table with your right hand, and put the plastic bottle, mineral water and sponge into the paper box respectively with your left hand.

With your right hand, take the cardboard box containing the small white box to the middle of the blue table. With your left hand, put the white plastic bottle, mineral water and sponge into the boxes on the blue table respectively.
zh: 左手将三个物品放进纸盒。
用右手把纸盒拿到桌子中央，用左手将塑料瓶，矿泉水，海绵分别放进纸盒中。

task_name: Put the Trash into the Trash Can

en: Put the garbage in the trash can.
Open the lid of the white trash can with your right hand, grab the green sponge on the table and put it into the trash can.
Reach into the white trash can and open the lid with your right hand. Reach for the green sponge on the table. Grab the sponge and lift it up. Throw the sponge into the open trash can.

用右手打开白色垃圾桶的盖子，抓住桌上的绿色海绵，把它放进垃圾桶里。
伸手向白色的垃圾桶，用右手打开盖子。伸手去拿桌上的绿色海绵。抓住海绵并提起。将海绵扔进打开的垃圾桶里。

task_name: Remove the Cap from the Plastic Bottle

en: Remove the green cap from the white plastic bottle.
Holding a white plastic bottle in the left hand and unscrewing the cap with the right hand.
Approach the white bottle from the side with your left hand, hold the bottle in place with your left hand, and rotate the bottle cap clockwise with your right hand to open it.
zh: 移除白色塑料瓶上的绿色瓶盖。
左手抓着白色塑料瓶，右手拧开瓶盖。
左手从侧面接近白色瓶子，左手固定瓶子，右手顺时针旋转打开瓶盖。

task_name: Remove the Cap from the Plastic Bottle

en: Remove the green cap from the white bottle in the center of the blue table.
The left hand is holding a white plastic bottle with red and green characters on it, located in the center of the blue table. Unscrew the bottle cap with your right hand.

Firmly press the bottom of the bottle against the table with your left hand, hold the bottle cap with your right hand and rotate it counterclockwise. After rotating it once, the bottle cap falls off and is placed on the table on the right side of the bottle. Throughout the entire process, the left hand should always hold the bottle firmly to prevent it from moving.
zh: 从蓝色桌子中央的白色瓶子上移除绿色瓶盖。
左手抓着一个白色塑料瓶，上面有红绿文字，位于蓝色桌面中央。用右手拧开瓶盖。
左手牢固地将瓶底压在桌面，右手握住瓶盖并逆时针旋转。旋转一周后，瓶盖脱落，并放在瓶子右侧的桌面上。整个过程中，左手始终稳稳地握住瓶子，防止其移动。

task_name: Remove the Cap from the Plastic Bottle

en: Remove the green cap from the white plastic bottle in the center of the blue table.

The left hand tightly holds the white cylindrical bottle located in the center of the blue table. The bottle cap is green and there are green and red labels on the bottle. Unscrew the bottle cap with your right hand and place it on the table.

Bring your left hand close to the bottle and wrap around it to secure it. Place your right hand above the green bottle cap, aligning your fingers with the edge of the cap. Apply a reverse rotational force, fix the bottle with your left hand, and unscrew the bottle cap by rotating counterclockwise with your right hand. Lift the unscrewed cap upwards and place it on the table on the right side of the bottle. Loosen the bottle and lay it down.
zh: 从蓝色桌子中央的白色塑料瓶上移去绿色瓶盖。
左手紧握位于蓝色桌子中央的白色圆柱形瓶子，瓶盖为绿色，瓶子上有绿色和红色的标签。右手拧下瓶盖放在桌子上。
用左手靠近瓶子，环绕瓶身以固定它。将右手放在绿色瓶盖上方，手指与瓶盖的棱边对齐。施加反向旋转力，左手固定瓶子，右手逆时针旋转旋开瓶盖。将旋下的瓶盖向上提起，放在瓶子右侧的桌子上。松开瓶子，放倒瓶身。

task_name: Remove the Cap from the Plastic Bottle

en: Open the green cap of a white bottle marked "AD Calcium", hold the bottle in place with your left hand, and unscrew and lift the cap with your right hand.

The white plastic bottle with a green label and a green screw cap is located in the center of the blue table. Hold the bottle body with your left hand and touch the cap directly with your right hand. Rotate it counterclockwise and lift it vertically upwards, then place it on the table.

Reach out your left hand towards the white bottle placed in the center of the blue table and hold the middle of the bottle to stabilize it. Place your right hand above the green bottle cap so that your fingers and palm are in full contact. While preventing the bottle from rotating with your left hand, apply counterclockwise force to the bottle cap to unscrew it. Lift the opened bottle cap vertically upwards with your right hand and place it on the table on the right side of the bottle.
zh: 打开一个标有“AD钙”的白色瓶子的绿色瓶盖，左手固定瓶子，右手拧开并提起瓶盖。
带有绿色标签和绿色旋盖的白色塑料瓶位于蓝色桌子的中央；左手抓住瓶子瓶身，右手直接接触瓶盖，逆时针旋转后将其垂直向上提起，放在桌面上。
用左手伸向放在蓝色桌子中央的白色瓶子，握住瓶子中部以使其稳定。将右手置于绿色瓶盖上方，使手指和手掌完全接触。在左手防止瓶子旋转的同时，对瓶盖施加逆时针的力以旋开瓶盖。用右手将打开的瓶盖垂直向上提起，并放在瓶子右侧的桌面。

task_name: Remove the Cap from the Plastic Bottle

en: Unscrew the cap from a transparent plastic bottle in the center of the blue table.
Grab a transparent plastic bottle with a white cap and a red and white label, located in the center of the blue table. Unscrew the slightly loose bottle cap.

Fix the bottle body with your left hand and rotate the cap counterclockwise with your right hand to unscrew it completely. Use your right hand to vertically remove the bottle cap from the bottle mouth and place it on the table on the right side of the bottle. After removing the bottle cap, release the grip on the bottle with your left hand.
zh: 从蓝色桌子中央的一个透明塑料瓶上拧下盖子。
抓住一个透明的塑料瓶，配有白色瓶盖和红白相间的标签，位于蓝色桌子的中央。拧下有些松动的瓶盖。
左手固定瓶身，右手逆时针旋转瓶盖，将其完全拧开。用右手将瓶盖垂直从瓶口取下，并放在瓶子右侧的桌面上。在移除瓶盖后，左手释放对瓶子的抓握。

task_name: Remove the Cap from the Plastic Bottle

en: Open the cap of a transparent plastic bottle.
Hold a transparent plastic bottle with a white cap and a red label in your left hand, stand it upright on a blue table, remove the white cap with your right hand and place it beside the bottle.

Hold the main body of the bottle firmly with your left hand and touch the white cap with your right hand. Rotate the bottle cap counterclockwise with your right hand while preventing the bottle from turning with your left hand. Remove the bottle cap vertically from the bottle mouth. Place the removed bottle cap on the table on the right side of the bottle. Put the bottle back on the table.
zh: 打开一个透明塑料瓶的瓶盖。
左手握住一个透明的塑料瓶，配有白色瓶盖和红色标签，直立在蓝色桌面上，右手将白色瓶盖取下后，放在瓶子旁边。
左手牢固地握住瓶子主体，右手接触白色瓶盖；右手逆时针旋转瓶盖，同时左手防止瓶子转动；将瓶盖垂直从瓶口取下；将拆下的瓶盖放在瓶子右侧的桌子上；将瓶子重新放回桌面。

task_name: Remove the Cap from the Plastic Bottle

en: Unscrew the cap from the transparent plastic bottle placed in the center of the blue table, fix it with both hands and rotate it.

The left hand tightly grasped the transparent bottle in the center of the blue table. The bottle cap was white and the label was red and white. Fix the bottle body with your left hand and rotate the cap counterclockwise with your right hand to unscrew it.

Wrap your left hand around the lower part of the bottle and firmly stabilize it. Place your right hand on the white bottle cap and apply counterclockwise torque, while your left hand resizes the rotational force. The bottle cap came loose and flew off the table. Release the bottle with your left hand to keep it upright and remove the cap.
zh: 从放在蓝色桌子中央的透明塑料瓶上拧下瓶盖，用双手固定并旋转。
左手紧握着蓝色桌子中央的透明瓶子，瓶盖是白色的，标签是红白相间的；左手固定瓶身，右手逆时针旋转瓶盖，将其旋开。
左手环绕瓶子下半部，牢固地稳定住瓶子。右手位于白色瓶盖上，施加逆时针扭矩，而左手则抵抗旋转力。瓶盖松脱飞出到桌面，左手松开瓶子，使瓶子保持直立且未盖瓶盖。

task_name: Remove the Cap from the Plastic Bottle

en: Unscrew the cap from the transparent plastic bottle placed in the center of the blue table.
Holding a transparent bottle with a red and white label in the left hand, grasping and unscrewing its white cap with the right hand, it is placed on the table.

Reach out your left hand towards the transparent bottle in the center of the table and fix it vertically. Place your right hand on the white bottle cap to establish contact. Apply reverse rotational torque: Fix the main body of the bottle with your left hand and rotate the bottle cap counterclockwise with your right hand. task_name_original: Shake test tube containing soapy water to create bubbles

Hold the transparent test tube located near the center of the blue table and beside the yellow box. Shake the test tube.
Stretch out your right hand and hold the test tube firmly. Shake the test tube in a tilted motion and put it back on the table to its original position.
zh: 摇晃装有肥皂水的试管。
握住位于蓝色桌子中心附近、黄色盒子旁的透明试管。摇晃试管。

zh: 摇晃试管，然后将其放回。
拿起并摇晃试管，然后将其放回原位。
伸出右手牢牢握住试管。将试管向上抬起。快速摇晃试管。将试管放回桌面。松开手，将试管放回容器。

用右手握住白色试管拿起来摇晃几次，然后再放回圆柱形物体里。
