Shake the test tube back and forth to stir the soapy water inside. Hold the test tube tightly throughout the shaking process. Stop the movement and put the test tube back in its original position.
zh: 摇晃装有肥皂水的试管。
握住桌子中间蓝色零食袋旁的一个白盖试管，并用力摇晃。
伸出右手够向位于蓝色桌子中间、蓝色零食袋旁边的白盖试管。握住试管并将其稍微抬起。来回摇晃试管以搅动里面的肥皂水。在整个摇晃过程中始终紧紧握住试管。停止动作，将试管放回原位。

用右手握住白色试管拿起来摇晃几次，然后再放回圆柱形物体里。

用左手滑动并重新排列位于蓝色桌子中央的粉色花纹扑克牌来洗牌。

Spread out pink-patterned playing cards on the left side of the blue table with the left hand. Fold the playing cards into a new stack. Then put it back on the blue desktop.

左手在蓝色桌子的左侧铺开粉色花纹扑克牌。将扑克牌重新收成一叠。然后将其重新放回蓝色桌面上。

zh: 有三张摞在一起的扑克牌，左手将牌摊开再叠起来。

zh: 用左手在桌上移动并叠放移动粉色花纹的扑克牌。

左手在蓝色桌面上移动并调整几张粉色花纹扑克牌。重新排列，并形成一摞。

Shuffle the cards on the blue table with your left hand and rearrange the three pink-patterned playing cards.

用左手在蓝色桌子上洗牌并重新罗列三张粉色花纹的扑克牌。

en: There are three stacked playing cards. Spread them out with your left hand and stack them together.

en: There are three playing cards. Use your left hand to spread out the three cards one by one and stack them together.
zh: 有三张扑克牌，用左手把三张牌依次摊开，并摞在一起。

en: Place the items on the table with your left and right hands.

First, use your left hand to pick up the items in white packaging and place them at the lower part of the table. Then, use your left hand to pick up the cake and place it on the left side of the white packaging. Next, use your right hand to pick up the beverage bottle and place it behind the cake. Then, use your left hand to pick up the beverage bottle and place it on the right side of the cola. Finally, use your right hand to pick up the green scouring pad and place it on the right side of the tissue.
zh: 用左右手摆放桌子上的物品。
先用左手拿起白色包装的物品放到桌子下半部分，再用左手拿起蛋糕放到白色包装的左边，然后用右手拿起饮料瓶放到蛋糕的后面，再用左手拿起饮料瓶放到可乐的右边，最后用右手拿起绿色的百洁布放到纸巾的右边。

en: Sort and place the items.
Sort and arrange the items in the middle of the table with your left and right hands.

Use your right hand to place the two packs of snacks in the middle of the table to the lower part of the table, and then use your left hand to place the two bottles of drinks on the left side of the table.
zh: 将物品分类摆放。
用左手和右手将桌子中间的物品分类摆放。
用右手将桌子中间的两包零食放到桌子的下半部分，然后再用左手将两瓶饮料放到桌子的左边。

en: Sort and place the items.
Sort and arrange the items on the blue table with your left and right hands.
Sort and put the snacks, daily necessities and beverages on the table together with your left and right hands.
zh: 将物品分类摆放。
用左手和右手将蓝色桌子上的物品分类摆放。
用左手和右手将桌子上的零食，生活用品和饮料分类放到一起。

en: Sort and place the items on the table by category.
Sort and arrange the items on the table with your left and right hands.

First, place the yellow drink in the lower left corner of the table with your left hand. Then, use your right hand to put the two packs of snacks under the table. Next, pick up the green scrub pad and place it on the right side of the transparent box. Finally, use your left hand to pick up the white mineral water bottle and the yellow drink bottle and put them together.
zh: 将桌子上的物品分类别摆放。
用左手和右手将桌子上的物品分类摆放。
先用左手将黄色的饮料放在桌子的左下角，再用右手将两包零食放在桌子的下方，再拿起绿色的百洁布放到透明盒子的右边，然后用左手拿起白色的矿泉水瓶和黄色的饮料瓶放到一起。

en: Put the items together by category.
Sort and put together the snacks, daily necessities and beverage bottles on the table by hand.
Put the two loaves of bread, two bottles of drink, a towel and a small rectangular box on the table together with your left and right hands.
zh: 将物品分类别摆放到一起。
用手将桌子上的零食，日用品和饮料瓶分类放到一起。
用左手和右手将桌子上的两个面包，两瓶饮料，毛巾和长方形小盒子放到一起。

en: Sort the items on the table.
Sort and arrange the items on the table with your left and right hands.

First, use your right hand to place the bread in the middle of the table at the lower part of the table. Then, pick up the rectangular box and put it on the left side of the table. Next, pick up the yellow-packaged cookies and place them beside the bread. Finally, use your left hand to move the cloth and the rectangular box together to make them pile up.
zh: 将桌子上的物品分类。
用左手和右手将桌子上的物品分类摆放。
先用右手把桌子中间的面包放在桌子的下半部分，再拿起长方形盒子放在桌子的左边，然后再拿起黄色包装的饼干放到面包旁边，再用左手移动抹布和长方形的盒子使它们在一堆。

en: Place the items.
Sort and arrange the items on the table with your left and right hands.
Use your left and right hands to sort and place the snacks, mineral water bottles and erasers in the middle of the table together.
zh: 摆放物品。
用左手和右手将桌子上的物品分类摆放。
用左手和右手将桌子中间的零食，矿泉水瓶和橡皮擦分类摆放到一起。

en: Sort and arrange the items on the table.
Sort and arrange the items on the table with your left and right hands.

Use your right hand to place the two packs of snacks in the middle of the table on the lower part of the table, and then use your left hand to move the nail screwdriver and pencil sharpener to stack them together.
zh: 将桌子上的物品分类摆放。
用左手和右手将桌子上的物品分类摆放。
用右手将桌子中间的两包零食放在桌子的下半部分，然后用左手移动起钉器和卷笔刀使它们在一堆。

en: Sort and arrange the items on the table.
Sort and arrange the items on the table with your left and right hands.

First, use your right hand to pick up the wahaha and the drink from the miscellaneous items in the middle of the table one by one and place them on the right side of the table. Then, use your left hand to pick up two packs of snacks one by one and place them on the left side of the table. Finally, use your right hand to pick up the two items in the middle of the table and place them on the lower part of the table.
zh: 将桌子上的物品分类摆放。
用左手和右手将桌子上的物品分类摆放。
先用右手依次拿起桌子中间杂物里的哇哈哈和饮料放在桌子的右边，再用左手依次拿起两包零食放在桌子左边，最后用右手拿起桌子中间的两个物品放到桌子的下半部分。

en: Sort and place the items on the table together.
Sort and arrange the items on the table with your left and right hands.
Use your left and right hands in coordination to place the snacks on the right side of the table, the beverage bottles on the left side, and the erasers and square boxes at the bottom.
zh: 把桌子上的物品分类摆放到一起。
用左手和右手将桌子上的物品分类摆放。
用左右手配合将桌子上的零食放到桌子的右边，饮料瓶放到桌子的左边，橡皮和正方形盒子放到桌子的下方。

en: Sort the scattered items on the table into different areas by bottles and small pieces respectively.
Place two bottles on the right, a green cube and a yellow cube on the left, leaving the packaging box in the middle.
zh: 将桌上的散乱物品按瓶和小块分别归类到不同的区域。
将两个瓶子放在右边，左边放一个绿色立方体和一个黄色方块，中间留出包装盒。

en: Sort and place the items on the table together.
Sort and place the items on the table together with your left and right hands.

First, use your left hand to place the green scouring pad and toothpaste on the left side of the table in sequence. Then, use your right hand to arrange the snacks at the lower part of the table and the beverage bottles on the right side.
zh: 将桌子上的物品分类摆放到一起。
用左手和右手将桌子上的物品分类摆放到一起。
先用左手依次将桌子上的绿色百洁布和牙膏放到桌子的左边，再用右手将零食摆到桌子的下半部分，饮料瓶在桌子的右边。

en: Rotate the globe horizontally with your right hand.
zh: 用右手将地球仪水平旋转。

en: Rotate the desktop globe clockwise with your left hand while keeping your right hand still.
zh: 左手顺时针旋转桌面地球仪，而右手保持不动。

en: Rotate the desktop globe counterclockwise with your right hand while keeping your left hand still.

en: He picked up the orange screaming chicken on the table, pinched it a few times, then placed it on the metal tray and withdrew his hands.

Pick up the orange screaming chicken on the table with your right hand. Pinch and press its body together with both hands, and then put it into a metal tray. Finally, let go of your hands and bring them back.

Reach out your right hand towards the orange screaming chicken on the table and grasp it. Lift the screaming chicken slightly upwards and remove it from the table. Reach out your left hand to grasp the toy together, and repeatedly press the body of the screaming chicken with both hands. After placing the screaming chicken on the tray, return your hands to the initial position.
zh: 拿起桌上的橙色尖叫鸡捏了几下，然后放入金属托盘并收回双手。
右手拿取桌上的橙色尖叫鸡。双手一起捏压它的身体，接着将其放进金属托盘里。最后松开双手并收回。
右手伸向桌面上的橙色尖叫鸡并将其抓握住。把尖叫鸡稍微向上抬起离开桌面。左手伸过来一同抓住玩具，双手反复用力捏压尖叫鸡的身体。将尖叫鸡放入托盘后，双手退回到初始位置。

en: Grab the orange rubber chicken on the table, squeeze it, place it on a metal tray and then withdraw your hand.

Take the orange rubber chicken on the table with your left hand. Squeeze the toy forcefully with both hands several times, and then place it in a metal tray. Return both hands to their original positions.

He reached out with his left hand to grab the orange rubber chicken placed on the table. Hold the body of the rubber chicken and lift it off the table. Bring your right hand close together to hold the toy, and simultaneously apply force to repeatedly squeeze the rubber chicken. Suspend the rubber chicken above the metal tray. Lower the rubber chicken to the bottom of the tray and release your fingers. Return your hands to their initial position.
zh: 抓取桌面上的橙色橡胶鸡挤压后，将其放置于金属托盘中再收回手。
左手拿取桌面上的橙色橡胶鸡。双手用力挤压玩具几次，随后将其放置在金属托盘内。双手恢复原位。
左手伸过去抓取放置在桌面上的橙色橡胶鸡。握住橡胶鸡的身体将其从桌面上提起来。右手靠拢过来握住玩具，双手同时施力反复挤压橡胶鸡。把橡胶鸡悬停在金属托盘上方。放下橡胶鸡至托盘底部并释放手指，双手归位到起初的姿态。

en: Pick up the screaming chicken toy from the table, pinch it twice and then put it back on the metal tray on the table.

en: Pick up the orange toy chicken on the table and pinch it several times. Finally, put it on the metal tray and return to its initial position.
He picked up the orange toy chicken from the table with his right hand. Pinch it a few times with both hands, then release your hand to let it fall into the metal tray. Pull your hands back.

en: Pinch an orange rubber chicken with both hands.

Reach the orange rubber chicken placed horizontally between the silver plate and the bottom edge of the table with your right hand. Hold the chicken's neck with your left hand and its lower body with your right hand. Apply pressure to the chicken body repeatedly with both hands simultaneously to create a squeezing effect. While compressing the object, maintain your grip strength for a few seconds. Release the chicken and let it partially stay on the silver plate. en: Stack the chess pieces together.
Stack the five chess pieces together with your left hand.
zh: 把象棋棋子叠放在一起。
用左手把五个象棋棋子叠放在一起。

en: Stack five circular chess pieces with red Chinese characters on top of each other to form a vertical cylindrical structure.
The right hand stacks five circular chess pieces with red Chinese characters to form a vertical cylindrical structure.
zh: 将五个带有红色汉字的圆形棋子堆叠成一个垂直柱体结构。
右手将五个带有红色汉字的圆形棋子堆叠成一个垂直柱体结构。

en: Use your left hand to stack five round wooden chess pieces vertically on a tablecloth with a grid.
zh: 用左手将五个圆形木制棋子垂直堆叠在有网格的桌布上。

en: Use your left hand to stack five circular chess pieces with red Chinese characters on top of each other and place them on a tablecloth with a grid.
zh: 用左手将五个带有红色汉字的圆形棋子叠在一起放在有网格的桌布上。

en: With the left hand, stack five round wooden chess pieces vertically on the grid-lined table.
zh: 左手将五个圆形木制棋子垂直叠放在有网格的桌面。

en: The left hand stacked five round wooden chess pieces with red Chinese characters on top of each other and placed them on a tablecloth with a grid.
zh: 左手将五个带有红色汉字的圆形木制棋子叠在一起放在有网格的桌布上。

en: Stack five round wooden chess pieces vertically on the green grid tablecloth with your left hand.
zh: 用左手将五个圆形木制棋子垂直叠放在绿色网格桌布上。

en: By coordinating the operation of both arms, stack three identical metal bowls into a vertical stack.

Grasp the bowl on the far right with your right hand and lift it slightly above the table. Move your left hand to the bowl on the far left, grab it and lift it. Place the leftmost lifted bowl directly under the rightmost bowl and release it to form a double bowl stack. Use your left hand to pick up the middle bowl, lift it up carefully and place it on top of the double-bowl stack to complete the three-bowl stack centered on the table.
zh: 通过协调的双臂操作，将三个相同的金属碗叠成一个垂直堆叠。
用右手抓住最右边的碗，将其稍微提起高于桌面。将左手移动到最左边的碗处，抓住并提起。将提起的最左边的碗直接放在最右边的碗下方，松开使其形成一个双碗堆叠。用左手去拿中间的碗，提起后小心地放在双碗堆叠的顶部，完成以桌子为中心的三碗堆叠。

en: Stack the three bowls together.

Pick up the bowl on the right side of the table with your right hand and place it on the bowl in the middle. Pick up the bowl on the left side of the table with your left hand and place it on the bowl in the middle.
zh: 将三个碗叠放起来。
右手拿起桌面右侧的碗放到桌面中间的碗上，左手拿起桌面左侧的碗，放到桌面中间的碗上。

en: Stack the three bowls together.

Pick up the metal bowl on the right with your right hand and stack it on the metal bowl in the middle. Pick up the metal bowl on the left with your left hand and stack it on the metal bowl in the middle.
zh: 把三个碗堆叠在一起。
右手拿起右侧金属碗堆叠在中间的金属碗上，左手拿起左侧的金属碗堆叠在中间的金属碗上。

en: Stack the three bowls together.
Pick up the bowl in the right front with your right hand and stack it on top of the middle bowl. Pick up the bowl at the lower left corner with your left hand and stack it on top of the middle bowl.
zh: 把三个碗叠在一起。
右手拿起右前方的碗叠在中间的碗上，左手拿起左下角的碗叠在中间的碗上。

en: Stack the three bowls together.
Pick up the bowl on the left with your left hand and stack it on top of the middle bowl. Pick up the bowl on the right with your right hand and stack it on top of the middle bowl.
zh: 把三个碗叠在一起。
左手拿起左侧的碗叠放到中间的碗上，右手拿起右侧的碗叠放在中间的碗上。

en: Pick up the metal bowl on the far right and place it in the middle metal bowl to form a double-layer bowl pile.

Pick up the metal bowl on the right with your right hand and stack it on the metal bowl in the middle. Pick up the metal bowl on the left with your left hand and stack it on the metal bowl in the middle.
zh: 拿起最右边的金属碗，将其放入中间的金属碗中，形成一个双层碗堆。
右手拿起右侧金属碗堆叠在中间的金属碗上，左手拿起左侧的金属碗堆叠在中间的金属碗上。

en: Stack the three metal bowls together.

Pick up the metal bowl in the right front with your right hand and stack it on the metal bowl in the middle. Pick up the metal bowl in the left front with your left hand and stack it on the metal bowl in the middle.
zh: 将三个金属碗叠在一起。
右手拿起右前方的金属碗叠在中间的金属碗上，左手拿起左前方的金属碗叠在中间的金属碗上。

en: Stack the three bowls together.
Pick up the bowl on the left with your left hand and stack it on the metal bowl above, and pick up the metal bowl in the front with your right hand and stack it on the metal bowl at the back.
zh: 把三个碗叠放在一起。
左手拿起左侧的碗叠到上方的金属碗上，右手拿起前方的金属碗叠到后方的金属碗上。

en: Stack the three bowls together

Pick up the metal bowl on the left with your left hand and place it on the metal bowl in the middle. Pick up the metal bowl on the right with your right hand and place it on the metal bowl in the middle.
zh: 将三个碗叠在一起
左手拿起左侧的金属碗放到中间的金属碗上，右手拿起右侧的金属碗放到中间的金属碗上。

en: Stack the three bowls together.
Use your left hand to pick up the bowl on the left and place it on the middle bowl, and use your right hand to pick up the bowl on the right and place it on the middle bowl.
zh: 把三个碗叠在一起。
用左手拿起左侧的碗放到中间的碗上，用右手拿起右侧的碗方到中间的碗上。

en: Stack the three bowls together.
Pick up the bowl on the left with your left hand and stack it on top of the middle bowl. Pick up the bowl on the right with your right hand and stack it on top of the middle bowl.
zh: 把三个碗叠在一起。
左手拿起左侧的碗叠放到中间的碗上，右手拿起右侧的碗叠放在中间的碗上。

en: Stack the three bowls together.

Take the metal bowl on the left with your left hand and stack it on top of the metal bowl in the middle. Take the metal bowl on the right with your right hand and stack it on top of the metal bowl in the middle.
zh: 将三个碗叠放起来。
左手拿起左侧的金属碗，将它叠放到中间的金属碗上，右手拿起右侧的金属碗，将它叠放在中间的金属碗上。

en: Stack three white paper cups into a stack.
Pick up two white paper cups from the bottom of the table and stack them one by one on the third upright cup above.
zh: 将三个白色纸杯叠成一摞。
从桌子底部拿起两个白色纸杯，将它们逐一叠放在上方第三个直立的杯子上。

en: Stack three white paper cups into a stack.

Three white paper cups arranged horizontally on the blue table. Pick up the cup on the right with your left hand, turn it upside down onto the cup in the middle, and then turn the cup on the far left upside down onto the cup in the middle as well.
zh: 将三个白色纸杯叠成一摞。
在蓝色桌子上横向排列的三个白色纸杯。用左手拿起右边的杯子，将其倒扣在中间的杯子上，然后将最左边的杯子也倒扣在中间的杯子上。

en: Stack three white paper cups in a row on the table.
zh: 在桌子上将三个白色纸杯叠成一摞。

en: Fold the white paper cups into a stack on the table.

Take the white paper cup closest to the bottom edge with your left hand. Grab and lift it up, and put it into the white paper cup in the middle. Let go. Take the white paper cup on the far left with your left hand. Grab and lift it up, and place it on top of the stack of paper cups that have already been folded in the middle. Let go. Withdraw your hand from the desktop and put it back in its original position.
zh: 在桌子上将白色纸杯叠成一叠。
用左手拿取最靠近底边的白色纸杯。抓起并提起，将其放入中间的白色纸杯内。松开。用左手拿取最左边的白色纸杯。抓起并提起，将其放在中间已叠好的纸杯堆顶端。松开。将手从桌面撤回并放回原位。

en: Stack three white paper cups together on the blue table.

Take the white paper cup closest to the bottom with your left hand. Grab and lift it up, and put it into the white paper cup in the middle of the table. Let go. Take the white paper cup on the left with your left hand. Grab and lift it up, and place it on top of the stack of folded paper cups in the middle of the table. Let go. Withdraw your hand from the desktop and put it back in its original position.
zh: 在蓝色桌面上将三个白色纸杯叠成一叠。
用左手拿取最靠近底部的白色纸杯。抓起并提起，将其放入桌子中间的白色纸杯内。松开。用左手拿取左边的白色纸杯。抓起并提起，将其放在桌子中间已叠好的纸杯堆顶端。松开。将手从桌面撤回并放回原位。

en: Stack three white paper cups in a row on the left side of the table.

Take the white paper cup closest to the bottom edge with your left hand. Grab and lift it up, and put it into the white paper cup in the middle on the left side. Let go. Take the white paper cup on the far left with your left hand. Grab and lift it up, and place it on the top of the stack of folded paper cups in the middle to the left. Let go. Withdraw your hand from the desktop and put it back in its original position.
zh: 将三个白色纸杯在桌子左侧叠成一摞。
用左手拿取最靠近底边的白色纸杯。抓起并提起，将其放入左侧偏中间的白色纸杯内。松开。用左手拿取最左边的白色纸杯。抓起并提起，将其放在左侧偏中间已叠好的纸杯堆顶端。松开。将手从桌面撤回并放回原位。

en: Stack three white paper cups together on the blue table.

Reach for the white paper cup near the lower side in the middle of the table with your left hand and hold it firmly. Lift the cup and place it directly above the white paper cup in the center of the top of the combination. Put down the cup and let go. Move your left hand to the last white paper cup on the left. Grab the cups, lift them up and stack them on top of the existing cup posts. After successfully stacking the three cups, I withdrew my hand.
zh: 在蓝色桌子上将三个白色纸杯叠成一摞。
用左手伸向桌子中间靠近下侧的白色纸杯并将其抓牢。提起杯子，将其置于组合顶部中央的白色纸杯正上方。放下杯子并松开。将左手移向左侧最后一个白色纸杯。抓取杯子，将其提起，并叠放在现有的杯柱顶端。三个杯子成功叠放后，收回手。

en: Stack the three white paper cups into a stack with your left hand.

Reach out your left hand towards the white paper cup in the middle among the three paper cups. Hold the cup firmly and lift it off the table. Move the cup to the right and place it directly on the white paper cup located in the middle of the table. Let go of your hand. Finally, hold the cup placed on the far left and release it on the stack of cups made up of two.
zh: 用左手将三个白色纸杯叠成一摞。
用左手伸向三个纸杯里在中间的白色纸杯。牢牢握住杯子，将其从桌面拿起。将杯子向右移动，直接放在位于桌子中间的白色纸杯上。松开手。最后，捏住放在最左边的杯子，放在两个杯子组成的杯堆上松手。

en: Use your left hand to stack the three white paper cups placed on the table into a stack.

Reach out your left hand towards the white paper cup placed in the middle among the three paper cups. Grab this paper cup and move it to the white paper cup on the left. Insert this paper cup into the one on the left and release it. Place the last white paper cup at the lower right corner into the stacked paper cups to form a stack. Loosen the paper cup and withdraw your hand.
zh: 用左手将放在桌子上的三个白色纸杯叠成一摞。
用左手伸向三个纸杯里放在中间的白色纸杯。抓取该纸杯并将其移向左侧的白色纸杯。将该纸杯套入左侧的纸杯中并松开。将右下方的最后一个白色纸杯放入叠层的纸杯中，形成一叠。松开纸杯并收回手。

en: Fold the three paper cups into one stack.

Stretch out your left hand towards the white paper cup on the far right of the blue table. Hold the cup firmly and raise it. Move the cup above the white cup on the far left and put it in. Release the grip. Reach for the cup at the bottom of the middle, then pick it up and place it on top of the two stacked cups. After that, release the grip and pull your hand back from the working area.
zh: 将三个纸杯叠成一叠。
向蓝色桌子最右侧的白色纸杯伸出左手。牢牢抓紧并举起杯子。将杯子移至最左侧的白色杯子上方并将其套入。松开抓取。伸手拿向中间下面的杯子，然后拿起来放在叠加的两个杯子上面，之后松开抓取，将手从工作区域收回。

en: Fold the three white paper cups into a stack with your left hand.

Take the white paper cup on the far right of this row with your left hand. Grab the cup and lift it towards the middle. Put this cup into the middle paper cup. Adjust the grasping position, then pick up the cup on the far left and put it into the double-layered cup in the middle, and then release the cup. Form a stack of cup columns. Finally, pull your hand back to the left side of the table.
zh: 用左手将三个白色纸杯叠成一叠。
用左手拿取这一排最右侧的白色纸杯。抓住杯子，将其向中间提起。将该杯子放入中间的纸杯内。调整抓取位置，之后拿起最左侧的杯子，将它放入中间的双层杯子中，然后松开杯子。形成一叠杯子柱状。最后将手收回到桌子的左侧。

en: Fold the three white paper cups into one stack.

Stretch out your left hand towards the white paper cup at the very bottom. Grab the paper cup and move it over the table. Place the paper cup directly above the middle white paper cup. Put down the paper cup and make it fit onto the target paper cup. Release the grip. Reach the white paper cup on the upper left with your left hand. Pick up the paper cup steadily. Move the paper cups to the existing pile of cups. Align the paper cups and slide them onto the top of the cup pile. Loosen the third paper cup to complete the stacking of the cup posts.
zh: 将三个白色纸杯叠成一叠。
伸出左手够向最底部的白色纸杯。抓起纸杯并将其移过桌面。将纸杯置于中间白色纸杯的正上方。放下纸杯，使其嵌套在目标纸杯上。松开抓取。用左手够向左上方的白色纸杯。稳稳地拿起纸杯。将纸杯移向已有的杯堆。对齐纸杯并将其滑入杯堆顶部。松开第三个纸杯，完成杯柱的叠放。

en: Put the bowl on the plate and the paper cup inside the bowl.
Pick up the beige bowl under the table with your right hand and place it on the white plate on the right. Then pick up the paper cup and put it in the bowl.
zh: 将碗放在盘子上，将纸杯在碗内。
右手拿起桌子下方的米色碗，将其放在右侧的白色盘子上。再拿起纸杯将其放在碗内。

en: Place one bowl on the table on top of another.
Stack the two beige bowls on the table with your right hand.
zh: 将桌子上的一个碗放在另一个碗上。
用右手将桌子上两个米黄色的碗摞在一起。

en: Stack the two beige bowls on the table together.
Pick up the beige bowl to the left of the tissue box on the table with your right hand and stack it on the bowl to the right of the white paper cup on the table.
zh: 将桌子上两个米黄色的碗摞在一起。
用右手拿起桌子上抽纸盒左方米黄色的碗叠放在桌子上白色纸杯右方的碗上。

en: Place the beige bowl on a larger white plate. Then pick up the paper cup and put it in the bowl.
Pick up the beige bowl from the left side of the table with your left hand and place it in the center of the larger white plate. Then pick up the paper cup and put it in the bowl.
zh: 将米黄色碗放在较大的白盘子上。再拿起纸杯将其放在碗内。
左手从桌子左侧拿起米黄色碗，将其放在更大的白盘子中央。再拿起纸杯将其放在碗内。

en: Stack the two beige bowls on the table together.
Stack the two beige bowls on the table with your right hand.
zh: 将桌子上两个米黄色的碗摞在一起。
用右手将桌子上两个米黄色的碗摞在一起。

en: Stack the small bowls and paper cups on the plate.

Pick up the beige bowl from the middle and lower part of the table with your left hand and place it on the white plate. Pick up the small white paper cup from the lower left and place it in the bowl on the plate.
zh: 将小碗和纸杯叠放在盘子上。
左手从桌子中下方拿起米色碗，将其放在白色盘子上。从左下方拿起白色小纸杯，将其放入盘中的碗里。

en: Stack the two beige bowls on the table together.
Use your right hand to stack the two beige bowls beneath the paper cup together.
zh: 将桌子上两个米黄色的碗叠放在一起。
用右手将纸杯下方的两个米黄色的碗叠放在一起。

en: Stack the beige bowl and the white cup on the white plate.

Pick up the beige bowl from the center of the bottom of the table with your left hand and place it on the large white plate on the left. Grab the white cup located in the center of the table and stack it in the beige bowl.
zh: 将米色碗和白色杯子叠放在白色盘子上。
左手从桌子底部中央拿起米色碗，将其放在左侧的大白盘上。抓起位于桌子中央的白色杯子，将其叠放在米色碗内。

en: Stack the two beige bowls on the table.
Pick up the beige bowl to the right of the biscuit box on the table with your right hand and stack it on the bowl below the right of the mineral water bottle on the table.
zh: 将桌子上两个米黄色的碗叠放。
用右手拿起桌子上饼干盒右边的米黄色碗叠放在桌子上矿泉水瓶右下方的碗上。

en: Stack the off-white bowls on the white plates. Then pick up the paper cup and put it in the bowl.
Pick up the off-white bowl from the center of the bottom of the table with your left hand and place it on the white plate in the center. Then pick up the paper cup and put it in the bowl.
zh: 将米白色的碗叠放在白色盘子上。再拿起纸杯将其放在碗内。
左手从桌子底部中央拿起米白色的碗，并将其放在位于中央的白色盘子上。再拿起纸杯将其放在碗内。

en: Stack two off-white bowls on top of each other.
Use your right hand to pick up the bowl on the table close to the left side of the plate and stack it on the bowl on the right side of the paper cup.
zh: 把两个米白色的碗叠放在一起。
用右手拿起桌子上靠近盘子左边的碗叠放在纸杯右边的碗上。

en: Stack two off-white bowls on top of each other.
Use your right hand to pick up the bowl on the table close to the left side of the tissue and stack it on the bowl below the right side of the mineral water bottle.
zh: 将两个米白色的碗叠放在一起。
用右手拿起桌子上靠近纸抽左边的碗叠放在桌子上矿泉水瓶右下方的碗上。

Use your right hand to stack the smaller colored cups inside the largest orange cup.
zh: 把杯子叠起来。
用右手将较小的彩色杯子叠放在最大的橙色杯子里面。

Stack the cups in descending order with your left hand.

用左手将杯子按从大到小的顺序叠起来。

用右手捡起散落的彩色杯子，逐个放入橙色杯子中，并按大小顺序叠放，相互嵌套。

task_name: Take the Jelly from a Person’s Hand

en: Put the jelly on the table.
Pick up the jelly with your left hand and place it on the table.
zh: 把果冻放到桌子上。
左手把果冻拿起放到桌子上。

task_name: Take the Lid Off the Teapot

en: Lift the lid of the small black teapot with the left hand.
Lift the lid on the small black teapot.
Lift the lid of the small black teapot with your left hand and place it on the left side.
zh: 左手揭开黑色小茶壶的盖子。
揭开黑色小茶壶上的盖子。
用左手揭开小黑茶壶的盖子，并将其放在左侧。

task_name: Take the Lid Off the Teapot

en: Lift the lid of the black teapot on the lower part of the blue table.
Lift the lid of the small black teapot with the left hand.
Lift the lid of the black teapot.
zh: 揭开蓝色桌子下半部分黑色茶壶的盖子。
左手揭开黑色小茶壶的盖子。
揭开黑色茶壶的盖子。

task_name: Take the Lid Off the Teapot

en: Take the lid of the teapot.
Hold the lid of the teapot with your right hand.
Pick up the lid of the teapot with your right hand and place it on the right side of the teapot.
zh: 拿茶壶盖。
用右手拿茶壶盖。
用右手拿起茶壶盖并放在茶壶的右边。

task_name: Take the Lid Off the Teapot

en: Take the lid of the teapot.
Hold the black teapot lid in your right hand.
Pick up the lid of the teapot with your right hand and place it on the right side of the teapot.
zh: 拿茶壶盖。
右手拿黑色的茶壶盖。
用右手拿起茶壶盖并放在茶壶的右边。

task_name: Take the Lid Off the Teapot

en: Lift the lid of the pot.
Lift the lid of the teapot with your left hand.
zh: 揭开壶盖。
左手揭开茶壶的盖子。

task_name: Take the Lid Off the Teapot

en: Pick up the lid of the teapot.
Move your left hand towards the small black teapot located at the lower half of the blue table, pick up the lid and place it beside the teapot.
zh: 拿起茶壶上的壶盖。
将左手移向位于蓝色桌子下半部分的黑色小茶壶，拿起壶盖并将其放于茶壶旁。

task_name: Take the Lid Off the Teapot

en: Lift the lid of the small teapot.
Lift the lid of the small black teapot with the left hand.
zh: 揭开小茶壶的盖子。
左手揭开黑色小茶壶的盖子。

task_name: Take the Lid Off the Teapot

en: Lift the lid of the black teapot.
Lift the lid of the small black teapot with the left hand.
zh: 揭开黑色茶壶的盖子。
左手揭开黑色小茶壶的盖子。

task_name: Take the Lid Off the Teapot

en: Take the lid of the teapot.
Hold the lid of the teapot with your right hand and place it beside the teapot.
zh: 拿茶壶盖。
用右手拿茶壶盖，将其放在茶壶旁边。

task_name: Take the Lid Off the Teapot

en: Take the lid of the teapot.
Pick up the lid of the teapot with your right hand and place it on the table.
zh: 拿茶壶的茶壶盖。
用右手拿起茶壶的茶壶盖，放在桌面。

task_name: Take the Lid Off the Teapot

en: Take the lid of the teapot.
Hold the lid of the black teapot with your left hand.
zh: 拿茶壶盖。
用左手拿黑色茶壶的茶壶盖。

task_name: Take the Lid Off the Teapot

en: Take the lid of the teapot.
Hold the lid of the black teapot placed on the table with your right hand.
zh: 拿茶壶盖。
用右手拿放在桌子上的黑色茶壶的茶壶盖。

task_name: Take the Objects out of the Container

en: Take out the yellow clips and small packs of tissues one by one from the basket with your left hand.
zh: 用左手从筐中依次取出黄色的夹子和小包纸巾。

task_name: Take the Objects out of the Container

en: Take out the red snack bag, the yellow object and the tongs one by one from the basket with your right hand.
zh: 用右手从筐中依次取出红色的零食袋，黄色的物体和夹子。

task_name: Take the Objects out of the Container

en: Take out the yellow doll with your left hand, take out the white object, the grape and the snack bag with your right hand, and then take out the snack bag with your left hand.
zh: 用左手取出黄色的玩偶，用右手取出白色的物体，葡萄和零食袋，再用左手拿出零食袋。

task_name: Take the Objects out of the Container

en: Take out the white items and bottled drinks with your right hand, and the yellow doll with your left hand.
zh: 用右手取出白色物品和瓶装饮品，用左手取出黄色玩偶。

task_name: Take the Objects out of the Container

en: Take out the purple packaging box and the white snack bag with your right hand, and take out the yellow doll with your left hand.
zh: 用右手取出紫色包装盒和白色零食袋，用左手取出黄色的玩偶。

task_name: Take the Objects out of the Container

en: Take out the white snack bag with your right hand and the transparent mineral water bottle with your left hand.
zh: 用右手取出白色的零食袋，用左手取出透明矿泉水瓶。

task_name: Take the Objects out of the Container

en: Take out the purple tissue with your left hand, and the yellow doll and the transparent mineral water bottle with your right hand.
zh: 用左手取出紫色纸巾，用右手取出黄色的玩偶和透明的矿泉水瓶。

task_name: Take the Objects out of the Container

en: Take the items out of the basket alternately with both hands.
Take out the white transparent bag and the mineral water bottle with your right hand, and the yellow doll with your left hand.
zh: 用双手交替从筐中取出物品。
用右手取出白色的透明袋子和矿泉水瓶，用左手取出黄色的玩偶。

task_name: Take the Objects out of the Container

en: Take the items out of the basket with your right hand.
Take out the small yellow toy in the frame with your right hand.
zh: 用右手从筐中取出物品。
用右手取出框中黄色的小玩具。

task_name: Take the Objects out of the Container

en: Take the items out of the basket alternately with both hands.
Take out the tissue in the box with your right hand, the rectangular box, and take out the white transparent bag with your left hand.
zh: 用双手交替从筐中取出物品。
用右手取出框中的纸巾，长方形盒子，用左手取出白色透明袋子。

task_name: Take the Objects out of the Container

en: Take the items out of the basket alternately with both hands.
Take out the purple tissue and the red cap mineral water bottle with your right hand, and take out the white cap mineral water bottle with your left hand.
zh: 用双手交替从筐中取出物品。
用右手取出紫色纸巾和红色瓶盖的矿泉水瓶，用左手取出白色瓶盖的矿泉水瓶。

task_name: Take the Objects out of the Container

en: Take the items out of the basket alternately with both hands.
Take out the transparent mineral water bottle with your left hand and the cylindrical box with your right hand.
zh: 用双手交替从筐中取出物品。
用左手取出透明矿泉水瓶，用右手取出圆柱形的盒子。

task_name: Take the Shoes out of the Shoebox

en: Open the light blue shoe box and place the two black slippers on the table.

Extend your right hand towards the right side of the light blue box, lift the lid up and back to fully expose the inside. Grab the black slipper at the top, take it out vertically from the box, and place it flat on the table on the right. Reach into the box again, grab the second black slipper, pull it up, and tilt the box slightly to help take it out. Then place it beside the first slipper on the table.
zh: 打开浅蓝色的鞋盒，将两只黑色拖鞋放到桌面。
用右手伸向浅蓝色盒子的右侧，向上并向后抬起盖子，以完全露出内部。抓住上部的黑色拖鞋，将其垂直从盒中取出，并平放在右边的桌子上。再次伸手进入盒子，抓住第二只黑色拖鞋，向上抽出，并稍微倾斜盒子以帮助取出，然后将其放在桌子上的第一只拖鞋旁边。

task_name: Take the Shoes out of the Shoebox

en: Removing black slippers from a shoebox onto the table surface.

Enter the open shoe box with your right hand, grasp the slippers on top, and take out the first slipper to place on the patterned tablecloth. Hold the box steady with your left hand and go to get the remaining slipper with your right hand. Take it out and place it beside the first one.
zh: 把黑拖鞋从鞋盒里拿到桌面上。
右手进入敞开的鞋盒，抓住上面的拖鞋，把第一只拖鞋拿出来放在有图案的桌布上。左手稳定住盒子，右手去拿剩下的那只拖鞋，把它取出放在第一只旁边。

task_name: Take the Shoes out of the Shoebox

en: Take out two black slippers from the light blue shoe box placed in the center of the blue table.

With your right hand, approach the light blue shoebox from the right side, grasp the front edge of the box lid, and lift it upwards to fully open the box. Reach into the box with your right hand, grab the black slipper on the top, take it out vertically and place it on the table on the right side of the box. Put your right hand back into the box, grab the second black slipper, take it up and place it beside the first slipper on the table. When both slippers were taken out, the box remained open.
zh: 从放在蓝色桌面上的中央浅蓝色鞋盒中取出两只黑色拖鞋。
右手从右侧靠近浅蓝色的鞋盒，抓住盒盖的前边缘，向上提起以完全打开盒子。用右手伸入盒子，抓住最上面的黑色拖鞋，垂直将其取出并放在盒子右侧的桌子上。将右手重新放回盒子中，抓住第二个黑色拖鞋，向上取出并放在桌子上的第一个拖鞋旁边。当两个拖鞋都被取出后，盒子仍然保持打开。

task_name: Take the Shoes out of the Shoebox

en: Take the black slippers out of the shoe box.
The right hand took out the pair of black slippers from the inside of the opened blue shoe box. Lift them vertically. Place the slippers one by one on the table close to the box.
zh: 把黑拖鞋从鞋盒里拿出来。
右手从打开的蓝色鞋盒内部取出那双黑色拖鞋。垂直提起它们。将拖鞋依次放在靠近盒子的桌面上。

task_name: Take the Shoes out of the Shoebox

en: Open the light blue shoe box and place the two black slippers on the table.

Bring your right hand close to the light blue box from the right side, lift the lid upwards and tilt it backward to fully expose the inside. Grab the black slippers at the top, lift the first one out of the box and place it on the table on the right side of the box. Reach your right hand into the box again, grasp the black slipper at the bottom, lift it vertically, rotate it slightly to avoid the edge of the box, and then place it beside the first slipper on the table surface.
zh: 打开浅蓝色的鞋盒，将两只黑拖鞋放到桌面。
右手从右侧靠近淡蓝色的盒子，向上抬起盖子并向后倾斜，以完全露出内部。抓住上方的黑色拖鞋，将第一只拖鞋从盒中提起，并放在盒子右侧的桌子上。右手再次伸入盒子中，抓住下方的黑色拖鞋，将其垂直提起，稍微旋转以避开盒子边缘，然后将其放在桌子表面第一只拖鞋旁边。

task_name: Take the Shoes out of the Shoebox

en: Take out two black slippers from the light blue rectangular box sealed on the blue tablecloth.

Open the lid of the light blue box in the center of the table with your right hand, revealing two black slippers inside. First, pick up the upper slippers, place the first one on the right side of the box, and then put the lower slippers beside the first one.
zh: 从放在蓝色桌布上封闭的浅蓝色长方形盒子中取出两只黑色拖鞋。
用右手打开位于桌子中央的浅蓝色盒子的盖子，露出里面两个黑色的拖鞋；先拿起上边的拖鞋，把第一只拖鞋放在盒子右边，然后将下边的拖鞋放在第一只拖鞋旁边。

task_name: Take the Shoes out of the Shoebox

en: Take out a pair of black slippers from the light blue shoe box placed in the center of the blue table.

Open the lid of the light blue rectangular shoe box located in the center of the table with your right hand. Two black slippers are placed side by side on the white paper on the right inside. First, take out the upper slippers and place them on the right side of the box. Then, put the lower slippers at the front of the box.
zh: 从放在蓝色桌子中央的浅蓝色鞋盒中取出一双黑色拖鞋。
右手打开位于桌子中央的浅蓝色长方形鞋盒的盖子；里面右两个黑色拖鞋并排放在白色纸张上；首先取出上边的拖鞋，放到盒子的右侧，然后将下边的拖鞋放在盒子的前边。

task_name: Take the Shoes out of the Shoebox

en: Open the light blue shoe box and take out the black slippers inside.

Reach out your right hand towards the light blue shoebox and open the lid upwards and backward to fully expose the inside. Grab the black slippers and take them out of the box. Move the black slippers horizontally to the right and place them beside the box.
zh: 打开浅蓝色的鞋盒，拿出里面的黑色拖鞋。
用右手伸向浅蓝色的鞋盒，向上并向后打开盒盖，以完全露出内部。抓住黑色拖鞋，从盒中取出。将黑色拖鞋向右侧横向移动，并把黑色拖鞋放在盒子旁边。

task_name: Take the Shoes out of the Shoebox

en: Take out the black slippers from the blue shoe box.

Grab the black slipper on the top of the open blue box with your left hand, lift it vertically and place it on the table. Repeat this action, take out the slippers below and place them beside the first one.
zh: 从蓝色鞋盒中取出黑拖鞋。
左手抓住打开的蓝盒子里的上面的黑拖鞋，垂直提起，放在桌子上。重复这个动作，取出下面的拖鞋，并将其放在第一个旁边。

task_name: Take the Shoes out of the Shoebox

en: Take out two black slippers from the open light blue shoe box and then place them side by side on the blue table.

Reach into the open light blue shoe box with your right hand, grasp the slippers at the bottom, take the first slipper out of the box and place it on the table on the right side of the box. Put your right hand back into the box, grasp the upper slipper, lift the second slipper vertically, and then place it under the box.
zh: 从敞开的浅蓝色鞋盒中取出两只黑色拖鞋，然后将它们并排放在蓝色的桌面上。
用右手伸入敞口的浅蓝色鞋盒，抓住下面的拖鞋，将第一只拖鞋从盒中取出，放在盒子右侧的桌子上。将右手再放回盒中，抓住上面的拖鞋，垂直提起第二只拖鞋，然后将其放在盒子下方。

task_name: Take the Shoes out of the Shoebox

en: Take out two black slippers from the light blue shoe box placed in the center of the blue table.

Open the lid of the light blue shoe box upwards with your right hand. Hold the upper slipper with your right hand and lift it out of the box. Place that slipper flat on the table right in front of the box. Reach into the box again with your right hand, grab the second slipper and take it out. Place the second slipper beside the first one. At this point, both slippers have completely left the box.
zh: 从放在蓝色桌中央的浅蓝色鞋盒中取出两只黑色拖鞋。
用右手向上打开浅蓝色鞋盒的盖子。用右手握住上面的拖鞋，并将上面的拖鞋从盒子里提起。将那只拖鞋平放在盒子正前方的桌面上。用右手再次伸入盒中，抓住第二只拖鞋，并将其取出。把第二只拖鞋放在第一只旁边，此时两只拖鞋都完全离开盒子。

task_name: Take the Shoes out of the Shoebox

en: Take out a pair of black slippers from the closed light blue rectangular shoe box placed on the blue table.

Open the lid of the light blue shoe box placed in the center of the table with your right hand, revealing two pairs of black rubber slippers inside. First, take out the upper slippers. Place the first one in the lower right corner of the box, and then put the lower slippers on the table beside it.
zh: 从放在蓝色桌面上的封闭的浅蓝色矩形鞋盒中取出一双黑色拖鞋。
用右手打开放在桌中央的浅蓝色鞋盒盖子，露出里面的两双黑色橡胶拖鞋；先取出上边的拖鞋，将第一只拖鞋放到盒子的右下角，然后将下边的拖鞋放在它旁边的桌面上。

task_name: Take the Tea Bag out of the Tea Box

en: Take out a green tea bag from a transparent plastic box and place it on a black tray.
Lift the lid with your left hand, grab a tea bag from the transparent plastic box filled with green tea bags in the center of the table, and place it on the black tray on the left.
zh: 从透明塑料盒中取出一个绿茶包，并将其放到一个黑色托盘中。
用左手掀开盖子，从桌子中央装满绿茶包的透明塑料盒中抓起一个茶包，并将其放到左边的黑色托盘中。

task_name: Take the Tea Bag out of the Tea Box

en: Take out a green tea bag from the transparent box and place it on the tray.
Lift the lid with your left hand, pick up a green tea bag from the transparent plastic tea box in the middle, and place it on the black tray on the left.
zh: 从透明盒中取出一个绿茶包并将其放在托盘上。
用左手掀开盖子，从中间的透明塑料茶盒中拿起一个绿色茶包，并将其放在左侧的黑色托盘上。

task_name: Take the Tea Bag out of the Tea Box

en: Take out the tea bag from the box
Open the lid of the transparent box with your left hand, pick up a green tea bag from it and place it on the table
zh: 从盒中拿出茶叶包
用左手打开透明盒子的盖子，从中拿起一个绿色茶包，放到桌子上

task_name: Take the Tea Bag out of the Tea Box

en: Take the tea bag out of the box.
Open the lid with your left hand and take out a tea bag from the transparent tea box to place on the table.
zh: 从盒子中取出茶包。
用左手打开盖子，从透明茶叶盒中取出一袋茶叶包放到桌子上。

task_name: Take the Tea Bag out of the Tea Box

en: Take a tea bag out of the container and place it in the tray.
Lift the lid of the tea box with your left hand, take out a bag of tea and put it into the black tray beside it.
zh: 从容器中取出一个茶包并将其放入托盘中。
用左手掀开茶盒盖子，拿出一包茶叶放进旁边的黑色托盘中。

task_name: Take the Tea Bag out of the Tea Box

en: Take a tea bag out of the container and place it on the tray.
Open the tea box with your left hand, pick up a green tea bag from the transparent container in the center of the table, and place it on the black tray on the left.
zh: 从容器中取出一个茶包并将其放在托盘上。
用左手打开茶叶盒，从桌子中央的透明容器中拿起一个绿茶包，并将其放在左侧的黑色托盘上。

task_name: Take the Tea Bag out of the Tea Box

en: Take out a tea bag from the container.
Open the lid of the tea box with your right hand, take out a bag of tea from the box and put it into the black tray beside it.
zh: 从容器中取出一个茶包。
右手打开茶叶盒的盖子，从茶叶盒中取出一袋茶叶包放进旁边的黑色托盘中。

task_name: Take the Tea Bag out of the Tea Box

en: Take out a green tea bag from a transparent container and place it on a black tray.
Open the lid of the tea box with your left hand and reach out to take a green tea bag inside. Grab the tea bag, take it out and place it on the black tray on the left.
zh: 从透明容器中拿出一个绿色茶包，并将其放入黑色托盘中。
用左手打开茶叶盒的盖子，伸手去拿茶叶盒里的一个绿色茶包。抓起茶包，将其取出，并放在左侧的黑色托盘上。

task_name: Take the Tea Bag out of the Tea Box

en: Take the tea bag out of the tea box.
Open the lid of the tea box with your left hand, grab a green tea bag from it, pick it up and place it on the black tray.
zh: 把茶包从茶叶盒中拿出来。
用左手打开茶叶盒的盖子，从茶叶盒中抓起一个绿色茶包，将其拿起并放到黑色托盘中。

task_name: Take the Tea Bag out of the Tea Box

en: Take out a bag of tea from the tea box.
Open the lid of the tea box with your left hand, take out a bag of tea and place it on the blue table.
zh: 从茶叶盒中拿出一袋茶叶包。
用左手打开茶叶盒的盖子，从中取出一袋茶叶放到蓝色的桌面上。

task_name: Take the Tea Bag out of the Tea Box

en: Pick up a tea bag from the tea box and place it on the tray.
Lift the lid of the tea box with your left hand, take out a bag of tea leaves from it, and then place it on the tray beside it.
zh: 从茶盒中拿起一个茶包并将其放在托盘上。
用左手掀开茶盒的盖子，从中取出一包茶叶，然后放到旁边的托盘上。

task_name: Take the Tea Bag out of the Tea Box

en: Take a tea bag out of the container and place it in a tray.
Open the container with your left hand and take out the tea bag from it to place on the black tray beside it.
zh: 从容器中取出一个茶包并放入托盘中。
用左手打开容器，从容器中拿出茶叶包放到旁边的黑色托盘上。

task_name: Take the Toilet Paper off the Holder

en: Remove the toilet paper from the black metal stand on the blue table.
Reach out to the black stand on the left side of the blue table with your left hand and take the white toilet paper from it.
zh: 从蓝色桌子上的黑色金属支架上取下卫生纸。
左手伸向蓝色桌子左侧的黑色支架，从支架上取下白色的卫生纸。

task_name: Take the Toilet Paper off the Holder

en: Remove the toilet paper from the black metal stand on the blue table.
Reach out to the black stand on the left side of the blue table with your left hand and take the white toilet paper from it.
zh: 从蓝色桌子上的黑色金属支架上取下卫生纸。
左手伸向蓝色桌子左侧的黑色支架，从支架上取下白色的卫生纸。

task_name: Take the Toilet Paper off the Holder

en: Remove the toilet paper from the vertical stand on the table.
Reach out to the black stand in the middle of the blue table with your left hand and take the white toilet paper from it.

左手伸向蓝色桌子中间的黑色支架，从支架上取下白色的卫生纸。

task_name: Toss a Ring over the Object

en: Pick up a red ring from the table and place it on a purple cylindrical object.

Extend your right hand towards the red ring on the right side of the table. Firmly grasp the ring with your fingers and lift it vertically. While keeping the direction unchanged, move the ring slightly upwards to the left. Position the ring directly above the purple cylinder, then lower it and put it over the cylinder.
zh: 从桌子拿起一个红色的环，把它放在一个紫色的圆柱形物体上。
用右手伸向桌子右侧的红色圆环。用手指牢固地抓住圆环并垂直提起。在保持方向不变的情况下，将圆环向左稍向上移动。将圆环定位在紫色圆柱体正上方，然后放下，套住圆柱。

task_name: Toss a Ring over the Object

en: Pick up a yellow ring and place it on the upright pink cylindrical target on the table.

Extend your right hand towards the yellow ring on the right side of the table, grasp it from above, lift it vertically, keep the direction unchanged and move it to the left. Align it directly above the pink cylindrical target, then lower it and put it over.
zh: 举起一个黄色的环，把它放在桌子上直立的粉色圆柱形目标上。
用右手伸向桌子右侧的黄色圆环，从上方抓住它，垂直提起，保持方向不变向左移动，将其正上方对准粉色圆柱形目标，然后将其放下套住。

task_name: Toss a Ring over the Object

en: Pick up a red ring from the table and place it above the purple cylindrical target, then perform the ring-throwing action.

Extend your right hand towards the red ring located on the blue surface, and grasp its edge with your fingers. Keep the direction unchanged and lift the ring vertically. Move horizontally to the left above the opening at the top of the purple cylinder. Move the ring directly above the cylinder and then lower it.
zh: 从桌子拿起一个红色的圆环，将其置于紫色圆柱形目标上方，做投环动作。
用右手伸向位于蓝色表面上的红色的圆环，手指抓住其边缘。保持方向不变，将环垂直提起。水平向左移动至紫色圆柱顶部开口上方。将环移到圆柱体正上方后直接放下。

task_name: Toss a Ring over the Object

en: Throw the two rings onto different pillars respectively to complete the ring-tossing task.

Grasp the red ring on the right side of the blue table with your right hand, lift it vertically, and then put it over the orange pillar located in the center of the middle right area. Reach out to take the yellow ring on the left, lift it up, move it above the purple pillar, and then put it on.
zh: 将两个环分别投掷到不同的柱子上以完成套圈任务。
右手抓住蓝色桌面右侧的红色圆环，垂直提起，然后将其套在位于中右区域中央的橙色柱子上。伸手去拿左侧的黄色圆环，提起它，移动到紫色柱子上方，然后将其套上去。

task_name: Toss a Ring over the Object

en: Pick up a red ring from the table and place it on a purple cylindrical object.

Extend your right hand towards the red ring on the right side of the table, hold the upper edge of the ring with your thumb and the rest of your fingers, lift it up steadily while maintaining its direction, then move it to the left so that it is directly above the opening at the top of the purple cylinder, and then lower it.
zh: 从桌子上拿起一个红色的圆环，把它放在一个紫色的圆柱形物体上。
将右手伸向桌子右侧的红色圆环，用拇指和其余手指握住圆环的上边缘，平稳地向上提起，同时保持其方向，然后向左移动，使其正位于紫色圆柱顶部开口的正上方，然后放下。

task_name: Toss a Ring over the Object

en: Pick up a yellow ring from the table and place it over a pink cylindrical target.

Extend your right hand towards the yellow ring on the right side of the table, grasp it horizontally from above, keep the direction vertical and lift it up, then move it to the upper left to the top of the pink cylinder, and then release and wrap it around the top of the pink cylinder.
zh: 从桌子拿起一个黄色的环，并将其套在一个粉色圆柱形目标上方。
用右手伸向桌子右侧的黄色环，从上方水平抓住它，保持方向垂直向上提起，然后向左上移动到粉色圆柱体上方，然后放开围绕到粉色圆柱体的上。

task_name: Toss a Ring over the Object

en: Lift the two colored rings in sequence and place each ring on the corresponding upright cup on the blue table.

Reach for the red ring on the table with your right hand and lift it steadily. Place the ring directly above the orange pillar, then release it to let the red circle fit over the orange pillar. Then slightly withdraw your hand and move sideways to grasp the yellow ring on the right. Lift the yellow ring vertically to align it with the top of the purple column, then lower and release it to let the ring fit onto the purple column.
zh: 依次举起两个彩色环，并将每个环放在蓝色桌面的相应直立杯子上。
用右手伸向桌面上的红色圆环，将其平稳地提起。将圆环置于橙色柱子的正上方，然后松开，让红色圆圈套在橙色柱子上。随后稍微收回手，然后横向移动去抓住右侧的黄色圆环。垂直提起黄色圆环，使其对准紫色柱子的上方，然后下降松开，让圆环套在紫色柱子上。

task_name: Toss a Ring over the Object

en: Lift the two plastic rings one by one, and place them respectively onto the upright cylindrical targets on the blue table.

Grasp the yellow ring on the right side of the table with your right hand, lift it vertically, and place it on the orange cylinder near the right corner. After placing the yellow ring on the orange cylinder, move your right hand to the left, grasp the red ring, lift it up, and place it above the blue cylinder. Lower the red ring so that it surrounds the blue cylinder.
zh: 依次提起两个塑料环，将它们分别套在蓝色桌子上的直立圆柱形目标上。
用右手抓住桌子右侧的黄色圆环，垂直提起，并将其放在靠近右角的橙色圆柱体上。将黄色圆环放到橙色圆柱体上后，将右手向左移动，抓住红色圆环，向上提起，并将其放置在蓝色圆柱体上方。将红色圆环放下，使其围绕蓝色圆柱体。

task_name: Toss a Ring over the Object

en: Lift the two colored rings one by one, and place each colored ring on the pegs on the blue tabletop.

Extend your right hand towards the yellow ring on the right, hold it tightly, lift it vertically and place it accurately above the purple pillar. Release your right hand and let the yellow ring fit around the cylinder. Move your hand to the left to the red ring, hold it, lift it up, align it with the orange cylinder and then release it to complete the ring setting.
zh: 依次提起两个彩色环，并将每个彩色环分别放在蓝色桌面上的柱子上。
用右手伸向右边的黄色圆环，将其握紧，垂直提起，并准确放在紫色柱子上方；松开右手，使黄色圆环套住圆柱。将手向左移动到红色圆环处，握住它，向上提起，对准橙色圆柱后松开，完成套圈。

task_name: Toss a Ring over the Object

en: Pick up a yellow ring from the table and place it on a pink cylindrical target.

Extend your right hand toward the yellow ring on the table, pinch and grasp its lower edge, lift it vertically while keeping the orientation unchanged, move it to the upper left above the pink cylinder, then release it to fit it onto the cylinder.
zh: 从桌子上拿起一个黄色的环，把它放在一个粉色的圆柱形目标上。
将右手伸向桌面上的黄色圆环，用捏住的方式靠近其下边缘抓住它，垂直提起同时保持方向不变，将其向左上方移动到粉红色圆柱体上方，然后松开，使其套在圆柱体上

task_name: Toss a Ring over the Object

en: Pick up a red ring from the table and place it on a purple cylindrical object.
Pick up the red ring with your right hand and put it on the purple cylinder.
zh: 从桌子拿起一个红色的环，把它放在一个紫色的圆柱形物体上。
右手拿起红色圆环，套在紫色圆柱上。

task_name: Toss a Ring over the Object

en: Lift a yellow ring and place it onto a pink cylindrical target on the table.

The right hand reaches out towards the yellow ring placed on the dark table. Grasp it at the lower edge of the ring, lift it vertically while maintaining the direction. Move the ring slightly forward to the left, placing it above the desktop. Place the ring accurately on the upright pink cylinder on the right side close to the center.
zh: 举起一个黄色的环，把它套在桌子上的一个粉色圆柱形目标上。
右手伸向放在深色桌面的黄色圆环。在圆环的下边缘抓住它，垂直提起同时保持方向。将圆环向左稍向前移动，位于桌面之上。将圆环准确地放置在靠近中心右侧直立的粉色圆柱体上。

en: Switch a green spray bottle from your left hand to your right hand.
Grasp the green spray bottle on the left side of the blue surface with your left hand, and then switch to grasp it with your right hand.

Place your left hand near the green spray bottle on the left side of the blue workspace. Grip the bottle. Move your right hand from the right side toward the bottle. Use your right hand to grasp the upper part of the green spray bottle while your left hand maintains contact. Release your left hand. Withdraw your left hand to the left side of the frame while your right hand continues to hold the bottle in place.
zh: 将一个绿色的喷雾瓶从左手换到右手。
用左手抓握蓝色表面左侧的绿色喷雾瓶，并换至右手抓握。
左手靠近蓝色工作区左侧的绿色喷雾瓶。握住瓶身。右手从右侧向瓶子移动。右手抓住绿色喷雾瓶的上部，同时左手保持接触。左手松开。左手缩回至画面左侧，同时右手继续在原位握住瓶子。

en: Transfer a yellow plush toy from one hand to the other.
Grab a yellow plush dinosaur toy with your left hand on the blue surface, and pass it to your right hand.

Use your left hand to approach the yellow dinosaur plush toy on the left side of the blue surface. Grasp the toy firmly and lift it slightly. Move your right hand into the frame from the right side, approaching the toy. While keeping your left hand gripping, grasp the toy with your right hand. Release the toy with your left hand. Hold the toy using only your right hand.
zh: 将一个黄色毛绒玩具从一只手换到另一只手。
左手在蓝色表面上抓起一个黄色毛绒恐龙玩具，并将其传给右手。
用左手靠近蓝色表面左侧的黄色恐龙毛绒玩具。抓紧玩具并将其稍微抬起。右手从画面右侧移入，向玩具靠近。在左手保持抓握的同时，用右手抓取玩具。左手松开玩具。仅用右手拿着玩具。

en: Switch the watering can from your left hand to your right hand.
Transfer the upside-down watering can from your left hand to your right hand.
On the blue tool table, pick up the spray bottle with your left hand, move it to your chest, take it with your right hand, and release your left hand to return to its original position.
zh: 将喷壶从左手换到右手上。
将倒着的喷壶从左手换到右手上。
在蓝色工具台上，用左手拿起喷壶，移动到胸前，右手接过喷壶，左手松开回到原位。

en: Switch the spray bottle from your left hand to your right hand.
Switch the green spray bottle from your left hand to your right hand.
The left hand slowly picked up the spray bottle, and the right hand steadily took it. Then, the left hand gently released it, and it naturally dropped back to its original position.
zh: 将喷壶从左手换到右手上。
将绿色的喷壶从左手换到右手上。
左手缓缓拿起喷壶，右手顺势稳稳接过，随后左手轻轻松开，自然垂落回归原位。

en: Switch the spray bottle from your left hand to your right hand.
Switch the green bottle with a black nozzle from your left hand to your right hand.
On the blue table, pick up the spray bottle with your left hand, move it to your chest, take it with your right hand, and release your left hand to return to its original position.
zh: 将喷壶从左手换到右手上。
将绿色瓶身黑色喷嘴的喷壶从左手换到右手上。
在蓝色桌子上，左手拿起喷壶，移动到胸前，右手接过喷壶，左手松开回到原位。

en: Switch the spray bottle from your left hand to your right hand.
Switch the upside-down spray bottle on the table from your left hand to your right hand.
Pick up the spray bottle with your left hand, slowly move it to your chest, then take it with your right hand and release your left hand back to its original position.
zh: 将喷壶从左手换到右手上。
将桌上倒着的喷壶从左手换到右手上。
左手拿起喷壶，缓慢的移动到胸前，紧接着用右手接过喷壶，左手松开回到原位。

en: Switch the spray bottle from your left hand to your right hand.
Pick up the spray bottle at the bottom of the small blue bucket and hand it to your right hand.

In front of the neat and smooth blue tool table, the left hand slowly bent down, steadily picked up the round spray bottle, and slowly raised the arm to smoothly move it to the position directly in front of the chest. Immediately after, the right hand calmly reached forward, steadily took the spray bottle and held it firmly. Then, the left hand slowly released the grip force, naturally withdrew the arm, and gracefully and upright returned to the original standing position.
zh: 将喷壶从左手换到右手上。
将蓝色小桶下方的喷壶拿起再交到右手上。
在整洁光洁的蓝色工具台前，左手缓缓俯身，稳稳拿起造型圆润的喷壶，缓慢抬臂将其平稳移动至胸口正前方的位置；紧接着右手从容伸上前去，稳稳接过喷壶握牢，随后左手缓缓松开握持的力道，自然收回手臂，优雅端正地回归原本站立的原位。

en: Lift up the shampoo.
Lift the shampoo with the left hand and hand it to the right hand.

Beside the smooth blue tool table, the left hand gently leaned forward, carefully straightening and stabilizing the shampoo bottle that was leaning on the table surface. Then, the bottle was firmly supported, and the arm was slowly raised to the chest. Then, the right hand calmly stepped forward to respond, firmly grasping the bottle. The left hand gently released it, naturally retracted the arm, and neatly returned to its original position.
zh: 扶起洗发水。
左手扶起洗发水，递到右手上。
在光洁的蓝色工具台旁，左手轻轻探向前方，小心翼翼将歪倒在台面的洗发水瓶缓缓扶正立稳，随后稳稳托住瓶身，缓缓抬臂移至胸前；接着右手从容上前接应，稳稳握住瓶身，左手便轻轻松开，自然收回手臂，规整地回到初始原位。

en: Hand the body wash to your hand.
Pass the body wash from your left hand to your right hand.

Beside the blue tool table, the left hand slowly extends forward, gently lifting the body wash lying across the table with the bottle mouth facing forward steadily, moving it smoothly to the chest position, and then calmly passing it to the right. The right hand moved forward smoothly and firmly grasped the bottle body. The left hand then gently released and naturally retracted, returning to its original standing position in an orderly manner.
zh: 把沐浴露递到手里。
左手把沐浴露递到右手。
在蓝色工具台旁，左手缓缓伸向前方，轻轻将横躺台面、瓶口朝前的沐浴露稳稳托起，平稳移至胸前位置，再从容递向右侧；右手顺势上前稳稳接牢瓶身，左手随之轻轻松开，自然收回，规整回归原本的站立原位。

en: Pick up the spray bottle.
Pick up the spray bottle with your left hand and give it to your right hand.

Beside the blue tool table, the left hand calmly reached out, gently lifted the empty spray bottle that was still on the table, and steadily supported the body of the bottle, slowly lifting it to the chest. Immediately, he turned sideways and passed to the right side. His right hand stretched out steadily to catch and hold firmly. His left hand slowly released the force and naturally withdrew his arm.
zh: 拿起喷壶。
左手拿起喷壶给右手。
在蓝色工具台边，左手从容探出，轻轻将静置在台面的空喷壶缓缓拢起，稳稳托住壶身缓慢抬至胸前；随即侧身递向右侧，右手顺势伸来稳稳承接握牢，左手缓缓卸力松开，自然收回臂膀。

en: Pick up the laundry detergent.
Pick up the laundry detergent with your left hand.

On the blue table, pick up the blue laundry detergent with your left hand, move it to your chest, take the detergent with your right hand, and release your left hand to return to its original position.
zh: 拿起洗衣液。
左手拿起洗衣液。
在蓝色桌子上，左手拿起蓝色的洗衣液，移动到胸前，右手接过洗衣液，左手松开回到原位。

en: Switch the green spray bottle from your left hand to your right hand.
Hold the green spray bottle on the left side of the blue table with your left hand and move it to your right hand.

Hold the green spray bottle on the left side of the blue plane with your left hand. Hold the bottle with your left hand. Move your right hand from the right side of the picture towards the bottle. While maintaining the grip with your left hand, grasp the upper part of the green spray bottle with your right hand. Release the bottle with your left hand to complete the hand change, allowing the object to be ultimately held by your right hand.
zh: 将绿色的喷雾瓶从左手换到右手。
左手握住蓝色桌子左侧的绿色喷雾瓶，并将其移至右手。
左手拿取位于蓝色平面左侧的绿色喷雾瓶。用左手握住瓶身。将右手从画面右侧移向瓶子。在左手保持握持的同时，用右手抓握绿色喷雾瓶的上部。左手松开瓶子以完成换手，使物体最终由右手握持。

en: Turn off the desk lamp.
Press the button on the lamp socket with your right hand to turn off the desk lamp.
zh: 关掉台灯。
右手按灯座的按钮，关掉台灯。

en: Turn off the desk lamp.
Press the switch at the bottom of the desk lamp with your left index finger. Turn off the desk lamp.
zh: 关闭台灯。
用左手食指按下台灯底部的开关。关闭台灯。

en: Turn off the desk lamp.
Press the button on the lamp socket with your left hand to turn off the desk lamp.
zh: 关闭台灯。
左手按灯座的按钮来关掉台灯。

en: Turn off the desk lamp.
Press the switch at the bottom of the desk lamp with your left index finger. Turn off the desk lamp.
zh: 关掉台灯。
用左手食指按下台灯底部的开关。关闭台灯。

en: Turn off the desk lamp.
Press the black switch on the base of the blue desk lamp with your left index finger. Turn off the desk lamp.
zh: 关掉台灯。
用左手食指按下蓝色台灯底座上的黑色开关。关掉台灯。

en: Turn off the desk lamp.
Press the button on the lamp socket with your left hand to turn off the desk lamp.
zh: 关掉台灯。
左手按灯座的按钮来关掉台灯。

en: Turn off the desk lamp.
Press the switch at the bottom of the desk lamp with your left index finger. Turn off the desk lamp.
zh: 关闭台灯。
用左手食指按下台灯底部的开关。关掉台灯。

task_name: Unplug the Charger from the Power Strip

en: Unplug the charger from the power socket.

Place your left hand on the left edge of the socket to stabilize it, and hold the main part of the charger plug with your right hand. Pull the plug out of the socket completely in a straight line. Place the plug on the table.
zh: 从电源插座上拔下充电器插头。
将左手放在插座左侧边缘以稳定插座，右手握住充电器插头的主体部分。以直线向将插头完全从插座中拔出。将插头放到桌面。

task_name: Unplug the Charger from the Power Strip

en: Unplug the charger from the power socket.

Place your right hand on the right edge of the socket to stabilize it, and hold the charger with your left hand. Then lift the unplugged plug upwards with your left hand and place it on the table to the left of the power socket.
zh: 从电源插座上拔下充电器插头。
右手放在插座右侧边缘以稳定插座，左手抓住充电器。然后左手将拔下的插头向上提起，并放在电源插座左侧的桌子上。

task_name: Unplug the Charger from the Power Strip

en: Unplug the plug from the power socket.

Place your left hand on the left edge of the socket to stabilize it, and hold the main part of the charger plug with your right hand. Unplug the plug completely from the socket. Place the plug on the table to the right of the socket.
zh: 从电源插座上拆下插头。
将左手放在插座左侧边缘以稳定插座，右手握住充电器插头的主体部分。将插头完全从插座中拔出。将插头放到插座右侧的桌面。

task_name: Unplug the Charger from the Power Strip

en: Remove the charger from the power socket.
Hold the main body of the charger with your right hand and stabilize the power socket with your left hand. Pull out the white USB charger with your right hand and place it on the table.
Hold the charger firmly with your right hand, pull it straight up and slightly backward out of the socket. Place the charger on the desktop to the right of the power socket.
zh: 从电源插座上取下充电器。
右手握住充电器主体，左手则稳定电源插座。右手将白色USB充电器拔出来放桌上。
右手牢固地抓住充电器，将其直直向上并略微向后拉出插孔。将充电器放到电源插座右侧的桌面。

task_name: Unplug the Charger from the Power Strip

en: Remove the charger from the power socket.
Hold the main body of the charger with your right hand and stabilize the power socket with your left hand. Pull out the white charger with your right hand and place it on the table.

Pull out the white charger vertically upwards from the upper right socket with your right hand, while maintaining pressure on the power socket with your left hand. Pull out the charger completely with your right hand to expose the empty socket, and then move the charger horizontally to the right side of the table.
zh: 从电源插座上取下充电器。
右手握住充电器主体，左手则稳定电源插座。右手将白色充电器拔出来放桌上。
用右手从右上角插口垂直向上拔出白色充电器，同时左手保持对电源插座的压力。右手将充电器完全拔出，露出空的插口，然后将充电器横向移动到桌子的右侧。

task_name: Unplug the Charger from the Power Strip

en: Unplug the white charger plug from the power socket.
Hold the main body of the charger with your right hand and stabilize the power socket with your left hand. Pull out the white USB charger with your right hand and place it on the table.

Place your right hand above the charger plug and stabilize the power socket with your left hand. Firmly grasp the charger plug with your right finger and pull it out straight up to disengage from the socket. Lift the charger completely out of the power socket and place it on the table.
zh: 从电源插座上拔下白色充电器插头。
右手握住充电器主体，左手则稳定电源插座。右手将白色USB充电器拔出来放桌上。
将右手放在充电器插头上方，左手稳定电源插座。用右手手指牢固抓住充电器插头，向上直线拉出以脱离插座。将充电器完全从电源插座上提起，并放在桌上。

task_name: Unplug the Charger from the Power Strip

en: Unplug the charger from the power socket.
Hold the main body of the charger with your right hand and stabilize the power socket with your left hand. Pull out the white USB charger with your right hand and place it on the table.

Hold the main body of the white charger plug with your right hand and touch the left edge of the power socket with your left hand to prevent movement. Pull your right hand steadily outward while keeping your left hand stable. Unplug the plug completely and place it on the table to the right of the power socket.
zh: 从电源插座上拔下充电器插头。
右手握住充电器主体，左手则稳定电源插座。右手将白色USB充电器拔出来放桌上。
右手握住白色充电器插头的主体，左手接触电源插座的左侧边缘以防止移动；右手稳定地向外拉，同时左手保持稳定；将插头完全拔出并放在电源插座右侧的桌面上。

Hold the main body of the charger with your right hand, and stabilize the power outlet with your left hand. Pull out the white USB charger with your right hand and place it on the table.
zh: 从电源插座上拔下充电器插头。
右手握住充电器主体，左手则稳定电源插座。右手将白色USB充电器拔出来放桌上。

task_name: Unplug the Charger from the Power Strip

en: Unplug the charger from the power socket.
Hold the main body of the charger with your right hand and stabilize the power socket with your left hand. Pull out the white USB charger with your right hand and place it on the table.

Hold the white charger body firmly with your right hand, stabilize the power socket with your left hand. Pull the charger straight outward along its axis to detach it from the socket. Place the removed charger on the table with your right hand.
zh: 从电源插座上拔下充电器插头。
右手握住充电器主体，左手则稳定电源插座。右手将白色USB充电器拔出来放桌上。
用右手牢固地握住白色充电器主体，左手则稳定电源插座。沿着充电器的轴线方向将其直线向外拉，使其脱离插座。右手将拔下的充电器放在桌子上。

task_name: Unplug the Charger from the Power Strip

Hold the main body of the charger with your right hand and stabilize the power socket with your left hand. Pull out the white USB charger with your right hand and place it on the table.
zh: 从电源插座上拔下充电器插头。
右手握住充电器主体，左手则稳定电源插座。右手将白色USB充电器拔出来放桌上。

task_name: Unplug the Charger from the Power Strip

en: Unplug the charger from the center of the power socket.
Move both hands towards the power socket. Use your right hand to fix the socket and your left hand to unplug the plug and place it on the table.

Hold the white charger plug firmly with your left hand while keeping the socket stable with your right hand. Pull the plug out of the socket in a straight line along the direction it is inserted with your left hand. Place the charger plug on the table with your left hand.
zh: 从电源插座中央取下充电器插头。
双手向电源插座移动，右手用于固定插座，左手拔出插头放在桌上。
用左手牢固地抓住白色充电器插头，同时右手保持插座稳定。左手沿着插头插入的方向直线向外拉，使其脱离插座。左手将充电器插头放在桌上。

task_name: Unplug the Charger from the Power Strip

en: Remove the power adapter from the power socket.
Fix the power socket with your left hand and hold and pull out the adapter with your right hand. Then put it on the table.
zh: 从电源插座上移除电源适配器。
左手固定住电源插座，右手握住并拔出适配器。然后放在桌上。

Grasp each end of the rope with both hands and then pull to untie the bow on the rope.
zh: 解开蝴蝶结。
用双手分别抓住绳子的两头然后拉扯将绳子上的蝴蝶结解开。

task_name: Use a Lint Roller on Clothes

en: Use a lint applicator on the skirt.
Hold the blue handle of the lint applicator on the left side of the table and move it over the surface of the brown skirt located in the center.

Stretch your left hand towards the blue handle bristle remover on the left side of the table. Hold the handle tightly and pick it up from the table. Move the lint applicator to the brown skirt laid in the middle. Press the lint applicator onto the fabric and slide it back and forth on the garment a few times. Move the lint remover back to the left side of the table. Put the lint remover back to its starting position and release your hand.
Use a lint remover to clean the brown skirt spread on the table.
Hold the handle of the lint applicator on the left side of the table and move it over the surface of the brown skirt located in the center.

Stretch your left hand towards the blue handle bristle remover on the left side of the table. Hold the handle tightly, pick it up from the table and press the lint applicator onto the fabric, sliding it back and forth on the garment a few times. Move the lint remover back to the left side of the table. Put the lint remover back to its starting position and release your hand.
zh: 在裙子上使用粘毛器。
握住桌子左侧粘毛器的蓝色手柄，并在位于中央的棕色裙子表面移动。
用左手伸向桌子左侧的蓝色手柄粘毛器。握紧手柄，将其从桌面拿起。将粘毛器移到铺在中间的棕色裙子上。将粘毛器压在织物上，在衣物上来回滑动几次。将粘毛器移回桌子左侧。将粘毛器放回起始位置并松开手。
用粘毛器清理铺在桌上的棕色裙子。
握住桌子左侧粘毛器的手柄，并在位于中央的棕色裙子表面移动。
用左手伸向桌子左侧的蓝色手柄粘毛器。握紧手柄，将其从桌面拿起并将粘毛器压在织物上，在衣物上来回滑动几次。将粘毛器移回桌子左侧。将粘毛器放回起始位置并松开手。

task_name: Use a Lint Roller on Clothes

en: Use a lint remover to clean the skirt on the table.
Pick up the blue handle bristle remover located on the left side of the brown dress. Roll the device over the fabric surface. Put the lint remover back to its original position on the table.

Take the blue handle bristle remover located on the left side of the blue table with your left hand. Hold the handle tightly with your left hand. Place the bristle applicator on the brown skirt laid flat in the center. Move the lint remover back and forth on the fabric surface several times to remove lint. Lift the lint remover off the garment. Place the lint applicator back on the table on the left side of the skirt. Release your hand and bring it back to the starting position.
Use a lint applicator on the light brown trousers laid flat on the table.
Hold the blue handle of the bristle remover on the left. Roll the sticky part of the brownish trousers in the center of the table and then put them back in their original place.

Take the blue handle of the lint remover with your left hand. Hold the handle and remove the roller from its white casing. Place the roller above the brown pants in the center of the table. Move the roller back and forth on the fabric for cleaning. Lift the roller and move it back to the left side of the pants. Place the bristle remover on the table beside the shell. Let go of your hand.
zh: 用粘毛器清理桌子上的裙子。
拿起位于棕色裙子左侧的蓝色手柄粘毛器。在织物表面滚动该装置。将粘毛器放回桌上的原位。
左手拿取位于蓝色桌子左侧蓝色手柄粘毛器。用左手紧紧握住手柄。将粘毛器放在平铺在中央的棕色裙子上。在织物表面来回移动粘毛器数次以去除毛屑。将粘毛器从衣物上抬起。将粘毛器放回裙子左侧的桌面上。松开手，将手收回至起始位置。
在平铺于桌上的浅褐色裤子上使用粘毛器。
握住左侧的蓝色手柄粘毛器。在桌子中央的棕褐色裤子表面滚动其粘性部分，然后将其放回原处。
用左手拿取粘毛器的蓝色手柄。握住手柄，将滚轮从其白色外壳中取出。将滚轮置于桌子中央的棕褐色裤子上方。在织物上来回移动滚轮以进行清洁。提起滚轮，将其移回裤子的左侧。将粘毛器放在外壳旁边的桌面上。松开手。

task_name: Use a Lint Roller on Clothes

en: Use a lint remover to clean the brown skirt spread on the table.
Hold the blue bristle roller on the right side of the blue table. Move the roller over the surface of the brownish clothes on the table to remove the lint.

Reach out your right hand towards the blue bristle applicator located on the right side of the blue table. Hold the handle tightly and lift the bristle remover. en: Place the green plastic object on the electronic scale to measure its weight.

Move your right hand to the electronic scale on the right side of the table. Turn on the electronic scale and grasp the green double-handled plastic object on the left side of the scale. Lift the green object vertically. Place it accurately on the weighing platform of the scale. Lower and release the green object onto the platform to ensure full contact and stability.
zh: 将绿色的塑料物体放在电子秤上以测量其重量。
将右手移向桌子右侧的电子秤。打开电子秤，抓住秤左侧的绿色双柄塑料物体。垂直提起绿色物体。将其准确地放在秤的称重平台上。将绿色物体降低并释放到平台 上，确保完全接触和稳定。

en: Place the green plastic object on the electronic scale to measure its weight.

Move your right hand from the right side of the frame towards the green plastic object to turn on the electronic scale. Lift the object vertically upwards and then move it horizontally to the left over the scale pan. Slowly lower the object until it is in full contact with the scale surface. While releasing the grip, maintain a slight downward force to ensure a stable placement.
zh: 将绿色的塑料物体放在电子秤上以测量其重量。
从框架右侧向绿色塑料物体移动右手，打开电子秤。将物体垂直向上提起，然后水平向左移动过秤盘。缓慢降低物体直到它与秤面完全接触。在释放抓握的同时保持轻微的下压力，以确保放置稳定。

en: Put the spoon on the electronic scale to measure its weight.

Open the electronic scale with your right hand, reach out to the spoon, grasp the handle of the spoon near the bowl, lift it slightly away from the tablecloth, rotate it horizontally above the scale, gently place it on the weighing surface of the scale, and release the contact while ensuring it is stably placed in the center of the platform.
zh: 把勺子放在电子秤上测量它的重量。
右手打开电子秤，伸向勺子，抓住勺子靠近碗部的柄，将其稍微抬起离开桌布，水平旋转在秤上方，轻轻放至秤的称重面上，并在确保稳定放置于平台中央的情况下松开接触。

en: Place the green plastic block on the electronic scale to measure its weight.

Open the electronic scale with your right hand and extend your right hand towards the green plastic block near the upper right quadrant of the table. Hold the piece firmly from both sides. Lift it vertically upwards and move it to the left over the electronic scale. Land the block precisely on the weighing platform of the scale. Release the grip while maintaining a slight pressure to stabilize the placement. The display screen of the scale activates upon contact, indicating the start of measurement.
zh: 将绿色塑料块放在电子秤上测量其重量。
右手打开电子秤，用右手伸向桌子右上象限附近的绿色塑料块。从两侧牢固地抓住该块。垂直向上提起，并向左移动过电子秤。精确地将该块降落在秤的称重平台上。在保持轻微压力以稳定放置的同时松开握持。秤的显示屏在接触时启动，表明开始进行测量。

en: Place the green plastic container on the electronic scale to measure its weight.

Turn on the electronic scale with your right hand and move it to the green plastic container beside it. Hold the container firmly from both sides. Lift it vertically off the desktop. Move horizontally above the scale. Lower it steadily until it is centered on the platform of the scale. Release the grip while maintaining contact stability. The display screen of the scale starts up and stabilizes, showing the weight measurement value.
zh: 将绿色塑料容器放在电子秤上以测量其重量。

en: Place the green plastic container on the electronic scale to measure its weight.

Reach out your right hand towards the white electronic scale and turn it on. Grasp the green double-compartment plastic container with your right hand and lift it clean off the table. Move the container directly above the scale pan and lower it until a stable contact is established. Keep the container stationary on the scale during the period when the display screen is stable.
zh: 将绿色塑料容器放在电子秤上以测量其重量。
用右手伸向白色电子秤，打开电子秤。用右手抓住绿色的双格塑料容器，干净地将其从桌面提起。将容器直接移到秤盘上方，并将其放下直到建立稳定接触。在显示屏稳定期间保持容器在秤上不动。

en: Place the green plastic container on the electronic scale to measure its weight.

Open the electronic scale with your right hand and move it to the green container on the left side of the scale. Grasp both sides of the container with your hands. Lift it vertically off the tablecloth. Center it on the metal platform of the scale. Loosen the contact to allow for stable placement, while the display records the weight.
zh: 将绿色塑料容器放在电子秤上以测量其重量。

en: Place the green plastic container on the electronic scale to measure its weight.

zh: 将绿色塑料容器放在电子秤上测量其重量。

zh: 将绿色的塑料物体放在电子秤上测量其重量。

en: Place the green plastic block on the electronic scale to measure its weight.

Grab it from the top surface of the green square; Lift it vertically off the desktop; Move it horizontally closer to the scale; Center it on the weighing platform of the scale; Gently release the contact while maintaining hovering stability to ensure a stable reading.
zh: 将绿色的塑料块放在电子秤上测量其重量。

en: Place the purple cube on the electronic scale to measure its weight.

Open the electronic scale with your right hand, reach out to the purple square with your right hand, and firmly grasp it from the top and sides of the square. Lift the square vertically upwards and remove it from the table. Move the square horizontally above the digital scale. Place the cube on the weighing platform of the scale, ensuring full contact and stable placement. After confirming that the square is flat on the scale, release the grip.
zh: 将紫色立方体放在电子秤上以测量其重量。
右手打开电子秤，右手伸向紫色方块，从方块的顶部和侧面牢固地抓住它。将方块垂直向上提起，离开桌面。将方块水平移动到数字秤上方。将方块放在秤的称重平台上，确保完全接触并稳定放置。确认方块平放在秤上后松开握持。
